title.zh: 卷523 列傳三百十 藩部六 杜尔伯特 旧土尔扈特 新土尔扈 和硕特
title.en: Volume 523 Biographies 310: Frontier Dependencies 6: Dorbod, Old Torghut, New Torghut, Khoshut
title.raw: 卷523 列傳三百十 藩部六 杜尔伯特 旧土尔扈特 新土尔扈 和硕特

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特部，游牧金山之東烏蘭固木地。

translations.literal: The Dorbod tribe pastures in the Ulan Gumu region east of the Altai (Golden Mountains).
translations.idiomatic: The Dorbod tribe grazes in Ulan Gumu, east of the Altai Mountains.

sentences.zh: 東薩拉陀羅海、納林蘇穆河，接唐努烏梁海；

translations.literal: To the east, Saratola Sea and Narin Sumu River, adjoining Tannu Uriankhai;
translations.idiomatic: On the east lie Saratola Sea and the Narin Sumu River, bordering Tannu Uriankhai;

sentences.zh: 南哈喇諾爾、齊爾噶圖山，接科布多牧場及明阿特；

translations.literal: To the south, Haranor and Qiergat Mountains, adjoining the Kobdo pastures and the Mingat;
translations.idiomatic: On the south are Haranor and Mount Qiergat, adjoining the Kobdo pastures and the Mingat;

sentences.zh: 西索果克河，接阿爾泰烏梁海；

translations.literal: To the west, Sogok River, adjoining Altai Uriankhai;
translations.idiomatic: On the west is the Sogok River, bordering Altai Uriankhai;

sentences.zh: 北阿斯哈圖河，接烏里雅蘇台卡倫。

translations.literal: To the north, Ashatu River, adjoining the Urga (Uliastai) barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the north is the Ashatu River, adjoining the Uliastai barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 本額魯特綽羅斯種，與內扎薩克之隸科爾沁右翼一旗同名異族。

translations.literal: Originally of the Oirat Choros stock; they share a name with but are a different people from one banner of the Right Wing of Khorchin subordinate to the Inner Zasaks.
translations.idiomatic: They are of Oirat Choros stock and bear the same name as, but are a different people from, one banner of the Khorchin Right Wing under the Inner Zasaks.

sentences.zh: 厄魯特舊設四衛拉特，杜爾伯特其一也，輝特隸之，後並稱衛拉特。

translations.literal: The Oirats formerly established four Oirat confederations; Dorbod was one of them, with Khoit subordinate to it; later all were collectively called Oirat.
translations.idiomatic: The Oirats once organized four confederations, of which Dorbod was one; Khoit was subordinate to it, and later all were known collectively as Oirat.

sentences.zh: 詳青海厄魯特部傳。

translations.literal: For details see the biography of the Qinghai Oirat tribes.
translations.idiomatic: See the biography of the Qinghai Oirat tribes for further particulars.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾台吉噶爾丹虐諸昆弟子姓，兄子策妄阿喇布坦棄之，徙博囉塔拉，杜爾伯特諸台吉從往，分牧額爾齊斯。

translations.literal: The Zungar taiji Galdan brutalized the clans of his kinsmen; his nephew Tsewang Araptan abandoned him and moved to Borotala; the Dorbod taijis followed, grazing in divisions along the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: The Zungar taiji Galdan mistreated his kinsmen's clans; his nephew Tsewang Araptan left him for Borotala, and the Dorbod taijis went with him to pasture in separate camps along the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 迄準噶爾族亂，杜爾伯特內附，設扎薩克十有四，附輝特扎薩克二，統稱賽因濟雅哈圖杜爾伯特部。

translations.literal: When the Zungar line was extinguished in rebellion, the Dorbod submitted within; fourteen zasaks were established, with two Khoit zasaks attached, collectively styled the Sain Jayikhatu Dorbod tribe.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zungar clan was destroyed in rebellion, the Dorbod came within the empire; fourteen zasaks were set up, with two Khoit zasaks attached, all under the name Sain Jayikhatu Dorbod.

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特祖曰博羅納哈勒，與準噶爾祖額斯墨特達爾漢諾顏為昆弟。

translations.literal: The Dorbod ancestor was Boronakhal, brother to the Zungar ancestor Esmet Darhan Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: The Dorbod ancestor Boronakhal was a brother of the Zungar ancestor Esmet Darhan Noyan.

sentences.zh: 博羅納哈勒子額什格泰什，三傳至達賴泰什。

translations.literal: Boronakhal's son was Eshgeteish; after three generations came Dalai Teish.
translations.idiomatic: Boronakhal was succeeded by his son Eshgeteish, and three generations later by Dalai Teish.

sentences.zh: 子七：長敏珠，裔不著；

translations.literal: He had seven sons: the eldest Minju, whose line is not recorded;
translations.idiomatic: He had seven sons: the eldest, Minju, left no notable descendants;

sentences.zh: 次垂因；

translations.literal: the second Chuiyin;
translations.idiomatic: next Chuiyin;

sentences.zh: 次陀音，其裔皆隸察哈爾；

translations.literal: the third Toyin, whose descendants all were placed under Chahar;
translations.idiomatic: then Toyin, whose descendants were all assigned to Chahar;

sentences.zh: 次鄂木布岱青和碩齊，為扎薩克汗車凌、親王車凌烏巴什、貝勒剛多爾濟三旗祖；

translations.literal: the fourth Omubudai Khosochi, ancestor of the three banners of Zasak Khan Cheren, Prince Cheren Ubashi, and Beile Gangdorji;
translations.idiomatic: then Omubudai Khosochi, founder of the three banners of Zasak Khan Cheren, Prince Cheren Ubashi, and Beile Gangdorji;

sentences.zh: 次袞布；

translations.literal: the fifth Gunbu;
translations.idiomatic: then Gunbu;

sentences.zh: 次達延泰什；

translations.literal: the sixth Dayan Teish;
translations.idiomatic: then Dayan Teish;

sentences.zh: 次塔爾琿泰什，其裔隸各扎薩克。

translations.literal: the seventh Targhu Teish, whose descendants were placed under the various zasaks.
translations.idiomatic: and lastly Targhu Teish, whose line was distributed among the various zasaks.

sentences.zh: 達賴泰什弟曰保伊爾登，子四。

translations.literal: Dalai Teish's younger brother was Boierden, who had four sons.
translations.idiomatic: Dalai Teish's younger brother Boierden had four sons.

sentences.zh: 長鄂爾羅斯，為扎薩克台吉恭錫拉、達什敦多克二旗祖；

translations.literal: The eldest Orlos was ancestor of the two banners of Zasak Taiji Gongxila and Dashundok;
translations.idiomatic: The eldest, Orlos, founded the two banners of Zasak Taiji Gongxila and Dashundok;

sentences.zh: 次巴特瑪多爾濟，為扎薩克貝勒色布騰、貝子班珠爾，輔國公剛、巴圖蒙克、台吉額布根五旗祖；

translations.literal: the second Batmadorji, ancestor of the five banners of Zasak Beile Sebten, Beizi Banzur, Fuguo Gong Gang, Batumengke, and Taiji Ebugen;
translations.idiomatic: next Batmadorji, founder of the five banners of Zasak Beile Sebten, Beizi Banzur, Fuguo Gong Gang, Batumengke, and Taiji Ebugen;

sentences.zh: 次額璘沁巴圖爾，為扎薩克貝子根敦、瑪什巴圖，台吉巴爾三旗祖；

translations.literal: the third Elinchin Batur, ancestor of the three banners of Zasak Beizi Gendun, Mashbatu, and Taiji Bar;
translations.idiomatic: then Elinchin Batur, founder of the three banners of Zasak Beizi Gendun, Mashbatu, and Taiji Bar;

sentences.zh: 次伯布什，為扎薩克郡王車凌蒙克一旗祖。

translations.literal: the fourth Bobushi, ancestor of the one banner of Zasak Junwang Cheren Mengke.
translations.idiomatic: and lastly Bobushi, founder of the single banner of Zasak Junwang Cheren Mengke.

sentences.zh: 和碩特台吉鄂齊爾圖，為衛拉特首汗，綽羅斯諸台吉隸之。

translations.literal: The Khoshut taiji Ochirtu was the chief khan of the Oirats, and the Choros taijis were subordinate to him.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshut taiji Ochirtu was head khan of the Oirats, with the Choros taijis under his authority.

sentences.zh: 順治十四年，杜爾伯特台吉陀音遣使哈什哈等自鄂齊爾圖所，以貢馬至。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Shunzhi, the Dorbod taiji Toyin sent envoys Hashiha and others from Ochirtu's camp to present tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 14, Dorbod taiji Toyin sent Hashiha and other envoys from Ochirtu's camp with tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 十五年，鄂木布岱青和碩齊子伊斯扎布復遣使額爾克貢馬。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Omubudai Khosochi's son Iszhab again sent the envoy Erke with tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Omubudai Khosochi's son Iszhab again sent Erke with tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，台吉額勒敦噶木布從鄂齊爾圖使入貢，自稱為阿勒達爾泰什族。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, taiji Eledun Gamu came to offer tribute with Ochirtu's envoys, styling himself of the Aldar Teish clan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14, taiji Eledun Gamu came to court with Ochirtu's mission and identified himself as of the Aldar Teish line.

sentences.zh: 阿勒達爾泰什者垂因子也，時蓋為所部長。

translations.literal: Aldar Teish was Chuiyin's son and was then presumably chief of his tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Aldar Teish was Chuiyin's son and was then apparently head of his division.

sentences.zh: 十六年，噶爾丹戕鄂齊爾圖，遣使告，自稱博碩克圖汗，因脅諸衛拉特奉己令。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Galdan killed Ochirtu, sent envoys to report it, styled himself Boshoktu Khan, and thereby coerced the Oirat tribes to obey his orders.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16, Galdan slew Ochirtu, announced the deed by envoy, took the title Boshoktu Khan, and forced the Oirat tribes to accept his rule.

sentences.zh: 諭給諸貢使符驗，不從，詭稱杜爾伯特及和碩特、土爾扈特雖隸準噶爾，以牧地遠，不及給。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that tally passes be issued to all tribute envoys; he did not comply, falsely claiming that although the Dorbod, Khoshut, and Torghut were subject to the Zungars, their pastures were too distant to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered tally passes for all tribute envoys; Galdan refused, claiming that the Dorbod, Khoshut, and Torghut, though under Zungar control, were too far away to be supplied.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，定四衛拉特貢例，噶爾丹使入關額二百人，餘市張家口及歸化城，其綽羅斯自貢之噶爾瑪岱青和碩齊、杜爾伯特台吉阿勒達爾泰什及和碩特、土爾扈特長如之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the tribute regulations for the four Oirat confederations were fixed: Galdan's envoys entering the passes were limited to two hundred men, the rest trading at Zhangjiakou and Guihua; the same applied to the Choros who presented tribute on their own—Garma Dai Khosochi, Dorbod taiji Aldar Teish, and the chiefs of the Khoshut and Torghut.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 24 the tribute quotas for the four Oirat confederations were set: Galdan's envoys crossing the passes were capped at two hundred, with the rest trading at Zhangjiakou and Guihua; the same limits applied to Choros who came on their own—Garma Dai Khosochi, Dorbod taiji Aldar Teish, and the Khoshut and Torghut leaders.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，台吉巴拜來歸。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, taiji Babai came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 33, taiji Babai submitted.

sentences.zh: 巴拜者陀音子也，噶爾丹以附牧，強取其戚屬。

translations.literal: Babai was Toyin's son; Galdan, on the pretext of attached pasture, forcibly took his kinsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Babai was Toyin's son; Galdan seized his kinsmen on the pretext of shared grazing rights.

sentences.zh: 巴拜索之不獲，畏弗敢爭。

translations.literal: Babai demanded their return but did not recover them, and in fear did not dare contend.
translations.idiomatic: Babai demanded them back in vain and, afraid of Galdan, did not dare press the matter.

sentences.zh: 嗣從噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，至烏蘭布通，欲棄之降，為伊拉古克三呼圖克圖所陰阻。

translations.literal: Later he followed Galdan in invading Khalkha; at Ulan Butung he wished to abandon him and surrender, but was secretly obstructed by the Khutuktu of Ilaguk.
translations.idiomatic: He later followed Galdan against Khalkha; at Ulan Butung he meant to desert and surrender, but the Ilaguk Khutuktu secretly blocked him.

sentences.zh: 至是偕從子齊克宗至。

translations.literal: At this time he came with his nephew Qikezong.
translations.idiomatic: He now arrived with his nephew Qikezong.

sentences.zh: 上以其習邊外，不便駐內地，詔隸喀喇沁牧。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering that he was accustomed to the frontier and unsuited to residence in the interior, ordered him placed under Kharchin pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was used to frontier life and ill suited to the interior, the emperor assigned him to Kharchin pastures.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，台吉車凌復來歸。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, taiji Cheren again came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 36, taiji Cheren submitted once more.

sentences.zh: 車凌為阿勒達爾泰什孫，其父烏爾袞從噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，為大軍所敗，攜屬三百餘竄圖拉河境。

translations.literal: Cheren was Aldar Teish's grandson; his father Urgun followed Galdan in invading Khalkha, was defeated by the main army, and fled with more than three hundred followers into the Tula River region.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren was Aldar Teish's grandson; his father Urgun had followed Galdan against Khalkha, was routed by imperial forces, and fled with over three hundred followers to the Tula.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，諭遣護軍統領瑪喇曰：「爾等馳赴圖拉，遣人問故。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it, he instructed the dispatched Guard General Mara: "Hasten to the Tula and send men to inquire the reason.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this, the emperor told Guard General Mara, whom he had dispatched: "Ride at once to the Tula and send men to learn their intentions.

sentences.zh: 伊等或欲內附，懼為喀爾喀阻；

translations.literal: They may wish to submit within but fear obstruction by the Khalkha;
translations.idiomatic: They may wish to submit but fear the Khalkha will block them;

sentences.zh: 或力不能至而在彼，可收之至。

translations.literal: or they may be unable to come and remain there—in either case bring them in.
translations.idiomatic: or they may be unable to come and are still there—in either case bring them in.

sentences.zh: 如欲往阿勒台則聽之。

translations.literal: If they wish to go to the Altai, let them.
translations.idiomatic: If they prefer the Altai, allow them to go there.

sentences.zh: 既不內附，又不前往，則當相機行事。」

translations.literal: If they neither submit within nor go forward, then act as circumstances require."
translations.idiomatic: If they neither submit nor move on, act as circumstances require."

sentences.zh: 瑪喇至，偵不獲踪。

translations.literal: When Mara arrived, reconnaissance found no trace of them.
translations.idiomatic: Mara arrived but scouts could find no trace of them.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹再侵喀爾喀，烏爾袞復從至，和托輝特台吉根敦陣斬之。

translations.literal: Galdan again invaded Khalkha; Urgun followed once more and was slain in battle by the Khotogoid taiji Gendun.
translations.idiomatic: When Galdan invaded Khalkha again, Urgun followed him and was killed in battle by Khotogoid taiji Gendun.

sentences.zh: 車凌從噶爾丹竄牧巴顏烏蘭，根敦以告。

translations.literal: Cheren followed Galdan in flight to pasture at Bayan Ulan; Gendun reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren fled with Galdan to Bayan Ulan; Gendun reported his whereabouts.

sentences.zh: 詔使諭車凌降，不至。

translations.literal: An edict sent envoys to urge Cheren to surrender; he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to urge Cheren to surrender, but he did not come.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹尋敗遁，車凌將乞降，我師不知而擊之，乃逸。

translations.literal: Galdan soon was defeated and fled; Cheren was about to beg surrender, but our army, not knowing, attacked him, and he escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan was soon defeated and fled; Cheren was on the point of surrendering when our troops, unaware, struck at him and he got away.

sentences.zh: 其屬綽克圖巴圖爾、宰桑莽奈哈什哈、都喇圖巴圖爾、班丹哈什哈、宰桑扎爾瑚齊什賁達爾漢、宰桑蘇穆齊扎爾瑚齊、阿哈雅扎爾瑚齊、畢哩克扎爾瑚齊等率眾百餘內附。

translations.literal: His followers Choktu Batur, zaisang Mangnai Hashiha, Dulatu Batur, Bandan Hashiha, zaisang Jarhuqi Shibendarhan, zaisang Sumuqi Jarhuqi, Ahaya Jarhuqi, Bilike Jarhuqi, and others led more than a hundred men to submit within.
translations.idiomatic: His followers Choktu Batur, the zaisangs Mangnai Hashiha, Dulatu Batur, Bandan Hashiha, Jarhuqi Shibendarhan, Sumuqi Jarhuqi, Ahaya Jarhuqi, Bilike Jarhuqi, and others brought over a hundred men to submit.

sentences.zh: 時巴拜屬從至，詔置張家口外。

translations.literal: At that time Babai's followers also arrived; an edict placed them outside Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: Babai's followers arrived at the same time and were settled outside Zhangjiakou.

sentences.zh: 巴拜遣宰桑博克請賜所屬，遣官察給之。

translations.literal: Babai sent the zaisang Boke to request allotment of his followers; officials were dispatched to inspect and grant them.
translations.idiomatic: Babai sent zaisang Boke to ask that his people be assigned; officials were sent to survey and allot them.

sentences.zh: 巴拜尋來朝，請效力禁廷，諭曰：「爾先眾來降，朕自有加恩之處。

translations.literal: Babai soon came to court and asked to serve at the imperial guard; he was instructed: "Your followers came down first; I shall have favor to bestow.
translations.idiomatic: Babai soon came to court and offered to serve in the imperial guard; he was told: "Your people submitted first, and I shall reward that.

sentences.zh: 其仍率所屬駐喀喇沁牧。」

translations.literal: Continue to lead your followers and remain on Kharchin pastures."
translations.idiomatic: Continue to lead your people on Kharchin pastures."

sentences.zh: 車凌敗，知噶爾丹不足恃，遣使奏：「杜爾伯特部自始貢中國，至阿勒達爾泰什，往來朝請已五世。

translations.literal: After his defeat Cheren knew Galdan could not be relied on and sent envoys to memorialize: "The Dorbod tribe has presented tribute to China from the beginning; down to Aldar Teish, court visits have continued for five generations.
translations.idiomatic: After his defeat Cheren saw that Galdan was no support and sent envoys to report: "The Dorbod have paid tribute to China from the first; down to Aldar Teish our court visits have spanned five generations.

sentences.zh: 前蒙恩遣巴扎爾傳諭臣屬功格額爾克，令臣歸誠，許恩待。

translations.literal: We were graciously sent Bazhar to instruct my follower Gongge Erke to have me return in loyalty, with promise of gracious treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Your Grace once sent Bazhar to tell my follower Gongge Erke to bring me back in loyalty, with promise of favor.

sentences.zh: 臣遵旨降，反為將軍所擊，臣复懼而逃，乞賜恩綸。」

translations.literal: I obeyed the decree and surrendered, yet was struck by the general; I fled again in fear and beg gracious favor."
translations.idiomatic: I obeyed and came to surrender, but was attacked by the general; I fled again in fear and beg Your Grace's mercy."

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「車凌來歸時，我綠營、蒙古兵不知而擊之。

translations.literal: An edict replied: "When Cheren came to submit, our Green Standard and Mongol troops did not know and attacked him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "When Cheren came to submit, our Green Standard and Mongol troops struck him without knowing his intent.

sentences.zh: 今復遣使奏請，理籓院其檄令速降，朕將優恤之。」

translations.literal: Now that he again sends envoys to petition, let the Court of Colonial Affairs issue an order for him to surrender quickly; I shall treat him generously."
translations.idiomatic: Now that he sends envoys again, let the Court of Colonial Affairs order him to surrender at once; I shall treat him generously."

sentences.zh: 會遣使招噶爾丹，詔以其使從。

translations.literal: It happened that envoys were being sent to summon Galdan; an edict ordered Cheren's envoys to accompany them.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time envoys were sent to summon Galdan, and Cheren's envoys were ordered to go with them.

sentences.zh: 至則車凌他徙，其使齎檄往諭。

translations.literal: When they arrived Cheren had moved elsewhere; his envoys carried the order to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: When they arrived Cheren had moved on; his envoys carried the summons to him.

sentences.zh: 車凌遣功格額爾克奉表降，自詣大將軍費揚古所告曰：「烏蘭布通戰後，臣父烏爾袞降志誠，不獲達。

translations.literal: Cheren sent Gongge Erke with a memorial of surrender and himself went to the commander-in-chief Fiyanggū to report: "After the battle of Ulan Butung my father Urgun's wish to surrender in good faith could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren sent Gongge Erke with a surrender memorial and went in person to Commander-in-Chief Fiyanggū, saying: "After Ulan Butung my father Urgun wished sincerely to surrender but could not reach you.

sentences.zh: 臣前為大軍擊，心甚懼，率殘卒十餘奔達瑪爾，遇噶爾丹，偕赴薩克薩克圖固哩克。

translations.literal: I was earlier struck by the main army and was greatly afraid; leading a dozen-odd survivors I fled to Damar, met Galdan, and went with him to Saksaktu Gurik.
translations.idiomatic: I was struck by your army and fled in terror with a dozen survivors to Damar, met Galdan, and went with him to Saksaktu Gurik.

sentences.zh: 未浹旬，棄之走額克阿喇勒。

translations.literal: Before ten days had passed I abandoned him and fled to Eke Aral.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days I left him and fled to Eke Aral.

sentences.zh: 臣知噶爾丹罪，與彼伍，徒就死。

translations.literal: I knew Galdan's guilt; to keep company with him was only to court death.
translations.idiomatic: I knew Galdan was guilty; to stay with him was only to die.

sentences.zh: 聞上撫厄魯特降人咸得所，集臣屬二百五十餘戶內徙，道逾汗阿林翁吉，閱四月始至。

translations.literal: Hearing that Your Majesty settles all Oirat submitters in security, I gathered more than two hundred fifty households of my followers and moved within; the route crossed Khan Alin Ongi, and only after four months did we arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that you settle all Oirat who surrender in peace, I gathered over two hundred fifty households and moved within; we crossed Khan Alin Ongi and took four months to arrive.

sentences.zh: 乞以此情代奏。」

translations.literal: I beg that this account be reported on my behalf."
translations.idiomatic: I beg you to report this to the throne."

sentences.zh: 費揚古馳疏聞，留其拏屬於張家口外，遣車凌覲行營。

translations.literal: Fiyanggū sent a rapid memorial; Cheren's dependents were left outside Zhangjiakou, and Cheren was sent to attend the mobile camp.
translations.idiomatic: Fiyanggū sent an urgent memorial; Cheren's families were left outside Zhangjiakou while Cheren was sent to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 詔授散秩大臣，巴拜如之。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him Grand Minister Without Portfolio; Babai received the same.
translations.idiomatic: Both were appointed Grand Ministers Without Portfolio.

sentences.zh: 明年，詔以巴拜、車凌屬隸察哈爾正白旗，編佐領二：車凌屬六品官班丹畢哩克及壯丁百餘，以功格額爾克為驍騎校領之；

translations.literal: The next year an edict placed Babai's and Cheren's followers under the Chahar Plain White Banner and organized two assistant commandant companies: Cheren's sixth-rank officer Bandan Bilike and more than a hundred strong men, with Gongge Erke as company captain in command;
translations.idiomatic: The next year Babai's and Cheren's people were assigned to the Chahar Plain White Banner in two companies: Cheren's sixth-rank officer Bandan Bilike and over a hundred men, with Gongge Erke as company captain;

sentences.zh: 巴拜屬五品官戴和碩齊、納木喀琳沁、額爾德尼達木巴，六品官達爾扎巴圖蒙克、色棱泰墨爾根伊什德克及壯丁百餘，以達木巴領之。

translations.literal: Babai's fifth-rank officers Dai Khosochi, Namukhalinchin, and Erdeni Damba, sixth-rank officers Darjabatu Mengke and Selengtai Mergen Ishideke, and more than a hundred strong men, with Damba in command.
translations.idiomatic: Babai's fifth-rank officers Dai Khosochi, Namukhalinchin, and Erdeni Damba, sixth-rank officers Darjabatu Mengke and Selengtai Mergen Ishideke, and over a hundred men, under Damba's command.

sentences.zh: 後巴拜卒，無嗣。

translations.literal: Later Babai died without heirs.
translations.idiomatic: Babai later died without heirs.

sentences.zh: 車凌卒，子策旺達爾濟嗣。

translations.literal: Cheren died; his son Tsewang Dorji succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren died and was succeeded by his son Tsewang Dorji.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，詔招降台吉丹津於阿勒台。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year an edict summoned the taiji Danjin to surrender at the Altai.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 54 an edict summoned taiji Danjin to surrender at the Altai.

sentences.zh: 丹津者鄂木布岱青和碩齊孫也，與車凌為昆弟，游牧阿勒台，戶千餘。

translations.literal: Danjin was Omubudai Khosochi's grandson and Cheren's brother; he pastured at the Altai with more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Danjin was Omubudai Khosochi's grandson and Cheren's brother; he grazed at the Altai with over a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 和托輝特台吉博貝請赴阿勒台招丹津降，抗即以兵取之。

translations.literal: The Khotogoid taiji Bobe asked to go to the Altai to summon Danjin to surrender; if he resisted, he would take him by force.
translations.idiomatic: Khotogoid taiji Bobe offered to go to the Altai to win Danjin over, or take him by force if he resisted.

sentences.zh: 諭車凌遣使齎書從。

translations.literal: Cheren was instructed to send envoys bearing letters to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren was told to send envoys with letters to go along.

sentences.zh: 比至，丹津徙策旺阿喇布坦牧。

translations.literal: When they arrived Danjin had moved to Tsewang Araptan's pastures.
translations.idiomatic: By the time they arrived Danjin had moved to Tsewang Araptan's pastures.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，靖逆將軍富寧安擒台吉垂木伯爾於伊勒布爾和碩。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year the Pacification General Funing'an captured the taiji Choimor at Ilebur Khoshod.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 59 Pacification General Funing'an captured taiji Choimor at Ilebur Khoshod.

sentences.zh: 蓋是時策妄阿喇布坦假兵力據四衛拉特，令諸台吉環牧烏魯木齊、額爾齊斯為負嵎計。

translations.literal: At this time Tsewang Araptan, relying on military force, held the four Oirat confederations and ordered the taijis to pasture in a ring around Urumqi and the Irtysh as a strategy of desperate defense.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang Araptan then held the four Oirat confederations by force and had the taijis graze in a ring around Urumqi and the Irtysh as a last-ditch defense.

sentences.zh: 我大兵因屯巴里坤、阿勒台兩路遏之，偵準噶爾襲唐古特，詔大軍往討罪，復以兵分擊準噶爾境。

translations.literal: Our main army therefore encamped on the Barkul and Altai routes to block them; when it was learned that the Zungars were raiding Tangut, an edict ordered the main army to campaign in punishment, and troops were again divided to strike the Zungar territory.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces camped on the Barkul and Altai routes to contain them; when Zungar raids on Tangut were detected, the main army was ordered to campaign, with detachments striking Zungar territory.

sentences.zh: 垂木伯爾者丹津族台吉也，率屬駐烏魯木齊，設哨伊勒布爾和碩、阿克塔斯路。

translations.literal: Choimor was a taiji of Danjin's clan; he led his followers to garrison Urumqi and set outposts on the Ilebur Khoshod and Aktas routes.
translations.idiomatic: Choimor was a taiji of Danjin's clan; he garrisoned Urumqi and posted guards on the Ilebur Khoshod and Aktas routes.

sentences.zh: 富寧安以兵至阿克塔斯設哨，賊遁，尾至伊勒布爾和碩擊之，擒垂木伯爾歸，烏魯木齊眾聞之咸竄。

translations.literal: Funing'an advanced to the Aktas outpost; the enemy fled; he pursued to Ilebur Khoshod, struck them, captured Choimor and returned; on hearing of it all the Urumqi bands fled.
translations.idiomatic: Funing'an reached the Aktas outpost; the enemy fled; he pursued to Ilebur Khoshod, defeated them, and brought Choimor back; the Urumqi bands all scattered on hearing of it.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年冬，台吉三車凌來歸。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighteenth year of Qianlong, the three taijis Cheren came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Qianlong 18 the three Cheren taijis submitted.

sentences.zh: 三車凌者：曰車凌，曰車凌烏巴什，曰車凌蒙克，統稱杜爾伯特台吉，巴約特其屬部也。

translations.literal: The three Cheren were: Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, and Cheren Mengke, collectively styled Dorbod taijis; the Bayad were their subordinate tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The three were Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, and Cheren Mengke, collectively the Dorbod taijis; the Bayad were their subordinate tribe.

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特以車凌為長，車凌烏巴什次之。

translations.literal: Among the Dorbod Cheren was chief and Cheren Ubashi second.
translations.idiomatic: Among the Dorbod, Cheren was senior and Cheren Ubashi next.

sentences.zh: 巴約特以車凌蒙克為長，聚族額爾齊斯。

translations.literal: Among the Bayad Cheren Mengke was chief; the clan gathered on the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: The Bayad followed Cheren Mengke and were gathered on the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾台吉舊有策淩敦多布二，大策淩敦多卜善謀，小策淩敦多卜以勇聞，策妄阿喇布坦及子噶爾丹策淩倚任之。

translations.literal: Among the Zungar taijis there had long been two Tsewang Dorji: the elder Tsewang Dorji was skilled in strategy, the younger famed for valor; Tsewang Araptan and his son Galdan Tsering relied on them.
translations.idiomatic: The Zungars had long had two Tsewang Dorji: the elder was a strategist, the younger famed for courage; Tsewang Araptan and his son Galdan Tsering depended on both.

sentences.zh: 大策淩敦多卜孫達瓦齊襲殺噶爾丹策淩嗣而自立。

translations.literal: The elder Tsewang Dorji's grandson Dawachi attacked and killed Galdan Tsering's heir and set himself up.
translations.idiomatic: The elder's grandson Dawachi killed Galdan Tsering's successor and seized power.

sentences.zh: 小策淩敦多卜孫訥默庫濟爾噶勒與構兵，各令杜爾伯特族助。

translations.literal: The younger Tsewang Dorji's grandson Nemeku Jirgal fought him; each made the Dorbod clans assist.
translations.idiomatic: The younger's grandson Nemeku Jirgal fought him, and each pressed the Dorbod to take his side.

sentences.zh: 車凌等欲拒之，不敵，欲事之，莫知所從，集族言曰：「依準噶爾，非計也，不如歸天朝為永聚計。」

translations.literal: Cheren and the others wished to resist but were no match; wished to serve one side but did not know which to follow; they assembled the clan and said: "Relying on the Zungars is no plan; better to return to the Celestial Dynasty as a plan for lasting settlement.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren and his kin wished to resist but could not; wished to take a side but did not know which; they assembled the clan and said: "To rely on the Zungars is no plan; we should submit to the dynasty for a lasting home.

sentences.zh: 有喀爾喀卒額璘沁達什者，為準噶爾所掠，聞其謀，脫歸以告。

translations.literal: A Khalkha soldier named Elinchin Dash, captured by the Zungars, heard their plan, escaped, and returned to report it.
translations.idiomatic: A Khalkha soldier named Elinchin Dash, taken by the Zungars, overheard the plan, escaped, and brought word of it.

sentences.zh: 詔定邊左副將軍喀爾喀親王成袞扎布俟車凌等至，察其誠可納之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Frontier, Khalkha Prince Chenggunjab, to wait until Cheren and the others arrived and examine whether their sincerity warranted acceptance.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Frontier, Khalkha Prince Chenggunjab, was ordered to wait for Cheren and his party and judge whether their submission was sincere.

sentences.zh: 既而三車凌棄額爾齊斯牧，由準噶爾東烏蘭嶺烏英齊而行，越旬有九日至博東齊，遣使巴顏克什克、都圖爾噶等馳赴巴顏珠爾克，以降故告，而留其眾於額克阿喇勒以待。

translations.literal: Soon the three Cheren abandoned their Irtysh pastures, traveled by way of the Zungar east of Ulan Ridge at Uyingqi, and after nineteen days reached Bodongqi; they sent envoys Bayan Kishik, Duturga, and others posthaste to Bayan Zhur to announce their surrender, leaving their people at Eke Aral to await.
translations.idiomatic: The three Cheren then left the Irtysh, marched east of Ulan Ridge through Zungar territory, and in nineteen days reached Bodongqi; envoys Bayan Kishik and Duturga raced to Bayan Zhur to announce their surrender while the people waited at Eke Aral.

sentences.zh: 成袞扎布遣守汛者視，慮詐，檄喀爾喀兵備之，以聞。

translations.literal: Chenggunjab sent border guards to observe; fearing deception, he ordered Khalkha troops to stand ready and reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggunjab sent guards to watch them, fearing a ruse, alerted Khalkha troops, and reported to court.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「車凌等降，非叵測也。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Cheren's submission is not unfathomable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Cheren's surrender is not hard to understand.

sentences.zh: 達瓦齊與訥默庫濟爾噶勒構兵，車凌等助之，勝負難預定，幸而從者勝，卒為人役，不若歸降之為得計也。

translations.literal: Dawachi and Nemeku Jirgal are at war; Cheren and the others would aid one side; victory is hard to foresee; even if their side won they would end as others' servants—submission is the better plan.
translations.idiomatic: Dawachi and Nemeku Jirgal are at war; if Cheren aided either side the outcome would be uncertain, and even victory would leave them servants of another—submission is the wiser course.

sentences.zh: 既遣使以情告，若仍令處汛外，恐遣兵至或有失，可即徙入內汛，暫給牧畜，徐議安置事宜。

translations.literal: Since they have sent envoys to explain, if they are still kept outside the inner posts, troops sent there may cause mishap; they may at once move within the inner posts, be given pasture and livestock for the time being, and arrangements be discussed gradually.
translations.idiomatic: They have sent envoys to explain themselves; if they remain outside the inner posts, our troops may clash with them; let them move inside at once, receive temporary pasture and livestock, and settle details later.

sentences.zh: 先以車凌、車凌烏巴什及從至者酌遣數人，令其瞻仰朕躬，朕自優加恩賚。」

translations.literal: First from Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, and those who had come with them, select and send a few persons to behold My person; I Myself will bestow generous favors."
translations.idiomatic: First select a few men from Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, and their party to behold the emperor in person; he would personally bestow generous rewards."

sentences.zh: 遣侍郎玉保齎賞物往諭。

translations.literal: The Vice Minister Yubao was dispatched bearing gifts to announce this.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister Yubao was sent with gifts to deliver the message.

sentences.zh: 甫就道，上念所部習邊外，以未出痘者生身，若即令至內地，雖傷一僕從不忍，詔俟明歲受朝塞外，勿遽來京師，以負矜卹意。

translations.literal: Just as he set out on the road, the emperor reflected that their people were accustomed to the frontier and many had never had smallpox; if they were sent to the interior at once, even the loss of one attendant would be unbearable; an edict ordered them to await audience next year beyond the passes in the borderlands and not hurry to the capital, lest the tender solicitude be frustrated.
translations.idiomatic: Yubao had barely set out when the emperor, mindful that their people were frontier folk among whom many had never had smallpox, could not bear even one attendant's death in the interior; he ordered them to wait until the next year for audience beyond the passes, not to rush to the capital, lest his care be undone.

sentences.zh: 而三車凌懼準噶爾兵襲，請急徙入汛，且獻馬為贄。

translations.literal: But the three Cheren, fearing a Zungar military raid, asked urgently to move within the posts and presented horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The three Cheren, fearing a Zungar attack, urgently asked to move inside the border posts and presented horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 成袞扎布納之，令暫駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Chenggunjab accepted this and ordered them to halt temporarily at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggunjab agreed and ordered them to stay temporarily at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 達瓦齊遣宰桑桑禡木特以兵襲，不及乃逸。

translations.literal: Dawachi sent the zaisang Samt Möt with troops to raid them; he did not catch up and they escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Dawachi sent the zaisang Samt Möt with troops to attack them, but failed to overtake them and they got away.

sentences.zh: 玉保至，三車凌忭迎十里外，宣諭之。

translations.literal: When Yubao arrived, the three Cheren came rejoicing to meet him ten li out and proclaimed the edict.
translations.idiomatic: When Yubao arrived, the three Cheren joyfully met him ten li out and received the imperial message.

sentences.zh: 詭奏：「噶勒丹策淩時，思內附，以眾志未變，且法嚴，故不獲間。

translations.literal: They submitted a disingenuous memorial: "Under Galdan Tsering we wished to submit within, but the will of the masses had not turned and the laws were strict, so we found no opening.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted a disingenuous memorial: "Under Galdan Tsering we wished to submit to the dynasty, but popular opinion had not shifted and the laws were strict, so we found no opportunity.

sentences.zh: 今避亂來歸，思覲天顏，蒙恩軫念避痘，令緩入覲期，請先以宰桑等朝京師。」

translations.literal: Now fleeing disorder we have come to submit, longing to behold the imperial countenance; in grace You were tenderly mindful of smallpox and deferred the audience; we ask first to send zaisang and others to court in the capital."
translations.idiomatic: Now fleeing turmoil we have come to submit and long to see the emperor's face; in grace he deferred our audience for fear of smallpox; we ask first to send zaisang and others to the capital."

sentences.zh: 車凌使曰和通、巴顏克什克，車凌烏巴什使曰哈錫塔，車凌蒙克使曰巴圖。

translations.literal: Cheren sent Hotun and Bayan Kishik; Cheren Ubashi sent Khashta; Cheren Mengke sent Batu.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren sent Hotun and Bayan Kishik; Cheren Ubashi sent Khashta; Cheren Mengke sent Batu.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，使至，詔與朝正諸籓臣宴。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year the envoys arrived; an edict ordered them to banquet with the other feudatory ministers at the New Year's audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the next year the envoys arrived and were ordered to feast with the other tributary princes at the New Year's audience.

sentences.zh: 上以所部間道至，駝馬疲甚，且乏畜產，不忍遽遠徙，詔視推河、扎克拜達里克、庫爾奇勒可耕地置之，穀種取諸歸化城。

translations.literal: The emperor, seeing that their people had come by a roundabout route and that camels and horses were very weary and they lacked livestock, could not bear to move them far at once; he ordered that arable land be sought along the Tui River, at Zakh Baydakh, and at Kirkhil and that they be settled there, grain seed to be taken from Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that their people had come by a roundabout route, with camels and horses exhausted and livestock scarce, the emperor would not move them far at once; he ordered arable land found along the Tui River, at Zakh Baydakh, and at Kirkhil for their settlement, with seed grain from Guihua.

sentences.zh: 复賜車凌、車凌烏巴什羊各五千，車凌蒙克羊三千贍之。

translations.literal: He further granted Cheren and Cheren Ubashi five thousand sheep each and Cheren Mengke three thousand sheep for their support.
translations.idiomatic: He further gave Cheren and Cheren Ubashi five thousand sheep each and Cheren Mengke three thousand sheep for their upkeep.

sentences.zh: 尋定牧扎克拜達里克。

translations.literal: Soon their pastures were fixed at Zakh Baydakh.
translations.idiomatic: Soon their pastures were assigned at Zakh Baydakh.

sentences.zh: 車凌烏巴什屬巴啟、齊倫等叛逸。

translations.literal: Subordinates of Cheren Ubashi, Baqi and Qilun among others, rebelled and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren Ubashi's followers Baqi, Qilun, and others rebelled and fled.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀卒盜車凌屬伊爾都齊馬，索不給，且射殺之。

translations.literal: Khalkha soldiers stole a horse belonging to Cheren's follower Yilduqi; when demanded back they refused and even shot him dead.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha soldiers stole a horse belonging to Cheren's follower Yilduqi; when it was demanded back they refused and shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 詔喀爾喀扎薩克以鄂爾坤防秋兵百視牧，复檄諸扎薩克鄰汛者弋叛賊務獲。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Khalkha zasaks to detail a hundred autumn-defense troops from the Orkhon to watch over the pastures, and again ordered all zasaks on neighboring posts to hunt the rebel bandits and capture them without fail.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha zasaks were ordered to post a hundred Orkhon autumn-defense troops to guard the pastures, and neighboring zasaks were told to hunt down the rebels and capture them.

sentences.zh: 後巴啟等就擒論罪。

translations.literal: Later Baqi and the others were captured and sentenced.
translations.idiomatic: Later Baqi and his companions were captured and punished.

sentences.zh: 四月，諭曰：「內扎薩克及喀爾喀咸設正副盟長，董理牧務。

translations.literal: In the fourth month an edict said: "The Inner Zasaks and the Khalkha all have chief and deputy league heads to oversee pastoral affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict said: "The Inner Zasaks and the Khalkha all have chief and deputy league heads to oversee pastoral affairs.

sentences.zh: 今新降台吉車凌等攜至戶口，悉編旗分佐領，其設正副盟長如內扎薩克及喀爾喀例，賜賽因濟雅哈圖盟名。」

translations.literal: Now the newly submitted taiji Cheren and others have brought their households; all are to be organized into banners with assistant commandants; league chief and deputy are to be established as among the Inner Zasaks and Khalkha; the league name Sain Jayikhatu is granted."
translations.idiomatic: The newly submitted taiji Cheren and others have brought their households; organize them into banners with assistant commandants, appoint chief and deputy league heads as among the Inner Zasaks and Khalkha, and grant the league name Sain Jayikhatu."

sentences.zh: 五月，駕幸熱河，駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the emperor proceeded to Rehe and halted at the Mountain Villa for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the emperor went to Rehe and stayed at the Mountain Villa for Avoiding Summer Heat.

sentences.zh: 三車凌率諸台吉至，賜宴萬樹園，命觀火戲。

translations.literal: The three Cheren led the taijis to audience; a banquet was given at the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees and they were bidden to watch fireworks.
translations.idiomatic: The three Cheren led the taijis to audience; they were feasted in the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees and invited to watch fireworks.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「杜爾伯特台吉等皆準噶爾渠酋，向慕仁化，率萬餘眾傾心來歸，宜敷渥澤，錫予封爵，以示懷柔至意。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Dorbod taijis are all chieftains of the Zungar ringleaders; long admiring benevolent transformation, they have led more than ten thousand to come wholeheartedly; it is fitting to spread generous favor and bestow noble ranks to show the utmost intent of winning affection.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "The Dorbod taijis were Zungar chieftains who long admired civilized rule and led more than ten thousand to submit wholeheartedly; generous favor and noble ranks should be bestowed to show the fullest conciliatory intent.

sentences.zh: 其各鈐所屬，令安分謀業，勿負朕恩。」

translations.literal: Each is to restrain his followers, keep them in their places and seek their livelihoods, and not fail Our grace."
translations.idiomatic: Let each restrain his followers, keep them settled and at their work, and not betray the emperor's grace."

sentences.zh: 時所部設扎薩克十有三，自三車凌外，曰色布騰，曰蒙克特穆爾，曰根敦，曰班珠爾，曰剛，曰巴圖蒙克，曰禡什巴圖，曰達什敦多克，曰恭錫喇，曰巴爾，封親、郡王、貝勒、貝子、公、一等台吉有差。

translations.literal: At this time thirteen zasaks were established in their tribe; besides the three Cheren were Sebeten, Mengket Mur, Dundön, Bandidor, Gang, Batu Mengke, Mashbatu, Dashtondok, Gongxila, and Bar; they were enfeoffed variously as prince, beile, beise, duke, and first-rank taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen zasaks were then established in their tribe; besides the three Cheren there were Sebeten, Mengket Mur, Dundön, Bandidor, Gang, Batu Mengke, Mashbatu, Dashtondok, Gongxila, and Bar, enfeoffed in varying ranks from prince down to first-rank taiji.

sentences.zh: 後蒙克特穆爾以從車凌蒙克子巴朗叛逃，別授其弟額布根為扎薩克，餘仍爵，詳列傳。

translations.literal: Later Mengket Mur, because his follower Barang, son of Cheren Mengke, rebelled and fled, had his zasakship transferred to his brother Ebugen; the rest kept their ranks; details are in individual biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Later Mengket Mur lost his zasakship when his follower Barang, son of Cheren Mengke, rebelled and fled; his brother Ebugen was appointed zasak instead; the rest kept their titles; details appear in separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，將軍策楞請徙三車凌牧於歸化城青山東。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn the general Tsewang requested to move the pastures of the three Cheren to the east of Qing Mountain near Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn General Tsewang asked to move the three Cheren's pastures to the east of Qing Mountain near Guihua.

sentences.zh: 時議備兵徵達瓦齊，諭曰：「巴朗等甫叛竄，若徙之，將滋新降疑懼，且非辦理準噶爾本意，其令安處舊牧，勿他徙。」

translations.literal: As preparations were debated to raise troops against Dawachi, an edict said: "Barang and others have just rebelled and fled; if they are moved it will increase the newly submitted people's suspicion and fear, and it is not the original intent in handling the Zungar; let them remain peacefully on their old pastures and not be moved elsewhere."
translations.idiomatic: As troops were being readied against Dawachi, an edict said: "Barang and others have just rebelled and fled; moving the Dorbod now would only alarm the newly submitted and is not the purpose of the Zungar campaign; let them stay on their old pastures and not be relocated."

sentences.zh: 三車凌之至也，告族台吉訥默庫留準噶爾戶千餘，剛多爾濟、額爾德尼、巴圖博羅特如之，將乘間內徙。

translations.literal: When the three Cheren had come, they reported that their kinsman taiji Nemeku had left more than a thousand households in Zungar territory, and Dundorji, Erdeni, and Batu Borot likewise; they would move within when opportunity offered.
translations.idiomatic: When the three Cheren arrived they reported that their kinsman taiji Nemeku had left more than a thousand households in Zungar lands, as had Dundorji, Erdeni, and Batu Borot, who would move within when they could.

sentences.zh: 至是果偕輝特台吉阿睦爾撒納、和碩特台吉班珠爾至，詔賜牧畜，置塔楚，鄰三車凌牧。

translations.literal: By this time they indeed arrived with the Khoit taiji Amursana and the Khoshut taiji Bandidor; an edict granted pasture and livestock, established tamga guards, and placed them adjoining the three Cheren's pastures.
translations.idiomatic: By then they did arrive with the Khoit taiji Amursana and the Khoshut taiji Bandidor; the court granted pasture and livestock, posted tamga guards, and settled them next to the three Cheren's pastures.

sentences.zh: 十月，駕由盛京旋，駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the emperor returned from Mukden and halted at the Mountain Villa.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the emperor returned from Mukden and stayed at the Mountain Villa.

sentences.zh: 訥默庫等入覲，复賜宴，錫之爵。

translations.literal: Nemeku and others presented themselves at audience; a banquet was again given and ranks bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Nemeku and his party were received in audience, feasted again, and granted ranks.

sentences.zh: 曰訥默庫，封郡王；

translations.literal: Nemeku was enfeoffed as prince of the second rank;
translations.idiomatic: Nemeku was made a prince of the second rank;

sentences.zh: 曰剛多爾濟，曰巴圖博羅特，封貝勒；

translations.literal: Dundorji and Batu Borot were enfeoffed as beile;
translations.idiomatic: Dundorji and Batu Borot were made beile;

sentences.zh: 曰布圖克森，曰額爾德尼，曰羅壘雲端，封貝子；

translations.literal: Butuksen, Erdeni, and Luolei Yunduan were enfeoffed as beise;
translations.idiomatic: Butuksen, Erdeni, and Luolei Yunduan were made beise;

sentences.zh: 曰布顏特古斯，曰蒙克博羅特，封輔國公；

translations.literal: Buyantu Gus and Mengke Borot were enfeoffed as ducal assistants of state;
translations.idiomatic: Buyantu Gus and Mengke Borot were made ducal assistants of state;

sentences.zh: 曰烏巴什，曰伯勒克，封一等台吉。

translations.literal: Ubashi and Berlek were enfeoffed as first-rank taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Ubashi and Berlek were made first-rank taiji.

sentences.zh: 凡設扎薩克十，詔編旗分佐領，如三車凌例，分左、右翼，設正副盟長各一。

translations.literal: In all ten zasaks were established; an edict ordered them organized into banners with assistant commandants as with the three Cheren, divided into Left and Right Wings, with one chief and one deputy league head each.
translations.idiomatic: Ten zasaks were established in all; they were organized into banners with assistant commandants like the three Cheren, divided into Left and Right Wings, each with a chief and deputy league head.

sentences.zh: 訥默庫者，車凌烏巴什兄子。

translations.literal: Nemeku was Cheren Ubashi's brother's son.
translations.idiomatic: Nemeku was the son of Cheren Ubashi's brother.

sentences.zh: 剛多爾濟、布圖克森、額爾德尼、羅壘雲端、烏巴什、伯勒克，皆車凌烏巴什曾祖察袞裔。

translations.literal: Dundorji, Butuksen, Erdeni, Luolei Yunduan, Ubashi, and Berlek were all descendants of Cheren Ubashi's great-grandfather Chaghan.
translations.idiomatic: Dundorji, Butuksen, Erdeni, Luolei Yunduan, Ubashi, and Berlek were all descended from Cheren Ubashi's great-grandfather Chaghan.

sentences.zh: 布顏特古斯、巴圖博羅特、蒙克博羅特亦戚族也。

translations.literal: Buyantu Gus, Batu Borot, and Mengke Borot were also kinsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Buyantu Gus, Batu Borot, and Mengke Borot were also of the same clan.

sentences.zh: 後訥默庫晉親王，子喇嘛扎卜授貝勒，以叛除爵。

translations.literal: Later Nemeku was promoted to prince of the first rank; his son Lama Zhab was granted beile rank but was stripped for rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Later Nemeku was promoted to prince of the first rank; his son Lama Zhab was made beile but stripped of rank for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 布圖克森、羅壘雲端、烏巴什，皆無嗣停襲。

translations.literal: Butuksen, Luolei Yunduan, and Ubashi all died without heirs and succession ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Butuksen, Luolei Yunduan, and Ubashi all died without heirs and their titles lapsed.

sentences.zh: 伯勒克卒，子多第巴襲。

translations.literal: When Berlek died, his son Dodiba succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Berlek died, his son Dodiba inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 多第巴卒，子尼爾瓦齊襲。

translations.literal: When Dodiba died, his son Nirwachi succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Dodiba died, his son Nirwachi inherited.

sentences.zh: 尼爾瓦齊卒，無嗣，以多第巴弟布顏德勒格爾襲。

translations.literal: When Nirwachi died without heir, Dodiba's younger brother Buyan Delegel succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Nirwachi died without heirs, Dodiba's younger brother Buyan Delegel inherited.

sentences.zh: 布顏德勒格爾卒，無嗣停襲。

translations.literal: When Buyan Delegel died without heir, succession ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When Buyan Delegel died without heirs, the title lapsed.

sentences.zh: 布顏特古斯卒，子舍稜襲，以叛除爵。

translations.literal: When Buyantu Gus died, his son Shedeng succeeded but was stripped for rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: When Buyantu Gus died, his son Shedeng inherited but was stripped of rank for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 剛多爾濟無嗣，以從子達瓦丕勒襲。

translations.literal: Dundorji had no heir; his collateral nephew Dawapile succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Dundorji had no heirs; his collateral nephew Dawapile inherited.

sentences.zh: 額爾德尼卒，無嗣停襲。

translations.literal: When Erdeni died, succession ceased for lack of heirs.
translations.idiomatic: When Erdeni died without heirs, the title lapsed.

sentences.zh: 巴圖博羅特、蒙克博羅特皆以叛除爵。

translations.literal: Batu Borot and Mengke Borot were both stripped of rank for rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Batu Borot and Mengke Borot were both stripped of rank for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 故自剛多爾濟外，皆不立傳。

translations.literal: Therefore apart from Dundorji none were given separate biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore none except Dundorji were given separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 二十年，烏梁海降臣察達克招服包沁，察獲杜爾伯特屬以獻，詔給所部。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Uriankhai submitter Chadak won over the Baoqin and seized Dorbod dependents to present; an edict ordered them given to their tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the Uriankhai submitter Chadak won over the Baoqin and captured Dorbod dependents whom he presented; an edict ordered them restored to the tribe.

sentences.zh: 尋從大軍徵達瓦齊。

translations.literal: Soon they followed the main army in the campaign against Dawachi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they joined the main army in the campaign against Dawachi.

sentences.zh: 三車凌既入覲歸，詔選兵二千，以車凌領其一，隸北路；

translations.literal: After the three Cheren had presented themselves and returned, an edict selected two thousand troops, one division under Cheren on the Northern Route;
translations.idiomatic: After the three Cheren had paid their respects and returned, two thousand men were selected; Cheren led one division on the Northern Route;

sentences.zh: 車凌蒙克、色布騰從之，以車凌烏巴什領其一，隸西路：各授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Cheren Mengke and Sebeten followed him; Cheren Ubashi led another division on the Western Route: each was given an assisting grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren Mengke and Sebeten went with him; Cheren Ubashi led another division on the Western Route; each was assigned an assisting grand minister.

sentences.zh: 訥默庫等繼至，請從軍，詔隸西路。

translations.literal: Nemeku and others arrived later and asked to join the army; an edict assigned them to the Western Route.
translations.idiomatic: Nemeku and his party arrived later and asked to join the campaign; they were assigned to the Western Route.

sentences.zh: 以車凌烏巴什、訥默庫皆幼不更事，詔調車凌蒙克赴西路軍，從車凌烏巴什、訥默庫等行。

translations.literal: Since Cheren Ubashi and Nemeku were both young and inexperienced, an edict transferred Cheren Mengke to the Western Route army to accompany Cheren Ubashi, Nemeku, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Because Cheren Ubashi and Nemeku were young and inexperienced, Cheren Mengke was transferred to the Western Route to accompany Cheren Ubashi, Nemeku, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 而是時阿睦爾撒納為北路副將軍，訥默庫其妻弟也，固請隸北路軍，允之。

translations.literal: But at this time Amursana was deputy commander of the Northern Route, and Nemeku was his wife's brother; he urgently asked to be assigned to the Northern Route army, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: But Amursana was then deputy commander on the Northern Route, and Nemeku was his wife's brother; he pressed to join the Northern Route army and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 以故偕三車凌至者隸西路副將軍薩拉勒隊，偕訥默庫至者隸北路副將軍阿睦爾撒納隊。

translations.literal: For this reason those who had come with the three Cheren were assigned to Deputy Commander Saral's Western Route corps, and those who had come with Nemeku to Deputy Commander Amursana's Northern Route corps.
translations.idiomatic: Thus those who had come with the three Cheren were placed under Deputy Commander Saral on the Western Route, and those who had come with Nemeku under Deputy Commander Amursana on the Northern Route.

sentences.zh: 賜車凌整裝銀二千，車凌烏巴什、訥默庫各減十分之二，給從軍者羊及餱有差。

translations.literal: Cheren was granted two thousand taels of silver for equipment; Cheren Ubashi and Nemeku each received twenty percent less; sheep and rations were given to those following the army in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren was given two thousand taels of silver for equipment; Cheren Ubashi and Nemeku each received twenty percent less; those who joined the army were given sheep and rations in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 复詔使車凌及車凌蒙克遣宰桑以善耕卒百赴額爾齊斯，蓋杜爾伯特眾兼耕牧業，視喀爾喀專以牧為業者異。

translations.literal: An edict further ordered Cheren and Cheren Mengke to send zaisang with a hundred skilled-farming soldiers to the Irtysh, for the Dorbod people practiced both farming and herding, unlike the Khalkha who relied solely on pastoralism.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren and Cheren Mengke were also ordered to send zaisang with a hundred skilled farmers to the Irtysh, for the Dorbod practiced both farming and herding, unlike the Khalkha who lived by pastoralism alone.

sentences.zh: 將遣綠旗及喀爾喀兵屯耕額爾齊斯，以所部識水泉道，且善耕，命簡卒往導，俟大功成，遣牧眾歸額爾齊斯。

translations.literal: Green Standard and Khalkha troops were to be sent to farm garrisons on the Irtysh; because their people knew the water sources and routes and were skilled at farming, selected soldiers were ordered to go as guides; when the great undertaking succeeded, the herding masses would be sent back to the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard and Khalkha troops were to farm garrisons on the Irtysh; because the Dorbod knew the water and roads and were good farmers, selected men were sent as guides; when the campaign succeeded, the herders would return to the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 會北路軍奏至，以訥默庫參贊列名，詔西路軍奏如之，列三車凌及色布騰名，次參贊大臣鄂容安後。

translations.literal: When the Northern Route army memorial arrived listing Nemeku among the assisting commanders, an edict ordered the Western Route memorial to do likewise, listing the three Cheren and Sebeten, after the assisting grand minister Echen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Northern Route report arrived listing Nemeku among the assisting commanders, the Western Route was told to do the same, listing the three Cheren and Sebeten after Assisting Grand Minister Echen.

sentences.zh: 复諭定北將軍班第，俟伊犁定，遣車凌、車凌烏巴什等率新降諸台吉入覲。

translations.literal: An edict further instructed the Pacification Commander in the North Bandi that when Ili was settled, Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, and others were to lead the newly submitted taijis to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi, Pacification Commander in the North, was further instructed that once Ili was pacified, Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, and others should lead the newly submitted taijis to audience.

sentences.zh: 初，議徵達瓦齊，上以衛拉特諸台吉後先附，凡數万眾，錯處內牧，非得地眾建之不可。

translations.literal: At first, when raising troops against Dawachi was debated, the emperor noted that Oirat taijis had submitted in succession, totaling tens of thousands settled among inner pastures; without ample land they could not be established.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign against Dawachi was first debated, the emperor noted that Oirat taijis had submitted in succession, tens of thousands in all settled on inner pastures; they could not be established without ample land.

sentences.zh: 詔俟準噶爾定，將復設四衛拉特，以車凌為杜爾伯特汗，別以班珠爾為和碩特汗，以阿睦爾撒納為輝特汗，以噶爾丹策淩子姓為綽羅斯汗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that when the Zungar were pacified the four Oirat confederations would be restored: Cheren as Khan of the Dorbod, separately Bandidor as Khan of the Khoshut, Amursana as Khan of the Khoit, and a descendant of Galdan Tsering's line as Khan of the Choros.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that once the Zungar were pacified the four Oirat confederations would be restored: Cheren as Khan of the Dorbod, Bandidor as Khan of the Khoshut, Amursana as Khan of the Khoit, and a descendant of Galdan Tsering's line as Khan of the Choros.

sentences.zh: 車凌等赴軍時輒聞命。

translations.literal: Cheren and the others heard these appointments whenever they went to the army.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren and his party heard these appointments whenever they joined the army.

sentences.zh: 大兵抵伊犁，達瓦齊就擒。

translations.literal: The main army reached Ili and Dawachi was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The main army reached Ili and Dawachi was captured.

sentences.zh: 班第以車凌烏巴什、訥默庫及新降之綽羅斯台吉噶勒藏多爾濟、和碩特台吉沙克都爾曼濟、輝特台吉巴雅爾等列入覲初班。

translations.literal: Bandi listed Cheren Ubashi, Nemeku, and the newly submitted Choros taiji Galecan Dorji, Khoshut taiji Shakdur Manji, and Khoit taiji Bayar among the first audience contingent.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi placed Cheren Ubashi, Nemeku, and the newly submitted Choros taiji Galecan Dorji, Khoshut taiji Shakdur Manji, and Khoit taiji Bayar in the first audience contingent.

sentences.zh: 駕幸木蘭，車凌等至，召覲行幄慰諭之。

translations.literal: The emperor proceeded to Mulan; Cheren and the others arrived and were summoned to audience at the traveling lodge and comforted with an edict.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to Mulan; when Cheren and his party arrived they were received at the traveling lodge and comforted with an edict.

sentences.zh: 旋蹕避暑山莊，禦淡泊敬誠殿受朝，詔以車凌為杜爾伯特汗，諸扎薩克隸之。

translations.literal: Soon he returned to halt at the Mountain Villa, received homage in the Hall of Plainness, Sincerity, and Respect, and issued an edict making Cheren Khan of the Dorbod, with all zasaks subordinate to him.
translations.idiomatic: He soon returned to the Mountain Villa, received homage in the Hall of Plainness, Sincerity, and Respect, and proclaimed Cheren Khan of the Dorbod with all zasaks under him.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克而下，設管旗章京、副管旗章京、參領、佐領、驍騎校等職。

translations.literal: Below the zasaks were established the offices of banner-managing clerk, assistant banner clerk, company commander, assistant commandant, and vanguard captain.
translations.idiomatic: Below the zasaks were established banner-managing clerks, assistant banner clerks, company commanders, assistant commandants, and vanguard captains.

sentences.zh: 時阿睦爾撒納覬轄四衛拉特，知不可得，叛竄。

translations.literal: At this time Amursana coveted rule over all four Oirat confederations; knowing it unattainable, he rebelled and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana then coveted rule over all four Oirat confederations; finding it impossible, he rebelled and fled.

sentences.zh: 班珠爾以附逆，械至。

translations.literal: Bandidor, for joining the rebel, was brought in irons.
translations.idiomatic: Bandidor, for joining the rebellion, was brought to court in irons.

sentences.zh: 噶勒藏多爾濟、沙克都爾曼濟、巴雅爾仍各賜汗爵，統所部眾。

translations.literal: Galecan Dorji, Shakdur Manji, and Bayar were still each granted khan rank to rule their followers.
translations.idiomatic: Galecan Dorji, Shakdur Manji, and Bayar were still each granted khan rank to rule their followers.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「準噶爾互相殘殺，群遭塗炭，不獲安生。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Zungar have slaughtered one another; the masses have suffered ruin and cannot live in peace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "The Zungar have slaughtered one another; the people have suffered ruin and cannot live in peace.

sentences.zh: 朕統一寰區，不忍坐視，特發兩路大兵進討。

translations.literal: We have unified the realm and could not sit by; We specially dispatched great armies on two routes to advance and chastise them.
translations.idiomatic: I have unified the realm and could not sit by; I specially sent great armies on two routes to chastise them.

sentences.zh: 諸台吉、宰桑等畏威懷德，率屬來歸，從軍自效。

translations.literal: The taijis, zaisang, and others feared Our might and cherished Our virtue, leading their dependents to submit and serving in the armies to prove their worth.
translations.idiomatic: The taijis and zaisang feared my might and cherished my virtue, leading their followers to submit and serving in the armies to prove their loyalty.

sentences.zh: 今已平定伊犁，擒獲達瓦齊，是用廣沛仁恩，酬庸效績。

translations.literal: Now Ili has been pacified and Dawachi captured; thus extensive grace is spread to reward meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: Now Ili has been pacified and Dawachi captured; therefore I spread generous grace to reward meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾舊有四衛拉特汗，令即仍其部落，樹之君長，其各董率所屬，務勤養教，共圖生聚，受朕無疆之福。」

translations.literal: The Zungar formerly had four Oirat khans; they are now to remain on their tribes, given leaders; each is to lead his followers, diligently nurture and teach them, jointly seek growth and settlement, and receive Our boundless blessings."
translations.idiomatic: The Zungar once had four Oirat khans; let them remain on their tribes with leaders appointed; let each lead his followers, diligently nurture and teach them, seek growth together, and receive my boundless blessings."

sentences.zh: 其後綽羅斯汗噶勒藏多爾濟叛，從子扎納噶爾布戮之，所部就滅。

translations.literal: Thereafter the Choros Khan Galecan Dorji rebelled; his nephew Zanagarbu killed him and his tribe was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Choros Khan Galecan Dorji rebelled; his nephew Zanagarbu killed him and his tribe was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 輝特汗巴雅爾以叛為大軍所擒誅。

translations.literal: The Khoit Khan Bayar, for rebellion, was captured and executed by the main army.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoit Khan Bayar was captured and executed by the main army for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 和碩特汗沙克都爾曼濟懷貳志，副都統雅爾哈善殲其眾於巴里坤。

translations.literal: The Khoshut Khan Shakdur Manji harbored disloyal intent; Vice Commander Yarghasan annihilated his followers at Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshut Khan Shakdur Manji harbored disloyal intent; Vice Commander Yarghasan annihilated his followers at Barkul.

sentences.zh: 惟杜爾伯特部恪守臣節，世受封爵罔替。

translations.literal: Only the Dorbod tribe steadfastly kept ministerial duty and received enfeoffments generation after generation without interruption.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Dorbod tribe steadfastly kept their loyalty and received enfeoffments generation after generation without interruption.

sentences.zh: 是年十二月，車凌等以乏牧產，請徙額克阿喇勒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year Cheren and the others, lacking pastoral resources, asked to move to Eke Aral.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of that year Cheren and his party, short of pasture and livestock, asked to move to Eke Aral.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「前議平定伊犁後遣歸舊牧額爾齊斯，若額克阿喇勒，距額爾齊斯較扎克、拜達里克路更邇，且附內汛外，調所部兵亦易。

translations.literal: An edict said: "It was earlier agreed that after pacifying Ili they would return to their old pastures on the Irtysh; Eke Aral is closer to the Irtysh than the route from Zakh and Baydakh, lies just outside the inner posts, and troops of their tribe can be mobilized easily.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "It was agreed that after pacifying Ili they would return to their old pastures on the Irtysh; Eke Aral is closer to the Irtysh than the route from Zakh and Baydakh, lies just outside the inner posts, and their troops can be mobilized easily.

sentences.zh: 俟擒獲阿逆後，仍當遣歸舊牧。

translations.literal: When the rebel chief is captured they will still be sent back to their old pastures.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebel chief is captured they will still be sent back to their old pastures.

sentences.zh: 所部生計既艱，其給籽種六百石，務令及時耕種，毋誤農期。

translations.literal: Their livelihood being strained, six hundred piculs of seed are granted; they must be made to plant in season and not miss the farming term.
translations.idiomatic: Their livelihood being strained, six hundred piculs of seed were granted; they were to plant in season and not miss the farming term.

sentences.zh: 至從軍所給駝馬，自應交納。

translations.literal: As for the camels and horses given for the campaign, they should naturally be turned in.
translations.idiomatic: As for the camels and horses given for the campaign, they should naturally be returned.

sentences.zh: 但念往返道遠，牲畜不無疲瘠，可姑緩期二載。」

translations.literal: But considering the long round trip and inevitable exhaustion of livestock, payment may be deferred two years."
translations.idiomatic: But considering the long journey and inevitable exhaustion of the animals, payment may be deferred two years."

sentences.zh: 訥默庫之將從征達瓦齊也，請徙牧拜達里克北扎布堪河源博囉喀博齊爾至鄂爾海、喀喇烏蘇界，允之，諭努力成功，勿念游牧眾。

translations.literal: When Nemeku was about to join the campaign against Dawachi, he asked to move his pastures from north of Baydakh at the Zhabkan headwaters at Borok Boqir to the border of Erhai and Kara Usu; this was granted, with an edict to strive for success and not fret over the herding multitude.
translations.idiomatic: When Nemeku was about to join the campaign against Dawachi, he asked to move his pastures from north of Baydakh at the Zhabkan headwaters at Borok Boqir to the border of Erhai and Kara Usu; this was granted, with an edict to strive for success and not fret over his herds.

sentences.zh: 至是以車凌等將徙牧，詔往會。

translations.literal: Now that Cheren and the others were about to move pastures, an edict ordered Nemeku to go join them.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Cheren and his party were about to move pastures, Nemeku was ordered to join them.

sentences.zh: 而訥默庫隱有叛志，謀竄就阿睦爾撒納。

translations.literal: But Nemeku secretly harbored rebellious intent and plotted to flee to Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: But Nemeku secretly harbored rebellious intent and plotted to flee to Amursana.

sentences.zh: 剛多爾濟、巴圖博羅特、布顏特古斯等阻之，卒不戢，率眾复乘間劫驛騎，戕守汛弁，奪運糧商民駝物及貲。

translations.literal: Dundorji, Batu Borot, Buyantu Gus, and others tried to stop him; he would not desist; he again led his followers to seize a chance, raid relay riders, kill the garrison officer, and seize camels, goods, and valuables of grain-transport merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Dundorji, Batu Borot, Buyantu Gus, and others tried to stop him; he would not desist; he again led his followers to raid relay riders, kill the garrison officer, and seize camels, goods, and valuables from grain-transport merchants.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春，駐防烏里雅蘇台辦事大臣阿蘭泰偕車凌、車凌烏巴什等以兵擒訥默庫及其孥，械至，論如律。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-first year the Uliastai Resident Minister Alantai together with Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, and others seized Nemeku and his family by force, brought them in irons, and sentenced them according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-first year the Uliastai Resident Minister Alantai, together with Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, and others, captured Nemeku and his family by force, brought them in irons, and sentenced them according to law.

sentences.zh: 詔不附逆諸扎薩克各安游牧，勿疑懼。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the zasaks who had not joined the rebellion each to pasture in peace and not to doubt or fear.
translations.idiomatic: The zasaks who had not joined the rebellion were ordered to pasture in peace and not to fear.

sentences.zh: 复諭曰：「剛多爾濟等屬妄行劫掠，應交部議扎薩克罪。

translations.literal: An edict further said: "The followers of Dundorji and others who rashly plundered should be referred to the ministry to discuss zasak guilt.
translations.idiomatic: An edict further said: "The followers of Dundorji and others who rashly plundered should be referred to the ministry to discuss zasak guilt.

sentences.zh: 但念伊等新降，未諳內地禁例，姑從寬免。」

translations.literal: But considering they have newly submitted and do not yet know inner prohibitions, they are for the time being pardoned with leniency."
translations.idiomatic: But considering they had newly submitted and did not yet know inner prohibitions, they were for the time being pardoned with leniency."

sentences.zh: 夏，以所部鄰扎哈沁，盜不戢，諭曰：「伊等生計全賴牧畜，若復盜竊相仍，不獲蕃孳，生計焉能充裕？

translations.literal: In summer, because their tribe neighbored the Zhakhachin and theft was unchecked, an edict said: "Their livelihood depends entirely on herd animals; if theft continues, herds cannot multiply—how can their livelihood be ample?
translations.idiomatic: In summer, because their tribe neighbored the Zhakhachin and theft was unchecked, an edict said: "Your livelihood depends entirely on herd animals; if theft continues, herds cannot multiply—how can your livelihood be ample?

sentences.zh: 其各鈐束部眾，務期守分安生，副朕休養群生至意。」

translations.literal: Each of you is to restrain your followers and strive to keep to your bounds and live in peace, in accord with Our supreme intent to rest and nourish all living beings."
translations.idiomatic: Each of you must restrain your followers, keep to your bounds, and live in peace, in keeping with my intent to let all living beings rest and thrive."

sentences.zh: 有伯什阿噶什者，伊什扎布之曾孫也，祖扎勒，父車凌多爾濟。

translations.literal: There was one Bosh Aghashi, a great-grandson of Ishjab; his grandfather was Zale, his father Cheren Dorji.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Bosh Aghashi, great-grandson of Ishjab; his grandfather was Zale and his father Cheren Dorji.

sentences.zh: 伯什阿噶什兄曰布達扎卜、曰達瓦克什克，弟曰達瓦濟特、曰格咱巴克，聚牧伊犁河西沙拉伯勒，境鄰哈薩克牧。

translations.literal: Bosh Aghashi's elder brothers were Budajab and Dawakashik; his younger brothers were Dawajit and Gezanbak; they gathered to pasture west of the Ili River at Shalabole, their lands bordering Kazakh pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Bosh Aghashi's elder brothers were Budajab and Dawakashik; his younger brothers were Dawajit and Gezanbak. They herded together west of the Ili at Shalabole, on ground bordering Kazakh pastures.

sentences.zh: 達瓦齊虐其眾，伯什阿噶什將棄之，懼襲而寢。

translations.literal: Dawachi abused his followers; Bosh Aghashi was about to abandon him but, fearing attack, desisted.
translations.idiomatic: Dawachi abused his people; Bosh Aghashi meant to leave him but, fearing reprisal, held back.

sentences.zh: 大軍徵達瓦齊，抵伊犁，班第遣使招，因獻籍三千餘戶降。

translations.literal: The main army campaigned against Dawachi and reached Ili; Bandi sent envoys to summon him, and he thereupon submitted a register of more than three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army marched against Dawachi and reached Ili, Bandi sent envoys to win him over; he submitted a register of more than three thousand households and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 將遣從車凌等入覲，告哈薩克數掠所部，請歸視。

translations.literal: He was about to be sent with Cheren and the others to audience at court; he reported that the Kazakhs had repeatedly raided his tribe and asked to return and oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: He was to accompany Cheren and the others to court, but reported repeated Kazakh raids on his people and asked leave to return and oversee his pastures.

sentences.zh: 比抵牧，偵哈薩克集兵，遣告，且請大軍援，諭嘉其恭順。

translations.literal: When he reached his pastures he detected the Kazakhs gathering troops; he sent word and also requested aid from the main army; an edict praised his deference.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching his pastures he found the Kazakhs massing troops, sent word, and asked for imperial troops; the court praised his dutiful conduct.

sentences.zh: 會阿睦爾撒納叛，逆黨擾伊犁，遣和碩特輔國公納噶察齎敕往諭曰：「準噶爾內亂頻仍，各部人眾咸失生業。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Amursana rebelled and rebel bands harassed Ili; the Khoshut Auxiliary State Duke Nagacha was sent bearing an imperial letter to proclaim: "The Zungar have suffered frequent internal strife; the people of every tribe have lost their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Amursana rebelled and rebel bands harassed Ili; the Khoshut Auxiliary State Duke Nagacha was sent with an imperial letter proclaiming: "The Zungar have suffered constant civil war; the people of every tribe have lost their livelihood.

sentences.zh: 朕為一統天下之君，懷保群生，無分中外，特發大軍往定伊犁。

translations.literal: We are the monarch who has unified all under Heaven, cherishing and protecting all living beings without distinction between inner and outer; We have specially dispatched a great army to pacify Ili.
translations.idiomatic: I am the sovereign who has unified all under Heaven, cherishing all living beings without distinction between inner and outer realms; I have sent a great army to pacify Ili.

sentences.zh: 方欲施恩立制，永安反側，乃逆賊潛懷叛志，妄思併吞諸部，肆其荼虐，罪狀已著，畏誅潛遁。

translations.literal: Just as We were about to bestow grace and establish institutions to secure the restless forever, the rebel secretly harbored treason, vainly scheming to swallow all the tribes and wantonly inflicting cruelty; his crimes are already manifest, and fearing punishment he has fled in secret.
translations.idiomatic: Just as I was about to bestow grace and establish rule to secure the frontier forever, the rebel secretly plotted treason, vainly seeking to swallow all the tribes and wantonly inflicting cruelty; his crimes are plain, and fearing punishment he has fled.

sentences.zh: 朕已命將窮追，務期弋獲。

translations.literal: We have already ordered Our generals to pursue to the end and must capture him by hunt.
translations.idiomatic: I have ordered my generals to pursue him relentlessly until he is taken.

sentences.zh: 逆賊一日不獲，諸部一日不安。

translations.literal: For each day the rebel is not captured, the tribes are unsettled one more day.
translations.idiomatic: Until the rebel is captured, the tribes cannot rest secure for a single day.

sentences.zh: 爾台吉輸誠歸命，果能仰體朕旨，去逆效順，或以兵協剿阿逆，或俟至爾牧擒獻之，朕必大沛殊恩。

translations.literal: You taijis have submitted in sincerity; if you can truly embody Our intent, cast off rebellion and serve loyally—whether by troops jointly chastising the Amursana rebel or by waiting until he reaches your pastures to seize and present him—We shall greatly bestow special grace.
translations.idiomatic: You taijis have submitted in good faith; if you truly heed my will, renounce rebellion, and serve loyally—whether by joining the hunt for Amursana or by seizing him when he reaches your pastures and presenting him to me—I shall reward you with exceptional favor.

sentences.zh: 爾其奮勉自效！」

translations.literal: You must exert yourselves and prove your merit!"
translations.idiomatic: Exert yourselves and prove your loyalty!"

sentences.zh: 達瓦齊復奏伯什阿噶什及庫木諾顏、台吉諾爾布必無異志，命遺之書，未達，而伯什阿噶什徙牧。

translations.literal: Dawachi again memorialized that Bosh Aghashi, Kumu Noyan, and the taiji Norbu certainly harbored no divergent intent; he was ordered to send them letters, but they did not arrive, and Bosh Aghashi moved his pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Dawachi again reported that Bosh Aghashi, Kumu Noyan, and the taiji Norbu surely had no treacherous intent; letters were sent to them but never delivered, and Bosh Aghashi had already moved his herds.

sentences.zh: 初傳偕諾爾佈內附，久之不至，或以居博囉塔拉告。

translations.literal: At first it was reported that Norbu would submit together with him; after a long while he did not arrive, and some reported that he dwelt at Borotara.
translations.idiomatic: At first Norbu was said to be submitting with him; when he failed to appear for a long time, some reported that he was living at Borotara.

sentences.zh: 詔將軍策楞等偵之，無其踪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General Celeng and others to search for him; no trace was found.
translations.idiomatic: General Celeng and others were ordered to search for him, but no trace was found.

sentences.zh: 時阿睦爾撒納敗竄，諭參贊大臣侍郎玉保等偵阿逆赴伯什阿噶什牧，即諭擒獻，或故縱，以兵剿之。

translations.literal: At that time Amursana was defeated and fled; the Participating Minister Vice Minister Yubao and others were instructed to watch whether the rebel Amursana went to Bosh Aghashi's pastures; they were then to order his capture and presentation, or deliberately release him and destroy him with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana had been defeated and was fleeing; the Participating Minister Yubao and others were told to watch whether the rebel headed for Bosh Aghashi's pastures and, if so, to seize and deliver him—or to let him pass deliberately and then destroy him by force.

sentences.zh: 伯什阿噶什養子博東齊尋偕宰桑諾斯海挈眾至，以哈薩克侵牧告。

translations.literal: Bosh Aghashi's adopted son Bodongqi soon arrived with the zaisang Noshai leading his followers, reporting Kazakh invasion of their pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Bosh Aghashi's adopted son Bodongqi soon arrived with the zaisang Noshai and their people, reporting that the Kazakhs had invaded their pastures.

sentences.zh: 宰桑賽音伯勒克，得木齊恩克、濟爾哈爾等踵至，告哈薩克追掠，間走乃免。

translations.literal: The zaisang Sayin Bolik, Demuqienke, Jirhar, and others followed in turn, reporting Kazakh pursuit and plunder; they escaped only by scattering in flight.
translations.idiomatic: The zaisang Sayin Bolik, Demuqienke, Jirhar, and others followed in turn, reporting Kazakh pursuit and plunder; they escaped only by scattering in flight.

sentences.zh: 詔博東齊以兵迎其父，暫置從眾於額爾齊斯，諾斯海護視之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Bodongqi to take troops to welcome his father; his followers were temporarily placed on the Irtysh under Noshai's guard.
translations.idiomatic: Bodongqi was ordered to take troops and welcome his father; his followers were temporarily settled on the Irtysh under Noshai's care.

sentences.zh: 賽音伯勒克或從博東齊往，或留牧額爾齊斯，惟其便。

translations.literal: Sayin Bolik might go with Bodongqi or remain herding on the Irtysh, as he found convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Sayin Bolik might go with Bodongqi or remain herding on the Irtysh, as he preferred.

sentences.zh: 博東齊將行，伯什阿噶什攜戶八百餘抵額爾齊斯，請內附。

translations.literal: As Bodongqi was about to depart, Bosh Aghashi brought more than eight hundred households to the Irtysh and requested submission to the inner realm.
translations.idiomatic: As Bodongqi was about to set out, Bosh Aghashi arrived on the Irtysh with more than eight hundred households and asked to submit.

sentences.zh: 烏巴什其族台吉也，從至。

translations.literal: Ubashi was a taiji of his clan and followed him there.
translations.idiomatic: Ubashi, a taiji of his clan, accompanied him.

sentences.zh: 詔封伯什阿噶什為扎薩克和碩親王，烏巴什為扎薩克固山貝子，賜諭曰：「爾誠心感戴，率眾投誠。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed Bosh Aghashi as zasak Khoshut Prince and Ubashi as zasak banner beizi, granting an address that said: "You sincerely cherish Our grace and have led your multitude to submit in good faith.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enfeoffed Bosh Aghashi as zasak Khoshut Prince and Ubashi as zasak banner beizi, with this message: "You have sincerely embraced my grace and led your people to submit.

sentences.zh: 前大軍抵伊犁，即謁將軍大臣，甫欲加恩封賞，旋遇阿逆背叛，未獲舉行。

translations.literal: When the main army earlier reached Ili you at once paid court to the general and ministers; We were just about to add grace and enfeoffment and reward, but then met the Amursana rebel's betrayal and could not carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army first reached Ili you came at once to the general and ministers; I was about to reward you with titles and gifts, but Amursana's rebellion intervened and it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 爾為哈薩克所掠，輾轉遷徙，始克內附。

translations.literal: You were plundered by the Kazakhs and shifted from place to place before you could at last submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: You were harried by the Kazakhs and driven from pasture to pasture before you could at last submit.

sentences.zh: 爾眾甫至，不必簡兵往從大軍，亦無須徙內地，即游牧額爾齊斯所。

translations.literal: Your multitude has only just arrived; you need not select troops to follow the main army, nor need you move to the inner provinces—pasture directly on the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: Your people have only just arrived; you need not furnish troops for the campaign, nor move inland—remain and pasture on the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 爾族台吉車凌等將歸舊牧，爾等聚族而處，實為允協，不必遠離故土，徒勞往返也。」
