translations.literal: Your clan taiji Cheren and the others will return to their old pastures; for you to dwell gathered as a clan is truly fitting—you need not leave your native soil far behind and toil back and forth in vain."
translations.idiomatic: Your clan taiji Cheren and the others will return to their old pastures; for you to settle together as a clan is altogether fitting—there is no need to leave your homeland far behind and wear yourselves out traveling back and forth."

sentences.zh: 命甫下，伯什阿噶什等攜眾抵哈達青吉勒，詔暫留，俟明歲歸額爾齊斯牧。

translations.literal: The order had only just been issued when Bosh Aghashi and the others brought their multitude to Hadaqingjile; an edict told them to stay temporarily and return to Irtysh pastures the following year.
translations.idiomatic: The order had scarcely been issued when Bosh Aghashi and his people reached Hadaqingjile; they were told to remain there for the time being and return to the Irtysh pastures the following year.

sentences.zh: 七月，車凌、車凌烏巴什、剛多爾濟等以徙牧額爾齊斯，請定入覲年班。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, Dundorji, and the others, having moved their pastures to the Irtysh, asked that the annual shifts for court audience be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Cheren, Cheren Ubashi, Dundorji, and the others, having moved to the Irtysh, asked that their turns for the annual court audience be set.

sentences.zh: 諭嘉其誠悃，詔自來年始，定三班，前給從軍駝馬，姑緩期納，示卹。

translations.literal: An edict praised their sincerity; from the coming year three shifts were fixed; camels and horses previously given for the campaign might for the time being be paid on a deferred schedule, showing compassion.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised their sincerity and fixed three annual shifts from the following year; payment for camels and horses furnished for the campaign was deferred, as a mark of compassion.

sentences.zh: 九月，伯什阿噶什來朝，弟達瓦濟特及兄子丹巴、都噶爾、布魯特扣肯以視牧故，各遣宰桑代至。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Bosh Aghashi came to court; his younger brother Dawajit and his elder brothers Danba, Dugar, and the Burut Kokon, for reasons of overseeing pastures, each sent a zaisang in his place.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Bosh Aghashi came to court; his younger brother Dawajit and his elder brothers Danba, Dugar, and the Burut Kokon, who had to oversee the herds, each sent a zaisang in his stead.

sentences.zh: 賜宴，賚馬七百、牛百五十、羊三千，詔編旗分佐領，如三車凌及剛多爾濟等來歸例。

translations.literal: A banquet was granted and seven hundred horses, one hundred fifty cattle, and three thousand sheep bestowed; an edict ordered banners organized and company commanders assigned, following the precedent of the three Cheren and Dundorji and others on their submission.
translations.idiomatic: He was feasted and given seven hundred horses, one hundred fifty cattle, and three thousand sheep; banners and company commanders were organized for him on the same model as the three Cheren, Dundorji, and the others when they submitted.

sentences.zh: 別為一盟，以伯什阿噶什為盟長，烏巴什副之，丹巴都噶爾授協理台吉。

translations.literal: They were separately made into one league; Bosh Aghashi was league chief and Ubashi his deputy; Danba Dugar was granted assistant managing taiji.
translations.idiomatic: They were formed into a separate league with Bosh Aghashi as chief and Ubashi as deputy; Danba Dugar was made assistant managing taiji.

sentences.zh: 伯什阿噶什甫歸牧，其妻卒，遣侍衛佛保往醊。

translations.literal: Bosh Aghashi had only just returned to his pastures when his wife died; the Bodyguard Fubao was dispatched to offer libation.
translations.idiomatic: Bosh Aghashi had only just returned to his pastures when his wife died; the bodyguard Fubao was sent to perform the funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 伯什阿噶什尋卒，無子，詔副都統唐喀祿賻祭，宣諭以丹巴都噶爾為扎薩克固山貝子，以達瓦濟特為扎薩克公，轄伯什阿噶什眾，聽歸車凌牧及內徙。

translations.literal: Bosh Aghashi soon died without a son; an edict ordered Vice Commander Tangkalu to present compensatory sacrifice and proclaimed Danba Dugar zasak banner beizi and Dawajit zasak duke to rule Bosh Aghashi's multitude, permitting them to return to Cheren's pastures and to migrate inward.
translations.idiomatic: Bosh Aghashi soon died childless; Vice Commander Tangkalu was sent with compensatory offerings, and Danba Dugar was proclaimed zasak banner beizi and Dawajit zasak duke to govern Bosh Aghashi's people, who were allowed to join Cheren's pastures or move inland.

sentences.zh: 而丹巴都噶爾與佐領色布騰互攘畜產，佛保將至牧，駝馬為所掠。

translations.literal: But Danba Dugar and the company commander Sebeten seized one another's livestock; as Fubao was about to reach the pastures, camels and horses were plundered by them.
translations.idiomatic: Danba Dugar and the company commander Sebeten, however, fought over livestock, and as Fubao was nearing the pastures they plundered his camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 詔撤恩命還，复諭烏巴什勿驚懼，俟事定歸車凌牧。

translations.literal: An edict revoked the grace appointments and recalled them; Ubashi was again told not to fear, and that when matters were settled he might return to Cheren's pastures.
translations.idiomatic: The enfeoffments were revoked; Ubashi was told not to fear and to return to Cheren's pastures once the matter was settled.

sentences.zh: 後烏巴什卒，停襲。

translations.literal: Later Ubashi died and succession was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Ubashi later died, and his title was not inherited.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，車凌以哈薩克不擒獻阿逆，諸厄魯特叛擾邊，請由額爾齊斯徙牧烏蘭固木避之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Cheren, because the Kazakhs had not captured and presented the rebel and various Oirat rebels were harassing the border, asked to move his pastures from the Irtysh to Ulan Gumu to avoid them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Cheren, because the Kazakhs had failed to seize and deliver the rebel and Oirat rebels were raiding the frontier, asked to move from the Irtysh to Ulan Gumu for safety.

sentences.zh: 時喀爾喀貝子車布登扎布遵旨遣兵剿掠佛保賊，收伯什阿噶什屬戶給喀爾喀，將遣博東齊歸車凌牧，族台吉布圖庫、班珠爾、布林等挈屬至，稱與車凌等析處久，請異牧，允之。

translations.literal: At that time the Khalkha beizi Chebudenjab, obeying the edict, dispatched troops to chastise Fubao's plunderers and took Bosh Aghashi's dependent households and assigned them to the Khalkha; Bodongqi was to be sent back to Cheren's pastures; the clan taijis Butuku, Banzuer, and Bulin and others brought their dependents and said they had long lived apart from Cheren and the others and asked for separate pastures—this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Khalkha beizi Chebudenjab, as ordered, sent troops against Fubao's raiders, took Bosh Aghashi's dependents into Khalkha custody, and was to return Bodongqi to Cheren's pastures; the clan taijis Butuku, Banzuer, Bulin, and others arrived with their people, saying they had long lived apart from Cheren's band and asked for separate pastures, which was granted.

sentences.zh: 布圖庫等抵汛，聞佛保自哈達青吉勒歸，和碩特台吉桑濟复掠諸道，遣從卒馳馬迎。

translations.literal: Butuku and the others reached the post; hearing that Fubao was returning from Hadaqingjile and that the Khoshut taiji Sangji was again plundering along the routes, they sent attendants spurring horses to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Butuku and his party reached the frontier post; learning that Fubao was returning from Hadaqingjile and that the Khoshut taiji Sangji was again raiding the roads, they sent riders ahead to meet him.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，諭曰：「車凌等自歸誠以來，感激朕恩，約束屬眾，甚為寧謐。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of it, an edict said: "Since Cheren and the others submitted in sincerity they have cherished Our grace and restrained their followers; the region has been very tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this, the emperor said: "Since Cheren and his people submitted they have been grateful for my grace and kept their followers in order; the region has been remarkably peaceful.

sentences.zh: 邇因叛賊紛起，亟請內徙游牧，其歸附之心益堅，可允所請，並給穀種，令為謀生資。

translations.literal: Recently, because rebels have risen in numbers, they urgently ask to migrate inward and pasture; their heart of submission is all the firmer—what they request may be granted, and grain seed given them as capital for making a livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Now, with rebels rising everywhere, they urgently ask to move inward to pasture; their loyalty is all the stronger. Grant their request and give them seed grain to live on.

sentences.zh: 博東齊雖與杜爾伯特同族，若往歸之，反仰賴車凌等養贍，著遣往烏里雅蘇台，交車布登扎布，酌徙呼倫貝爾、通肯呼裕爾等處。

translations.literal: Although Bodongqi is of the same tribe as the Dorbod, if he returns to them he would in turn rely on Cheren and the others for support; he is to be sent to Uliastai and handed to Chebudenjab to consider moving him to Hulun Buir, Tongken Huyur, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Although Bodongqi is kin to the Dorbod, if he rejoined them he would only burden Cheren's people; send him to Uliastai to Chebudenjab and settle him in Hulun Buir, Tongken Huyur, or the like.

sentences.zh: 布圖庫、班珠爾等迎接侍衛佛保，俟至烏里雅蘇台軍所，各給幣賞之。」

translations.literal: Butuku, Banzuer, and the others welcomed the bodyguard Fubao; when they reached the Uliastai army headquarters each was to be given gifts in reward."
translations.idiomatic: Butuku, Banzuer, and the others who escorted the bodyguard Fubao are each to be rewarded when they reach the Uliastai headquarters."

sentences.zh: 後博東齊及布圖庫等咸置呼倫貝爾。

translations.literal: Later Bodongqi and Butuku and the others were all settled in Hulun Buir.
translations.idiomatic: Bodongqi, Butuku, and the others were later all settled in Hulun Buir.

sentences.zh: 布圖庫、班珠爾以內附誠，各授二等台吉。

translations.literal: Butuku and Banzuer, for the sincerity of their inward submission, were each granted second-rank taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Butuku and Banzuer were each made second-rank taiji for their faithful submission.

sentences.zh: 而貝勒巴圖博羅特、輔國公舍棱不從車凌等徙牧，叛應阿睦爾撒納，副都統瑚爾起以兵擒諸輝巴朗山，妻拏悉論誅。

translations.literal: But the beile Batu Borot and the Auxiliary State Duke Seleng did not follow Cheren and the others in moving pastures; they rebelled in support of Amursana; Vice Commander Hurqi seized them by force at Huibaolang Mountain, and wives and children were all sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: The beile Batu Borot and the Auxiliary State Duke Seleng, however, refused to move with Cheren; they rebelled in support of Amursana. Vice Commander Hurqi captured them at Huibaolang Mountain, and their wives and children were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 先是杜爾伯特及烏梁海未內屬，錯牧額爾齊斯。

translations.literal: Earlier, before the Dorbod and the Uriankhai had submitted inward, they pastured together on the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, before the Dorbod and Uriankhai had submitted, both tribes grazed on the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 後杜爾伯特諸台吉至，游牧扎克拜達里克，初徙牧額克阿喇勒，再徙額爾齊斯。

translations.literal: Later, when the Dorbod taijis arrived, they pastured at Zakh Baydakh; they first moved their pastures to Eke Aral, then again to the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: When the Dorbod taijis arrived they grazed at Zakh Baydakh, then moved first to Eke Aral and later to the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 烏梁海就撫，以烏蘭固木地給之。

translations.literal: The Uriankhai accepted pacification and were given the Ulan Gumu lands.
translations.idiomatic: The Uriankhai submitted and were given the Ulan Gumu region.

sentences.zh: 車凌等復請由額爾齊斯往徙，遣都統納穆扎爾往勘杜爾伯特及烏梁海牧界。

translations.literal: Cheren and the others again asked to move from the Irtysh; Commandant Namuzhar was dispatched to survey the pasture boundaries of the Dorbod and the Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren and his people again asked to move from the Irtysh; Commandant Namuzhar was sent to survey the Dorbod and Uriankhai pasture boundaries.

sentences.zh: 車凌復請以烏蘭固木為屯耕地，而游牧於科布多、額克阿喇勒，允之，詔嚴禁所屬勿攘竊。

translations.literal: Cheren again asked that Ulan Gumu be made garrison-farmland while he pastured at Kobdo and Eke Aral; this was granted, and an edict strictly forbade his followers to seize one another's property.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren asked to farm Ulan Gumu while grazing at Kobdo and Eke Aral; this was granted, with strict orders that his people must not plunder one another.

sentences.zh: 尋以錯牧不便，定烏蘭固木為杜爾伯特牧，別以科布多為烏梁海牧。

translations.literal: Soon, because mixed pasturing was inconvenient, Ulan Gumu was fixed as Dorbod pasture and Kobdo separately as Uriankhai pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Mixed grazing soon proved awkward; Ulan Gumu was assigned to the Dorbod and Kobdo to the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，烏梁海以科布多產貂不給捕，請徙就阿勒台陽額爾齊斯。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the Uriankhai, because sable at Kobdo did not suffice for hunting, asked to move to the sunny Irtysh side of the Altai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the Uriankhai, finding Kobdo's sable insufficient, asked to move to the sunny Irtysh slopes of the Altai.

sentences.zh: 諭車凌烏巴什等曰：「額爾齊斯為爾舊牧，今爾移處烏蘭固木，烏梁海察達克請游牧額爾齊斯地，向曾降旨，爾等若原歸舊牧，聽爾便。

translations.literal: Cheren Ubashi and the others were instructed: "The Irtysh was your old pasture; now you have moved to Ulan Gumu. The Uriankhai Tsadak has asked to pasture on Irtysh lands; We once issued an edict that if you wished to return to your old pastures, you might do as you pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren Ubashi and the others were told: "The Irtysh was your old pasture; you now live at Ulan Gumu. The Uriankhai leader Tsadak has asked to graze on the Irtysh; I once said that if you wished to return to your old pastures, you might do so.

sentences.zh: 今哈薩克已全部內附，伊犁厄魯特賊眾复殲無孑遺。

translations.literal: Now the Kazakhs have all submitted inward, and the Oirat rebel bands of Ili have again been annihilated without a survivor.
translations.idiomatic: The Kazakhs have now all submitted, and the Oirat rebels of Ili have been wiped out to the last man.

sentences.zh: 若爾果原歸舊牧，可即徙往額爾齊斯，所遺烏蘭固木，自可給烏梁海處之。

translations.literal: If you truly wish to return to your old pastures you may at once move to the Irtysh; the Ulan Gumu you leave can naturally be given the Uriankhai to settle.
translations.idiomatic: If you truly wish to return to the Irtysh, move there at once; the Ulan Gumu you leave can be given to the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 但哈薩克新附，非爾等久為內屬者比，務宜嚴飭所屬安靜無事。

translations.literal: But the Kazakhs have newly submitted and are not to be compared with you who have long been inner subjects; you must strictly restrain your followers to keep quiet and cause no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The Kazakhs have only lately submitted and are not like you long-established subjects; strictly restrain your people and keep the peace.

sentences.zh: 若爾部眾既遵鈐束，而哈薩克反來肆擾，可即擒誅之。

translations.literal: If your tribesmen have already kept to restraint but the Kazakhs come instead to wantonly harass, you may at once seize and execute them.
translations.idiomatic: If your people keep order but the Kazakhs raid you anyway, seize and punish them at once.

sentences.zh: 爾等或安土重遷，則額爾齊斯地與其為哈薩克、俄羅斯所竊據，不若令烏梁海往徙之也。」

translations.literal: If you are attached to your soil and reluctant to move, then rather than let Irtysh lands be stealthily seized by Kazakhs and Russians, it would be better to have the Uriankhai move there."
translations.idiomatic: If you are loath to leave your home, it is better to let the Uriankhai take the Irtysh than to see those lands fall to Kazakhs or Russians."

sentences.zh: 車凌烏巴什等奏：「察達克所請地，系烏梁海舊牧，距臣等牧遠。

translations.literal: Cheren Ubashi and the others memorialized: "The lands Tsadak requests were the Uriankhai's old pastures and lie far from our pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Cheren Ubashi and the others replied: "The land Tsadak seeks was the Uriankhai's old pasture and lies far from ours.

sentences.zh: 且烏蘭固木地肥不磽，臣等游牧久，請勿徙，以額爾齊斯地給烏梁海。」

translations.literal: Moreover Ulan Gumu's soil is fertile and not barren; we have pastured there long—We ask not to move and that Irtysh lands be given the Uriankhai."
translations.idiomatic: Ulan Gumu is rich pasture where we have long grazed; we ask to remain and that the Irtysh be given to the Uriankhai instead."

sentences.zh: 詔如所請。

translations.literal: An edict granted their request.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 是年十月，以大軍定回部蕆功，諭車凌烏巴什等知之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year, because the main army had completed its pacification of the Muslim regions, Cheren Ubashi and the others were instructed to know of it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year the court announced to Cheren Ubashi and the others that the Muslim regions had been pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月，偵哈薩克襲烏梁海，以兵三百餘擊走，得旨獎賚。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they detected Kazakhs raiding the Uriankhai; with more than three hundred troops they drove them off and received an edict of reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they detected a Kazakh raid on the Uriankhai, routed it with some three hundred men, and were rewarded by imperial decree.

sentences.zh: 二十五年四月，以所部有溫圖呼爾者，貧不給，聞其弟居察哈爾牧，告諸扎薩克往就之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year, because one Ontuhur of their tribe was poor and could not support himself and had heard his brother pastured in Chakhar, the zasaks were told to let him go join him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year a tribesman named Ontuhur, unable to support himself, heard that his brother grazed in Chakhar; the zasaks were told to let him join him.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「杜爾伯特自歸誠以來，編設旗分佐領，原欲伊等各安生業。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since the Dorbod submitted in sincerity, banners have been organized and company commanders assigned, originally so that each might settle his livelihood in peace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Since the Dorbod submitted, banners and company commanders were organized so that each of you might live securely on his own livelihood.

sentences.zh: 若不善卹之，漸至析處，殊為可憫。

translations.literal: If they are not well cared for and gradually scatter apart, it is deeply pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: If they are not well cared for and gradually scatter, the sight is pitiable indeed.

sentences.zh: 其各加意撫綏，令守分謀生，勿至流離失所，副朕恫瘝一體之懷。」

translations.literal: Each of you is to give added care in soothing them, make them keep to their bounds and seek livelihood, and not come to wandering homeless—in accord with Our heart that grieves for them as one body."
translations.idiomatic: Each of you must care for them diligently, keep them within their bounds and earning a living, and not let them wander destitute, in keeping with my care for them as my own people."

sentences.zh: 七月，車凌烏巴什等扈蹕行圍，奏所部蒙恩安置，牧產漸饒，嗣請自備駝馬。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Cheren Ubashi and the others attended the imperial hunt escort and memorialized that their tribe, having received grace and settlement, was gradually growing rich in herds and thereafter asked to furnish their own camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Cheren Ubashi and the others attended the autumn hunt and reported that their people, settled by imperial grace, were growing prosperous and wished hereafter to supply their own camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其誠悃，不忍驟勞之，詔仍官給駝馬。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised their sincerity and could not bear suddenly to burden them; an edict still ordered camels and horses supplied by the state.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised their sincerity and would not burden them abruptly; camels and horses were still to be supplied by the state.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，詔左、右翼各設副將軍一，右翼用正黃旗纛，左翼用正白旗纛，以敕印軍符給之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year an edict ordered one deputy general set for each of the left and right wings; the right wing used the plain yellow banner standard, the left wing the plain white banner standard, and imperial seals and military tallies were given them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year a deputy general was appointed for each wing—the right with the plain yellow banner standard, the left with the plain white—and each was given an imperial seal and military tally.

sentences.zh: 所部旗十有六，爵如之：扎薩克特古斯庫魯克達賴汗一；

translations.literal: Their tribe had sixteen banners, with titles to match: one zasak Tegus Külük Dalai Khan;
translations.idiomatic: The tribe had sixteen banners and corresponding titles: one zasak Tegus Külük Dalai Khan;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克和碩親王一；

translations.literal: one zasak Khoshut Prince;
translations.idiomatic: one zasak Khoshut Prince;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅郡王一；

translations.literal: one zasak Doruo Prince of the Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: one zasak Doruo Prince of the Commandery;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅貝勒二；

translations.literal: two zasak Doruo beile;
translations.idiomatic: two zasak Doruo beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克固山貝子二；

translations.literal: two zasak banner beizi;
translations.idiomatic: two zasak banner beizi;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克鎮國公一，由貝子降襲；

translations.literal: one zasak defender duke of the state, inherited by descent from beizi;
translations.idiomatic: one zasak defender duke of the state, inherited by descent from beizi rank;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克輔國公二；

translations.literal: two zasak auxiliary dukes of the state;
translations.idiomatic: two zasak auxiliary dukes of the state;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉四；

translations.literal: four zasak first-rank taiji;
translations.idiomatic: four zasak first-rank taiji;

sentences.zh: 輝特扎薩克一等台吉二。

translations.literal: two Khoit zasak first-rank taiji.
translations.idiomatic: two Khoit zasak first-rank taiji.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，命烏里雅蘇台將軍巴圖查辦喀爾喀侵占杜爾伯特、扎哈沁等部界址。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year the Uliastai General Batu was ordered to investigate and settle Khalkha encroachments on the boundary lands of the Dorbod, Zhakhachin, and other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year General Batu of Uliastai was ordered to investigate Khalkha encroachments on Dorbod, Zhakhachin, and other tribal boundaries.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，修科布多眾安廟。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Daoguang reign the Zhong'an Temple at Kobdo was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang the Zhong'an Temple at Kobdo was repaired.

sentences.zh: 三月，科布多參贊大臣那彥寶奏定蒙民、商民貿易章程。

translations.literal: In the third month the Kobdo Participating Minister Nayenbao memorialized fixing regulations for trade between Mongols and merchant civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Kobdo Participating Minister Nayenbao submitted regulations governing trade between Mongols and Han merchants.

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特、扎哈沁、明阿特、額魯特均准給票與商民貿易。

translations.literal: The Dorbod, Zhakhachin, Mingat, and Elute were all permitted to issue passes for trade with merchant civilians.
translations.idiomatic: The Dorbod, Zhakhachin, Mingat, and Elute were all authorized to issue trade passes to merchants.

sentences.zh: 六年，回疆軍興，杜爾伯特汗、王、公、扎薩克等獻駝馬助軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the Muslim-region campaign began, the Dorbod khan, princes, dukes, zasaks, and others presented camels and horses to aid the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when war broke out in the Muslim regions, the Dorbod khan, princes, dukes, and zasaks presented camels and horses for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以杜爾伯特汗齊旺巴勒楚克等復輸駝助軍，上嘉賚之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, because the Dorbod Khan Qiwang Balechuke and others again furnished camels to aid the army, the Emperor praised and rewarded them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Dorbod Khan Qiwang Balechuke and others again furnished camels for the army, and the emperor rewarded them.

sentences.zh: 九年，杜爾伯特貝子奇默特多爾濟呈控科布多參贊大臣額勒錦需索馬匹，擾累各部。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Dorbod beizi Chimted Dorji presented a complaint that the Kobdo Participating Minister Elejin was demanding horses and harassing every tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Dorbod beizi Chimted Dorji complained that the Kobdo Participating Minister Elejin was extorting horses and harassing the tribes.

sentences.zh: 鞫實，罷之。

translations.literal: The facts were tried and verified; he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The charge was proved and Elejin was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十八年，是部以兵從烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣車林多爾濟驅逐闌入烏梁海之哈薩克。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year this tribe with troops followed the Uliastai Participating Minister Cheren Dorji in driving off Kazakhs who had intruded into Uriankhai lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the tribe joined Uliastai Participating Minister Cheren Dorji in driving Kazakhs out of Uriankhai territory.

sentences.zh: 十八年十二月，以烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣車林多爾濟奏科布多參贊大臣管理烏梁海八部落，地方遼闊，多興訟端，允增置幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eighteenth year, because the Uliastai Participating Minister Cheren Dorji memorialized that the Kobdo Participating Minister administered the Uriankhai's eight tribes over a vast region where lawsuits frequently arose, an additional assisting minister was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the eighteenth year Cheren Dorji of Uliastai reported that the Kobdo minister's jurisdiction over the eight Uriankhai tribes was too vast and litigation too frequent; an assistant minister was approved.

sentences.zh: 十九年，給是部官兵俸賞行裝銀。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year this tribe's officers and soldiers were given salary, reward, and traveling-expense silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year officers and soldiers of the tribe were granted pay, bonuses, and travel silver.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年二月，是部汗、王、公等捐助軍需，溫旨卻之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Xianfeng the tribe's khan, princes, dukes, and others contributed military supplies; a gracious edict declined them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of Xianfeng the khan, princes, and dukes offered military supplies; a gracious edict declined the gift.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，烏魯木齊等城回匪滋事，調是部兵援之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, when Muslim rebels made trouble in Ürümqi and other cities, this tribe's troops were mobilized to aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi, when Muslim rebels rose in Ürümqi and other cities, troops of the tribe were called up to assist.

sentences.zh: 尋以不得力，撤歸。

translations.literal: Soon, because they did not prove effective, they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: They soon proved ineffective and were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 八年，以杜爾伯特汗嗣絕，將軍麟興等奏：「左翼汗旗下舊管十佐領戶一千五百有奇，右翼親王旗下舊管十一佐領戶一千二百上下，右翼貝勒旗下舊管二佐領僅一百六十餘戶。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because the Dorbod khan's line had died out, General Linxing and others memorialized: "Under the left-wing khan's banner were formerly ten company commands with more than fifteen hundred households; under the right-wing prince's banner eleven company commands with about twelve hundred households; under the right-wing beile's banner only two company commands with a little more than one hundred sixty households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, with the Dorbod khan's line extinct, General Linxing reported: "The left-wing khan's banner once had ten companies and more than fifteen hundred households; the right-wing prince's banner had eleven companies and about twelve hundred households; the right-wing beile's banner had only two companies and barely one hundred sixty households.

sentences.zh: 以爵而論，貝勒較輕；

translations.literal: Judging by rank, the beile is the lighter;
translations.idiomatic: By rank the beile is the lesser title;

sentences.zh: 以戶口而論，不過抵汗三十分之一。

translations.literal: Judging by registered households, they amounted to no more than one-thirtieth of the khan's.
translations.idiomatic: By registered households they came to barely one-thirtieth of the khan's total.

sentences.zh: 擬親王棍布扎布令折回承襲汗爵，以貝勒巴雜爾扎那承襲親王，貝勒一缺如無可承襲之人，俟汗王襲爵定後，即將貝勒暫行停襲。」

translations.literal: It was proposed to order Prince Gunbuzhab to turn back from inheriting the khan's rank and to have Beile Bazarjana inherit the princedom; if no one could inherit the vacant beile rank, after the khan's succession was settled the beile title would for the time being be suspended."
translations.idiomatic: They proposed ordering Prince Gunbuzhab to relinquish the khanate and vesting the princedom in Beile Bazarjana; if no heir could be found for the vacant beile rank, that title would be suspended until the khan's succession was settled."

sentences.zh: 下所司。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was forwarded to the responsible agencies.

sentences.zh: 九年，命以故汗密什多爾濟族弟噶勒章那木濟勒襲汗，棍布扎布等襲親王、貝勒如故。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an order appointed the late khan Mishidorji's clansman younger brother Galejanamjil to inherit the khanate; Gunbuzhab and others inherited prince and beile as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the court named Galejanamjil, younger brother of the late Khan Mishidorji, to succeed as khan; Gunbuzhab and the others continued as prince and beile.

sentences.zh: 回匪東竄，陷烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Muslim rebels fled eastward and captured Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim rebels drove east and took Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 十一月，科布多參贊大臣奎昌等奏：「匪撲烏里雅蘇台地方，各台潰散，科城街市商民惶惑，調附近之杜爾伯特、扎哈沁、明阿特、額魯特盟長、總管等，即發兵來城聽候調遣。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Kobdo Participating Minister Kuichang and others memorialized: "The bandits assailed the Uliastai region; the postal stations broke and scattered; merchants in Kobdo's streets and markets were alarmed; the nearby Dorbod, Zhakhachin, Mingat, and Elute league chiefs, superintendents, and others were summoned to raise troops at once and come to the city to await orders."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Kobdo Participating Minister Kuichang reported: "Rebels struck the Uliastai region; courier stations collapsed; Kobdo's merchants were panic-stricken. Nearby Dorbod, Zhakhachin, Mingat, and Elute league chiefs and superintendents were ordered to march their men to the city for deployment."

sentences.zh: 尋奏杜爾伯特左翼兵四百名、右翼及明阿特、額魯特兵各二百名、扎哈沁公兵及總管兵各五十名，均到科城收伍，命撥科布多餉銀十萬兩。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward they reported that four hundred troops of the Dorbod Left Wing, two hundred each from the Right Wing, Mingat, and Elute, and fifty each from the Zhakhachin prince's troops and the superintendents' troops had all reached Kobdo and been mustered; an order allocated one hundred thousand taels of Kobdo pay silver.
translations.idiomatic: They soon reported four hundred Dorbod left-wing troops, two hundred each from the right wing, Mingat, and Elute, and fifty each from the Zhakhachin prince's banner and the superintendents' commands—all mustered at Kobdo—and one hundred thousand taels of pay silver were assigned from Kobdo funds.

sentences.zh: 十一年十一月，予辦差無誤之杜爾伯特右翼盟長棍布扎布等獎。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year rewards were granted to Dorbod Right Wing league chief Gunbuzhab and others who had handled duties without error.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year Gunbuzhab, league chief of the Dorbod Right Wing, and others who had handled their commissions flawlessly received rewards.

sentences.zh: 是月，科布多參贊大臣長順等奏：「十月十七、十八等日，匪徑撲本城，參將英華督弁兵登壁迎擊，匪始敗退，守備賀遐齡等陣亡。

translations.literal: That month the Kobdo Participating Minister Changshun and others memorialized: "On the seventeenth, eighteenth, and other days of the tenth month the bandits pressed straight upon this city; Major Yinghua led officers and troops up the walls to meet the attack; the bandits then retreated in defeat; garrison commander He Xialing and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That month Kobdo Participating Minister Changshun reported: "On the 17th, 18th, and following days of the tenth month rebels rushed the city. Major Yinghua led his men onto the walls to repel them; the enemy finally broke and fled. Garrison commander He Xialing and others fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 十九日，匪復攻撲南關，不得逞。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth the bandits again attacked the south gate but could not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: On the 19th they assaulted the south gate again but were driven back.

sentences.zh: 二十日，由東南山路仍向扎哈沁部落奔竄。」

translations.literal: On the twentieth they fled along the southeast mountain route toward the Zhakhachin tribe."
translations.idiomatic: On the 20th they fled southeast toward the Zhakhachin pastures."

sentences.zh: 自後回匪出沒於扎哈沁、土爾扈特諸部之地，是部警備益嚴。

translations.literal: Thereafter Muslim rebels appeared and vanished in the lands of the Zhakhachin, Torghut, and other tribes; this tribe's guard was tightened all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim rebels then raided back and forth through Zhakhachin and Torghut country, and the tribe tightened its defenses accordingly.

sentences.zh: 至西路肅清，始息警撤戍。

translations.literal: Only when the Western Route was pacified did the alert cease and the garrison be withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Only when the western front was cleared did the emergency end and the garrison stand down.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，以改議俄約，增城科布多之戍，事定，撤之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, because the Russian treaty was under revision, Kobdo's garrison was increased; when matters were settled it was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7, when the Russian treaty was being renegotiated, Kobdo's garrison was reinforced; once the matter was settled, the extra troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪事起，北路戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer incident arose and the Northern Route was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the 26th year the Boxer uprising began and the northern frontier was put on alert.

sentences.zh: 科布多參贊大臣瑞洵議舉辦蒙古團練，令杜爾伯特每旗挑選兵丁二百名，一半馬隊，一半步隊，駐防本旗。

translations.literal: The Kobdo Participating Minister Ruixun proposed organizing Mongol militia, ordering each Dorbod banner to select two hundred soldiers, half cavalry and half infantry, to garrison their own banner.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo Participating Minister Ruixun proposed raising Mongol militia, requiring each Dorbod banner to furnish two hundred men—half horse, half foot—to guard their own pastures.

sentences.zh: 十月，事定，裁撤。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, when matters were settled, they were disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, once the crisis passed, the militia was dissolved.

sentences.zh: 二十八年四月，瑞洵以杜爾伯特正副盟長等保全俄商遺棄貨物，毫無損失，請準獎敘，允之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-eighth year Ruixun memorialized that the Dorbod principal and deputy league chiefs and others had preserved abandoned Russian merchants' goods without any loss and requested rewards; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the 28th year Ruixun reported that the Dorbod principal and deputy league chiefs had safeguarded goods left behind by Russian merchants without loss and asked that they be rewarded; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 七月，賑杜爾伯特右翼公多諾魯旗災，並給耔種大小麥一百石，引渠溉舊墾波什圖、那米拉、察罕哈克三處之地。

translations.literal: In the seventh month relief was extended to the Dorbod Right Wing's Duke Doronur banner for disaster, and one hundred piculs of wheat and barley seed were given; canals were led to irrigate former reclaimed lands at Boshitu, Namila, and Chaghan Hek.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the court relieved famine in the Dorbod Right Wing's Duke Doronur banner, issued one hundred piculs of wheat and barley seed, and opened canals to irrigate older fields at Boshitu, Namila, and Chaghan Hek.

sentences.zh: 二十九年閏五月，予杜爾伯特左翼正盟長副將軍特固斯庫魯克達賴汗噶勒章那木濟勒紫韁，副盟長貝勒納遜布彥、左翼扎薩克郡王圖柯莫勒、右翼正盟長副將軍扎薩克親王索特納木扎木柴三眼花翎，左翼扎薩克貝勒納遜布彥等雙眼花翎，餘給獎有差。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-ninth year the Dorbod Left Wing principal league chief and deputy general Tegus Kuruk Dalai Khan Galejanamjil was given a purple bridle; the deputy league chief Beile Nason Bayan, Left Wing zasak junwang Tukemole, and Right Wing principal league chief and deputy general zasak prince Sotnamjamsan received triple-peacock plumes; Left Wing zasak beile Nason Bayan and others received double-peacock plumes; the rest received differentiated rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of the 29th year Galejanamjil, Tegus Kuruk Dalai Khan and principal league chief of the Dorbod Left Wing, was granted a purple bridle; Deputy League Chief Beile Nason Bayan, Left Wing zasak Prince Tukemole, and Right Wing Principal League Chief and Deputy General Zasak Prince Sotnamjamsan received triple-peacock plumes; Left Wing Zasak Beile Nason Bayan and others received double-peacock plumes; others were rewarded in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 是年，辦布倫託海屯田渠工，以杜爾伯特左、右翼助借駝只，均給幫價銀。

translations.literal: That year, in undertaking the Burintokhai garrison-farm canal works, camels were borrowed with the aid of the Dorbod Left and Right Wings, and subsidy silver was given to all.
translations.idiomatic: That year, for the Burintokhai colony canal project, the Dorbod left and right wings lent camels and were paid compensatory silver.

sentences.zh: 其後參贊大臣連魁等議開烏蘭固木等屯田。

translations.literal: Thereafter Participating Ministers Lianqui and others proposed opening garrison farms at Ulan Gumu and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Later Participating Minister Lianqui and others proposed opening farms at Ulan Gumu and other sites.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年四月，索特納木扎木柴為資政院欽選議員。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Xuantong, Sotnamjamsan became an imperially selected member of the Political Consultative Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Xuantong 2 Sotnamjamsan was chosen as an imperial delegate to the Political Consultative Council.

sentences.zh: 三年，庫倫獨立，喀爾喀四部無梗抗者。

translations.literal: In the third year Urga declared independence; among the four Khalkha divisions none resisted in obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Urga declared independence; none of the four Khalkha leagues offered meaningful resistance.

sentences.zh: 是部汗噶勒章那木濟勒獨不附，聽參贊大臣溥節制如故。

translations.literal: This tribe's khan Galejanamjil alone did not attach himself to it and continued to heed Participating Minister Pu's direction as before.
translations.idiomatic: Only this tribe's Khan Galejanamjil refused to join and continued to accept the direction of Participating Minister Pu as before.

sentences.zh: 其地雜耕牧，有礦，有鹽。

translations.literal: Its lands mix farming and pastoralism; there are mines and salt.
translations.idiomatic: The territory mixes farming and herding and has both minerals and salt.

sentences.zh: 共有佐領三十五。

translations.literal: In all there are thirty-five company commands.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe maintained thirty-five company commands in all.

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特附近之部同隸科布多參贊大臣者，曰扎哈沁，東扎薩克圖汗部，南新疆鎮西，西阿爾泰烏梁海，北科布多屯田官廠。

translations.literal: Among tribes near the Dorbod likewise subordinate to the Kobdo Participating Minister is the Zhakhachin: on the east the Zasaktu Khan division; on the south Zhenxi in Xinjiang; on the west Altai Uriankhai; on the north the Kobdo garrison-farm official depots.
translations.idiomatic: Tribes near the Dorbod under the same Kobdo minister included the Zhakhachin: Zasaktu Khan territory to the east, Zhenxi in Xinjiang to the south, Altai Uriankhai to the west, and Kobdo's garrison farms to the north.

sentences.zh: 初，禡木特，額魯特人，號庫克辛，為準噶爾之扎哈沁宰桑。

translations.literal: At the beginning Mamet, an Oirat, styled Kukshin, was the Zhakhachin zaisang of the Zungars.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Mamet, an Oirat known as Kukshin, served as Zhakhachin zaisang to the Zungars.

sentences.zh: 扎哈沁者，譯言「汛卒」，以宰桑領之。

translations.literal: Zhakhachin means "garrison sentry" in translation; a zaisang leads it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhakhachin means "post sentinel"; a zaisang commanded the unit.

sentences.zh: 禡木特守阿爾泰汛，游牧布拉罕察罕托輝。

translations.literal: Mamet guarded the Altai post and pastured at Bulaghan Chaghan Tuikhui.
translations.idiomatic: Mamet held the Altai frontier post and grazed at Bulaghan Chaghan Tuikhui.

sentences.zh: 其東為喀爾喀，有烏梁海界之；

translations.literal: To the east was Khalkha, with Uriankhai forming the boundary;
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha lay to the east, bordered by the Uriankhai;

sentences.zh: 其西為準噶爾，有包沁雜準及噶拉雜特、塔本集賽界之。

translations.literal: to the west was the Zungar region, with Baojin mixed Zungars and Galazat and Tabun Jisai forming the boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: to the west lay Zungar country, bounded by the Baojin mixed Zungars and the Galazat and Tabun Jisai otoks.

sentences.zh: 包沁為回族，準噶爾呼砲曰「包」，以回人司砲，故名。

translations.literal: The Baojin were Hui people; the Zungars called cannon "bao," and because Hui men managed the guns they were so named.
translations.idiomatic: The Baojin were Hui Muslims; the Zungars called cannon bao, and the name came from Hui gunners in their service.

sentences.zh: 噶拉雜特、塔本集賽，皆準噶爾鄂拓克。

translations.literal: Galazat and Tabun Jisai were both Zungar otoks.
translations.idiomatic: Galazat and Tabun Jisai were both Zungar otoks.

sentences.zh: 鄂拓克如各旗佐領。

translations.literal: An otok was like a banner company command.
translations.idiomatic: An otok corresponded to a banner company command.

sentences.zh: 三月，以阿睦爾撒納煽烏梁海梗赴哈薩克，詔從北路將軍哈達哈剿烏梁海叛賊。

translations.literal: In the third month, because Amursana had incited the Uriankhai to block the road to the Kazakhs, an edict ordered Northern Route General Hadaha to suppress the Uriankhai rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, after Amursana stirred the Uriankhai to block the Kazakh route, an edict ordered Northern Route General Hadaha to suppress the Uriankhai rebels.

sentences.zh: 九月，賜牧哲爾格西喇呼烏蘇。

translations.literal: In the ninth month pasture at Zorge Xilahunusu was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the court granted pasture at Zorge Xilahunusu.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「扎哈沁既與喀爾喀鄰牧，即設哨附近卡倫，視喀爾喀例支領錢糧，以資養贍。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since the Zhakhachin now pasture beside the Khalkha, sentries should be posted near the barrier posts; following the Khalkha precedent they are to receive stipends in money and grain for their support."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Because the Zhakhachin now graze beside the Khalkha, post sentries near the barrier stations and pay them money and grain on the Khalkha model for their upkeep."

sentences.zh: 二十四年，從參贊大臣齊努渾追剿瑪哈沁，至阿爾齊圖。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year they followed Participating Minister Qinunhun in pursuing and suppressing the Mahajin as far as Arqitu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year they joined Participating Minister Qinunhun in pursuing the Mahajin rebels as far as Arqitu.

sentences.zh: 以兵先遇賊哈喇呼山，奮擊之，屢就擒，獎賚幣。

translations.literal: With troops they first met the bandits at Khara Khushan, struck fiercely, repeatedly came near capture, and were rewarded with gifts of silks.
translations.idiomatic: Their troops first met the rebels at Khara Khushan and fought fiercely, nearly capturing them several times, and were rewarded with silks.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，扎木禪子門圖什扈蹕行圍，乞喀爾喀親王成袞札布代請駝馬勿官給。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Zhamuchan's son Mentush escorted the imperial hunt and asked Khalkha Prince Chengunjab to request on his behalf that camels and horses not be supplied by the government.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Zhamuchan's son Mentush attended the imperial hunt and asked Khalkha Prince Chengunjab to plead that camels and horses not be issued from government stores.

sentences.zh: 上以扎哈沁甫定牧畜之生計，諭仍官給。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the Zhakhachin had only just settled their pastoral livelihood, ordered that official supply continue.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that, since the Zhakhachin had only just secured their herds, official supplies should continue.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，理籓院議禡木特歸誠後，扎哈沁屬相繼附，置佐領九，得二千餘口，雖補總管，未給印，請以總管扎哈沁一旗總管印給扎木禪轄其眾，允之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Court of Colonial Affairs deliberated: after Mamet's submission, Zhakhachin dependents attached themselves in succession; nine company commands were established with more than two thousand persons; although a superintendent was appointed, no seal was issued; it was requested that the superintendent's seal of the one-banner Zhakhachin be given to Zhamuchan to govern his people; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the Court of Colonial Affairs ruled that after Mamet submitted, Zhakhachin followers came in one after another; nine company commands were set up for more than two thousand people. Although a superintendent was named, he had no seal; the court granted Zhamuchan the Zhakhachin superintendent's seal to govern his people.

sentences.zh: 四十年，扎木禪卒。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year Zhamuchan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year Zhamuchan died.

sentences.zh: 以扎哈沁原非禡木特之阿爾巴圖，撤出佐領，設一旗屬科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Because the Zhakhachin had not originally been Mamet's albatu, the company commands were withdrawn and one banner was established subordinate to the Kobdo Participating Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Zhakhachin had not originally been Mamet's retainers, their company commands were withdrawn and a single banner was placed under the Kobdo Participating Minister.

sentences.zh: 其扎木禪族丁及其阿爾巴圖三十餘戶，亦附近科布多之烏裕克齊、博多克齊游牧。

translations.literal: Zhamuchan's clansmen and his more than thirty albatu households also pastured near Kobdo at Uyukqi and Bodokqi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhamuchan's kinsmen and his thirty-odd retainer households grazed instead near Kobdo at Uyukqi and Bodokqi.

sentences.zh: 至四十五年五月，諭將軍巴圖等不可令扎薩克圖汗部侵占扎哈沁之烏英濟等處隙地。

translations.literal: By the fifth month of the forty-fifth year an edict instructed General Batu and others not to let the Zasaktu Khan division encroach on vacant lands of the Zhakhachin such as Uyingji.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth month of the forty-fifth year an edict warned General Batu and others not to let the Zasaktu Khan division seize vacant Zhakhachin lands such as Uyingji.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪事起，邊戍戒嚴，參贊大臣瑞洵檄是部信勇公策林多爾濟、總管三保、額魯特總管喇嘛札布、明阿特總管達什哲克博舉辦團防，保護俄商貨物，用弭邊釁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer incident arose and the frontier garrisons were placed on alert; Participating Minister Ruixun ordered this tribe's Xinyong Gong Ceringdorji, Superintendent Sanbao, Elute Superintendent Lama Jab, and Mingat Superintendent Dashijekbo to organize local defense, protect Russian merchants' goods, and thereby quiet border troubles.
translations.idiomatic: In the 26th year the Boxer uprising put frontier garrisons on alert; Participating Minister Ruixun directed this tribe's Xinyong Gong Ceringdorji, Superintendent Sanbao, Elute Superintendent Lama Jab, and Mingat Superintendent Dashijekbo to raise local defense, safeguard Russian merchants' property, and ease border tensions.

sentences.zh: 二十九年閏五月，一再請獎。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-ninth year rewards were repeatedly requested.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of the 29th year they repeatedly petitioned for rewards.

sentences.zh: 奏入，予策林多爾濟貝子銜，三保等均二品頂戴。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, Ceringdorji was given the rank of beizi and Sanbao and the others all received second-rank official caps.
translations.idiomatic: On memorializing, Ceringdorji was granted beizi rank and Sanbao and the others second-rank official caps.

sentences.zh: 三十一年五月，瑞洵奏：「科布多所轄扎哈沁應用之五台，尤為大雪封壩。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirty-first year Ruixun memorialized: "Among the five postal stations under Kobdo that the Zhakhachin must serve, these are especially blocked by heavy snow on the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the 31st year Ruixun reported: "Of the five courier stations the Zhakhachin maintain for Kobdo, these are worst cut off by snow on the mountain passes.

sentences.zh: 复赴阿爾泰必由之路，信使絡繹，地當其衝。

translations.literal: They are also on the road that must be taken to reach Altai; couriers come and go in succession; the place lies at the crossroads.
translations.idiomatic: They also lie on the mandatory route to Altai, where couriers pass constantly—a true crossroads.

sentences.zh: 扎哈沁共二旗，最為瘠苦，公一旗戶口甚稀。

translations.literal: The Zhakhachin have two banners in all; they are the poorest and most destitute; the prince's one banner has very few households.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhakhachin have only two banners, the poorest of all; the prince's banner has very few households.

sentences.zh: 幫辦大臣英秀由哈巴河回科布多，臣赴新疆督辦收撫，信勇公策林多爾濟調集烏拉，奔走恐後，保其子台吉棍布瓦齊爾，請賞二品頂戴。」

translations.literal: Assistant Minister Yingxiu returned to Kobdo from the Haba River; your servant went to Xinjiang to supervise pacification; Xinyong Gong Ceringdorji gathered transport animals and strove to be first in service; he recommended his son taiji Gunbawachir and requested a second-rank official cap."
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Minister Yingxiu returned to Kobdo from the Haba River while I went to Xinjiang to oversee pacification. Xinyong Gong Ceringdorji mustered transport animals and hurried to serve; he recommended his son, taiji Gunbawachir, for a second-rank official cap."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，參贊大臣溥奏賑扎哈沁災，公旗貧民三百五十六丁口，總管旗貧民一千有一十一丁口，將賞銀五千兩分別重輕散放。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong Participating Minister Pu memorialized relief for the Zhakhachin disaster: three hundred fifty-six persons in the prince's banner and one thousand eleven persons in the superintendent's banner; five thousand taels of reward silver would be distributed according to degrees of hardship.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 Participating Minister Pu sought relief for the Zhakhachin famine: 356 persons in the prince's banner and 1,011 in the superintendent's banner; 5,000 taels were to be distributed according to need.

sentences.zh: 下所司。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was forwarded to the responsible agencies.

sentences.zh: 額魯特、明阿特亦與是部同隸科布多。

translations.literal: The Elute and Mingat were also subordinate to Kobdo like this tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The Elute and Mingat were likewise under Kobdo, as was this tribe.

sentences.zh: 額魯特本台吉達木拜屬。

translations.literal: The Elute had originally been dependents of taiji Damubai.
translations.idiomatic: The Elute had originally followed taiji Damubai.

sentences.zh: 達木拜有罪削爵，以其眾屬科布多，游牧在新和碩特之西。

translations.literal: Damubai was guilty and stripped of his rank; his people were placed under Kobdo and pastured west of the New Khoshut.
translations.idiomatic: Damubai was convicted and stripped of rank; his people were assigned to Kobdo and grazed west of the New Khoshut.

sentences.zh: 明阿特本出烏梁海，復為扎薩克圖汗部中左翼左左旗之屬，乾隆三十年撤出。

translations.literal: The Mingat had originally come from the Uriankhai and again belonged to the Middle Left Wing's Left-Left Banner of the Zasaktu Khan division; in the thirtieth year of Qianlong they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The Mingat were originally Uriankhai and had belonged to the Middle Left Wing's Left-Left Banner of the Zasaktu Khan division; in Qianlong 30 they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 設一旗屬科布多，游牧在阿爾泰烏梁海之西。

translations.literal: One banner was established subordinate to Kobdo, pasturing west of Altai Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: A single banner was placed under Kobdo and grazed west of Altai Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十七年，設額魯特、明阿特總管各一，參領以下有差。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year of Qianlong one superintendent each was established for the Elute and Mingat, with assistant commanders and below in graded numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 57 one superintendent was appointed for each of the Elute and Mingat, with assistant commanders and subordinates in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 同治十年，以防守科城及供大兵西進勞，額魯特、明阿特總管與扎哈沁信勇公及總管均予獎。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Tongzhi, for defending Kobdo and supplying labor for the great army's advance westward, the Elute and Mingat superintendents together with the Zhakhachin Xinyong Gong and superintendent all received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 10, for defending Kobdo and supporting the great western campaign, the Elute and Mingat superintendents, the Zhakhachin Xinyong Gong, and the superintendent were all rewarded.

sentences.zh: 兩旗皆無扎薩克，論者謂此蒙部之同於郡縣者也。

translations.literal: Neither banner had a zasak; commentators said these Mongol tribes were like prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Neither banner had a zasak; commentators held that these Mongol tribes resembled Chinese prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 舊土爾扈特，始祖元臣翁罕，姓不著。

translations.literal: The Old Torghut: their founding ancestor was the Yuan minister Weng Han; the clan name is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Torghut traced their line to the Yuan minister Weng Han; their clan name is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 七傳至貝果鄂爾勒克，子四，長珠勒扎幹鄂爾勒克，生子一，曰和鄂爾勒克，居於雅爾之額什爾努拉地。

translations.literal: After seven generations came Boige Orlok, who had four sons; the eldest Julesagan Orlok had one son, called Kho Orlok, who dwelt at Eshil Nura in Yar.
translations.idiomatic: Seven generations later came Boige Orlok, who had four sons. The eldest, Julesagan Orlok, had one son, Kho Orlok, who lived at Eshil Nura in Yar.

sentences.zh: 初衛拉特諸酋以伊犁為會宗地，各統所部不相屬。

translations.literal: At first the Oirat chiefs took Ili as their assembly ground; each ruled his own people and was not subordinate to the others.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Oirat chiefs met at Ili; each ruled his own followers independently.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾部酋巴圖爾琿台吉者，游牧阿爾台，恃其強，欲役屬諸衛拉特。

translations.literal: The Zungar chief Batur Khuntaiji pastured on the Altai, relied on his strength, and wished to bring all the Oirats under his service.
translations.idiomatic: The Zungar chief Batur Khuntaiji grazed the Altai, trusted in his power, and sought to subjugate the Oirat tribes.

sentences.zh: 和鄂爾勒克惡之，挈族走俄羅斯，牧額濟勒河，俄羅斯因稱為己屬。

translations.literal: Kho Orlok detested this, led his clan away to Russia, and pastured on the Ilek River; Russia thereupon claimed them as its subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Kho Orlok loathed this, led his clan into Russia, and grazed the Ilek; Russia then claimed them as subjects.

sentences.zh: 順治十二、三、四年，和鄂爾勒克子書庫爾岱青、伊勒登諾顏、羅卜藏諾顏相繼遣使奉表貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth, thirteenth, and fourteenth years of Shunzhi, Kho Orlok's sons Shukur Daike, Ileden Noyan, and Lobzang Noyan sent envoys in succession to present memorials and tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12–14, Kho Orlok's sons Shukur Daike, Ileden Noyan, and Lobzang Noyan sent envoys in turn with memorials and tribute.

sentences.zh: 書庫爾岱青子朋蘇克，朋蘇克子阿玉奇，世為土爾扈特部長，至阿玉奇始自稱汗。

translations.literal: Shukur Daike's son was Pungsuk; Pungsuk's son was Ayuki; for generations they were chiefs of the Torghut tribe, and only with Ayuki did one first style himself khan.
translations.idiomatic: Shukur Daike's son was Pungsuk, and Pungsuk's son Ayuki; for generations they headed the Torghut, and only Ayuki took the title of khan.

sentences.zh: 康熙中，表貢不絕。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign memorial tribute was unbroken.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the Kangxi reign they sent memorial tribute without interruption.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，復遣使假道俄羅斯貢方物。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year envoys were again sent by way of Russia to present local products in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the 51st year they again sent envoys through Russia with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其誠，且欲悉所部疆域，遣內閣侍讀圖理琛等賚敕往，曆三載乃還，附表奏謝。

translations.literal: The emperor praised their sincerity and, wishing to know the boundaries of their tribe, dispatched Grand Secretariat Reader-in-Waiting Tulichen and others bearing an imperial letter; after three years they returned and attached a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised their loyalty and, wishing to learn their territory, sent Grand Secretariat Reader Tulichen with an imperial letter; they returned three years later with a memorial of thanks.

sentences.zh: 自是時因俄羅斯請於中朝，遣所部人赴藏熬茶。

translations.literal: From this time, because Russia requested it of the central court, people of the tribe were sent to Tibet to boil tea.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, at Russia's request to the central court, tribesmen were sent to Tibet for the tea pilgrimage.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十一年，所部使吹扎布等入覲，稱奉其汗惇羅布喇什令，假道俄羅斯，三載方至，請赴唐古忒謁達賴喇嘛，遣官護往。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Qianlong the tribe's envoys Chuijab and others came to audience, saying they acted on the order of their khan Dunrubashi, had come by way of Russia, and required three years to arrive; they asked to go to Tangut to visit the Dalai Lama, and officials were dispatched to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 21 the tribe's envoys Chuijab and others came to court on orders from their khan Dunrubashi; they had traveled three years through Russia and asked to visit the Dalai Lama in Tibet; officials were sent to escort them.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，自唐古忒還，頒惇羅布喇什幣物。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year they returned from Tangut and gifts of silks were bestowed on Dunrubashi.
translations.idiomatic: In the 22nd year they returned from Tibet and silks were bestowed on Dunrubashi.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，伊犁平，有附牧伊犁之土爾扈特族台吉舍棱等奔額濟勒河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Ili was pacified; Torghut clansmen taiji Sele and others who had been attached to grazing at Ili fled to the Ilek River.
translations.idiomatic: In the 23rd year, after Ili was pacified, Torghut taiji Sele and others who had grazed near Ili fled to the Ilek.

sentences.zh: 既而惇羅布喇什卒，子渥巴錫嗣為汗。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Dunrubashi died and his son Ubashi succeeded as khan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Dunrubashi died and his son Ubashi succeeded as khan.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，舍棱誘渥巴錫攜所部之土爾扈特、和碩特、輝特、杜爾伯特等人眾於十月越俄羅斯之坑格圖喇納卡倫而南，俄羅斯遣兵追之不及。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year Sele induced Ubashi to lead his Torghut, Khoshut, Khoit, Dorbod, and other followers south in the tenth month across Russia's Khangait Lun barrier post; Russia sent troops in pursuit but could not overtake them.
translations.idiomatic: In the 35th year Sele persuaded Ubashi to lead the Torghut, Khoshut, Khoit, Dorbod, and their followers south in the tenth month across Russia's Khangait Lun barrier; Russian troops pursued but could not catch them.

sentences.zh: 渥巴錫既入國境，由巴爾噶什淖爾而進，至克齊克玉子地方，與哈薩克台吉額勒里納拉里之眾相持。

translations.literal: Once Ubashi had entered the frontier, he advanced from Lake Balkhash to the Keqikeyuzi region and confronted the forces of Kazakh taiji Elerinarali.
translations.idiomatic: After Ubashi crossed the frontier he advanced from Lake Balkhash to Keqikeyuzi and faced the forces of Kazakh taiji Elerinarali.

sentences.zh: 伊犁將軍令哈薩克毋許土爾扈特越游牧而行，渥巴錫遂向沙喇伯可而進，布魯特群起劫之。

translations.literal: The Ili General ordered the Kazakhs not to allow the Torghut to cross and pasture as they went; Ubashi then advanced toward Sarboko, and the Kyrgyz rose in groups to plunder them.
translations.idiomatic: The Ili General forbade the Kazakhs to let the Torghut pass and graze through their lands; Ubashi turned toward Sarboko, and Kyrgyz bands fell upon them in plunder.

sentences.zh: 渥巴錫走沙喇伯可之北戈壁，無水草，人皆取馬牛之血而飲，瘟疫大作，死者三十萬，牲畜十存三四。

translations.literal: Ubashi fled into the Gobi north of Sarboko; there was no water or grass; people all took horse and cattle blood to drink; plague broke out fiercely; three hundred thousand died; of livestock only three or four in ten survived.
translations.idiomatic: Ubashi fled into the Gobi north of Sarboko where there was no water or pasture; people drank the blood of horses and cattle; plague swept the column; three hundred thousand died; only three or four animals in ten survived.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，至他木哈地方，近內地卡倫，布魯特始斂兵退。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year they reached Tamuha, near the interior barrier posts, and the Kyrgyz only then gathered in their troops and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the 36th year they reached Tamuha near the interior barrier posts; only then did the Kyrgyz withdraw their raiding parties.

sentences.zh: 將軍伊勒因遣侍衛普濟問來意，渥巴錫與其台吉、喇嘛計議數日始定，以投誠為詞，獻其祖所受明永樂八年漢篆敕封玉印及玉器、宣窯磁器等物。

translations.literal: General Yilein dispatched guardsman Puji to ask their purpose; Ubashi deliberated with his taijis and lamas for several days before deciding; under the plea of submission he presented the jade seal bearing a Han-script investiture edict of the eighth year of Yongle of the Ming received by his ancestor, together with jade objects, Xuande-kiln porcelain, and other items.
translations.idiomatic: General Yilein sent guardsman Puji to ask their purpose. Ubashi deliberated with his taijis and lamas for days before declaring submission and presenting the jade seal with a Yongle 8 Han-script investiture received by his ancestor, along with jades, Xuande porcelain, and other treasures.

sentences.zh: 先是上聞渥巴錫之來，命烏什參贊大臣舒赫德往伊犁經紀其事。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the emperor heard of Ubashi's coming, he ordered Ushi Participating Minister Shuhede to go to Ili to manage the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, on hearing of Ubashi's approach, the emperor had ordered Ushi Participating Minister Shuhede to Ili to handle the reception.

sentences.zh: 至是因受其降，存七萬餘眾，賑以米、麥、牛、羊、茶、布、棉裘之屬，用帑二十萬兩。

translations.literal: Thereupon he accepted their surrender; more than seventy thousand people survived; they were relieved with rice, wheat, cattle, sheep, tea, cloth, cotton garments, and the like, at a cost of two hundred thousand taels from the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: He then accepted their surrender. More than seventy thousand survived and were relieved with rice, wheat, cattle, sheep, tea, cloth, cotton garments, and the like, at a cost of two hundred thousand taels from the treasury.

sentences.zh: 三十六年九月，渥巴錫等入覲熱河，封渥巴錫舊土爾扈特卓里克圖汗，渥巴錫從子額墨根烏巴什固山巴雅爾圖貝子，拜濟瑚輔國公，從弟伯爾哈什哈一等台吉，均授扎薩克，各編一旗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirty-sixth year Ubashi and others had audience at Rehe; Ubashi was enfeoffed as Jorightu Khan of the Old Torghut; Ubashi's nephew Emegein Ubashi Gushen Bayartu was made beizi; Baijihu was made fuguo gong; his younger cousin Berhasha was made first-rank taiji; all were granted zasak rank and each was organized into one banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the 36th year Ubashi and his party had audience at Rehe. Ubashi was enfeoffed as Jorightu Khan of the Old Torghut; his nephew Emegein Ubashi Gushen Bayartu was made beizi; Baijihu was made fuguo gong; his cousin Berhasha was made first-rank taiji; all received zasak rank and each was organized into a banner.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，均予世襲罔替。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year all were granted perpetual hereditary succession without degradation.
translations.idiomatic: In the 47th year all were granted perpetual hereditary rank without degradation.

sentences.zh: 初分所部為四路，南路凡四旗，曰扎薩克卓理克圖汗旗，曰中旗，曰右旗，曰左旗。

translations.literal: At first the tribe was divided into four routes; the Southern Route had four banners in all: the Zasak Jorightu Khan banner, the Middle banner, the Right banner, and the Left banner.
translations.idiomatic: At first the tribe was divided into four routes. The Southern Route had four banners: the Zasak Jorightu Khan banner, the Middle banner, the Right banner, and the Left banner.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，賜牧齋爾。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year pasture at Zha'er was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 37th year they were granted pasture at Zha'er.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，徙牧珠勒都斯，隸喀喇沙爾辦事大臣，與北路三旗、東路二旗、西路一旗統受節制於伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year they were moved to pasture at Zhaledus, placed under the Karashar Resident Minister, and together with the three banners of the Northern Route, two of the Eastern Route, and one of the Western Route were all placed under the Ili General's command.
translations.idiomatic: In the 38th year they were moved to Zhaledus under the Karashar Resident Minister; with the three northern banners, two eastern banners, and one western banner, all came under the Ili General.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，高宗大行，舊土爾扈特汗霍紹齊之母請納俸諷經，不許。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, when the Gaozong Emperor died, the mother of Old Torghut Khan Huoshoji asked to pay stipends for sutra chanting; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4, after the Gaozong Emperor's death, the mother of Old Torghut Khan Huoshoji asked to pay stipends for sutra chanting; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，回匪張格爾擾喀什噶爾等城，徵是路土爾扈特及和碩特蒙兵赴阿克蘇一帶助剿。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang the Muslim rebel Jahangir harassed Kashgar and other cities; Torghut and Khoshut Mongol troops of this route were levied to assist in suppression around Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6 the Muslim rebel Jahangir raided Kashgar and other cities; Old Torghut and Khoshut troops of this route were called to help suppress the revolt around Aksu.

sentences.zh: 十月，擊退犯渾巴什河之賊，賚貝子巴爾達拉什、台吉烏圖那遜等及兵丁等緞疋、翎頂、銀兩有差。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the bandits attacking the Hunbash River were beaten back; beizi Bardarash, taiji Utunason, and others together with the soldiers were rewarded with bolts of silk, plumes, and silver in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they repelled rebels on the Hunbash River; Beizi Bardarash, taiji Utunason, and their soldiers received graded rewards of silk, plumes, and silver.

sentences.zh: 自是回疆有事，皆徵其兵。

translations.literal: From this time onward, whenever there was trouble in the Muslim borderlands, their troops were levied.
translations.idiomatic: After that, whenever trouble broke out in the Muslim borderlands, their troops were called up.

sentences.zh: 十年十一月，以貝子巴爾丹拉什率兵援喀、英等城，卒於軍，命其子蒙庫那遜晉襲貝勒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the tenth year, because beizi Bardanlash led troops to relieve Karashahr, Yingjisha, and other cities and died in the army, his son Mengkunason was ordered to succeed and be promoted to beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the 10th year Beizi Bardanlash died in camp while leading troops to relieve Karashahr and Yingjisha; his son Mengkunason was ordered to succeed him and promoted to beile.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月，以是部南路盟長福晉喇什丕勒指修喀喇沙爾城垣，予獎。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year, because this tribe's Southern Route league chief Fujin Lashibele directed repairs to the Karashahr city walls, a reward was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the 18th year the Southern Route league chief Fujin Lashibele was rewarded for directing repairs to the Karashahr city walls.

sentences.zh: 二十一年六月，又獻伊拉里克水源，卻之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-first year they again presented the Ilirik water source; it was declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the 21st year they again offered the Ilirik water source; the court declined it.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，布魯特擾喀什噶爾等城，亦徵是路蒙兵防剿，事定撤回。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the Burut harassed Kashgar and other cities; Mongol troops of this route were also levied to defend and suppress; when the affair was settled they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the 27th year the Burut raided Kashgar and other cities; Old Torghut Mongol troops of this route were also called up to defend and suppress the disturbance, and were withdrawn once order was restored.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，回匪變亂，庫車失陷，徵是路兵剿之，不利，退守游牧。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi Muslim rebels rose in revolt; Kucha fell; troops of this route were levied to suppress them; they did not succeed and fell back to guard their pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 Muslim rebels rose in revolt and Kucha fell. Troops of this route were sent to suppress them, met with no success, and fell back to their pastures.

sentences.zh: 是年，喀喇沙爾等城均失陷，是路部落屢與回匪接戰，被蹂躪離散。

translations.literal: That year Karashahr and other cities all fell; tribes of this route repeatedly engaged Muslim rebels in battle and were ravaged and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: That year Karashahr and the other cities fell as well. The tribes of this route fought Muslim rebels again and again and were overrun and driven apart.

sentences.zh: 六年十二月，盟長佈雅庫勒哲依圖請赴京，允之，命烏里雅蘇台將軍麟興等設法安插其部落游牧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixth year the league chief Buyankulejeyitu asked to go to the capital; this was granted, and the Uliastai General Lin Xing and others were ordered to find means to resettle the tribe's pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the 6th year League Chief Buyankulejeyitu asked to go to Beijing; the request was granted, and the Uliastai General Lin Xing and others were ordered to arrange resettlement for the tribe's pastoral communities.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，布雅庫勒哲依圖請率屬剿回逆，上嘉之，命赴布倫託海候李雲麟酌辦，並飭戶部籌撥歷年俸銀俸緞，李雲麟接濟所屬游牧人眾。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year Buyankulejeyitu asked to lead his followers to suppress the rebellious Muslims; the emperor commended this and ordered him to proceed to Burultokhai to await Li Yunlin's arrangements, and also directed the Board of Revenue to allocate accumulated years of stipend silver and silk; Li Yunlin was to relieve the nomadic people under his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the 7th year Buyankulejeyitu asked to lead his people against the Muslim rebels. The emperor praised the offer and ordered him to Burultokhai to coordinate with Li Yunlin, while the Board of Revenue was directed to supply back stipends in silver and silk and Li Yunlin was to provide relief for the pastoral communities under his authority.

sentences.zh: 六月，以舊土爾扈特蒙兵接仗失利，移至大小珠勒都斯，催布雅庫勒哲依圖赴布倫託海，命明瑤等接濟照料。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, because Old Torghut Mongol troops had been defeated in battle, they were moved to Greater and Lesser Zhaledus; Buyankulejeyitu was urged to go to Burultokhai, and Ming Yao and others were ordered to provide relief and care.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, after Old Torghut Mongol troops were defeated in action, they were moved to Greater and Lesser Zhaledus. Buyankulejeyitu was urged on to Burultokhai, and Ming Yao and others were ordered to supply and look after them.

sentences.zh: 十一月，麟興奏布雅庫勒哲依圖困苦情形，下所司議。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Lin Xing memorialized on Buyankulejeyitu's distressed condition; the matter was referred to the responsible offices for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Lin Xing reported Buyankulejeyitu's desperate situation, and the case was sent to the relevant offices for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 八年三月，賚舊土爾扈特汗布雅庫勒哲依圖、貝勒固嚕扎布、輔國公曼吉多爾濟等旗銀二萬兩。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eighth year Old Torghut Khan Buyankulejeyitu, beile Guruzhab, fuguo gong Mangiduorji, and others were granted twenty thousand taels of banner silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the 8th year Old Torghut Khan Buyankulejeyitu, Beile Guruzhab, Fuguo Gong Mangiduorji, and others received twenty thousand taels of banner silver.

sentences.zh: 六月，命烏里雅蘇台將軍福濟安插舊土爾扈特汗布雅庫勒哲依圖及隨帶官兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Uliastai General Fu Ji was ordered to resettle Old Torghut Khan Buyankulejeyitu and the officers and soldiers who accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Uliastai General Fu Ji was ordered to resettle Old Torghut Khan Buyankulejeyitu and his escort of officers and troops.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，布雅庫勒哲依圖卒，以福晉恩克巴圖署盟長。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu Buyankulejeyitu died; the princess consort Enkebatu was appointed to act as league chief.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 Buyankulejeyitu died, and Princess Consort Enkebatu was appointed acting league chief.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，撥部庫銀予恩克巴圖撫綏人眾，擇地安插。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year Board of Revenue silver was allocated to Enkebatu to pacify the people and choose land for resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the 2nd year Board of Revenue funds were allotted to Enkebatu to pacify her people and select land for their resettlement.

sentences.zh: 三年，劉錦棠等軍复喀喇沙爾。

translations.literal: In the third year the armies of Liu Jintang and others recovered Karashahr.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year Liu Jintang's forces recovered Karashahr.

sentences.zh: 四年十二月，伊犁將軍金順奏土爾扈特南部落人眾，自逆回構亂以來，逃散伊犁空吉斯及西湖等處，署盟長派員前往收集，約計一萬餘人，現已移回珠勒都斯游牧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year the Ili General Jin Shun memorialized that the people of the Torghut Southern Route tribe, since the rebellious Muslims had stirred up disorder, had fled and scattered to Ili, Kongjisi, Xihu, and other places; the acting league chief had sent men to gather them, totaling more than ten thousand persons, who had now been moved back to pasture at Zhaledus.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the 4th year Ili General Jin Shun reported that since the Muslim revolt the people of the Torghut Southern Route had fled and scattered through Ili, Kongjisi, Xihu, and elsewhere. The acting league chief had sent officers to gather them—about ten thousand in all—and they had now been moved back to their pastures at Zhaledus.

sentences.zh: 諭以其部人眾困苦，賞銀四萬卹之，由左宗棠發給。

translations.literal: An edict stated that because the people of the tribe were in distress, forty thousand taels of silver were granted in relief, to be disbursed by Zuo Zongtang.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered forty thousand taels in relief silver for the tribe's suffering people, to be paid out by Zuo Zongtang.

sentences.zh: 八年，是部難民由伊犁續歸三百三十餘丁口，舊有府第，兵燹之後，尚未修復，大小水渠，年久墊淤。

translations.literal: In the eighth year more than three hundred and thirty persons of refugee households of this tribe continued to return from Ili; their former mansions, after the devastation of war, had not yet been restored, and the large and small irrigation canals had silted up over the years.
translations.idiomatic: In the 8th year more than three hundred and thirty additional refugees returned from Ili. Their former residences had not been rebuilt after the war, and the main and branch canals had long since silted shut.

sentences.zh: 欽差大臣劉錦棠奏：「恩克巴圖請賑恤，並籌借銀兩。

translations.literal: Imperial Commissioner Liu Jintang memorialized: "Enkebatu asks for relief and condolence payments, and also to borrow silver on account.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Commissioner Liu Jintang memorialized: "Enkebatu seeks relief funds and also requests a loan of silver.

sentences.zh: 權為籌撥銀一萬兩，作為渠工宅第經費。

translations.literal: It is proposed provisionally to allocate ten thousand taels of silver as funds for canal works and mansions.
translations.idiomatic: I propose allocating ten thousand taels provisionally for canal repairs and rebuilding the mansions.

sentences.zh: 喀喇沙爾善後局員照章給賑，通融接濟牛種，待賑丁口糧，俾資耕作。

translations.literal: The Karashahr rehabilitation bureau staff should distribute relief according to regulations, flexibly supply cattle and seed, and provide grain for relief households so they may resume farming.
translations.idiomatic: Karashahr rehabilitation officials should distribute relief as regulations provide, and as circumstances allow supply cattle and seed and grain for registered households so they can return to farming.

sentences.zh: 請分別核銷及作正開銷。」

translations.literal: It is requested that these be separately audited and written off, and entered as regular expenditures."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that these items be audited and written off separately and entered as regular expenditures."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 九年，設新疆喀喇沙爾直隸廳撫民同知兼理事銜，兼管土爾扈特游牧事宜。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Xinjiang Karashahr Directly Attached Department was established with a subprefect for civil administration who also held concurrent jurisdiction over Mongol affairs, and who also supervised Torghut pastoral affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year Xinjiang established the Karashahr Direct Department with a subprefect for civil administration and concurrent Mongol jurisdiction, who also oversaw Torghut pastoral affairs.

sentences.zh: 十三年，新疆巡撫劉錦棠奏：「土爾扈特等蒙眾向隸辦事領隊管轄者，應改歸地方官管轄。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Xinjiang governor Liu Jintang memorialized: "Torghut and other Mongol communities formerly under the jurisdiction of the frontier service leading detachments should be transferred to local civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the 13th year Xinjiang Governor Liu Jintang memorialized: "Torghut and other Mongols formerly under frontier leading detachments should come under local civil administration.

sentences.zh: 恐各蒙民未能戶曉，請飭理籓院申明新設定制，轉行各蒙部。」

translations.literal: Fearing that the various Mongol peoples might not all be informed household by household, it is requested that the Court of Colonial Affairs be ordered to proclaim the newly established regulations and circulate them to the various Mongol tribes."
translations.idiomatic: Lest the change not reach every household, I ask that the Court of Colonial Affairs proclaim the new regulations and circulate them to all Mongol tribes."

sentences.zh: 下所司知之。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were notified to take note.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices were so informed.

sentences.zh: 二十二年三月，甘肅回匪西竄出關，伊犁將軍長庚電奏賊窺珠勒都斯，檄南部落署盟長福晉色里特博勒噶丹等揀選有槍馬之蒙兵五百名，由貝勒恭噶那木扎勒統之，分派參領奔津等各帶官兵駐哈布齊沿山口及哈哈爾達巴罕、達蘭達巴罕等處，扼珠勒都斯之東，逼喀喇沙爾、庫爾勒要隘。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-second year Gansu Muslim rebels fled west out of the passes; the Ili General Chang Geng telegraphed that bandits were watching Zhaledus and ordered the Southern Route acting league chief Princess Consort Seritebolegadan and others to select five hundred Mongol soldiers with firearms and horses, placed under beile Gongganamuzhale's command; assistant commandants Benjin and others were each assigned officers and soldiers to garrison along the Haubuqi pass and at Hahardaban, Dalandaban, and other places, blocking the east of Zhaledus and pressing the strategic points of Karashahr and Korla.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the 22nd year Gansu Muslim rebels broke west out of the passes. Ili General Chang Geng wired that rebels were threatening Zhaledus and ordered Southern Route Acting League Chief Princess Consort Seritebolegadan and others to muster five hundred mounted Mongols with firearms under Beile Gongganamuzhale. Assistant commandants Benjin and others were posted with their troops along the Haubuqi pass and at Hahardaban, Dalandaban, and other points to hold the east of Zhaledus and guard the approaches to Karashahr and Korla.

sentences.zh: 八月，事定，撤歸。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the affair was settled and the troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, once the crisis passed, the troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 新疆置省後，舊土爾扈特諸部仍隸伊犁將軍，俸銀俸緞均由伊犁發給。

translations.literal: After Xinjiang was made a province, the various divisions of the Old Torghut remained under the Ili General; stipend silver and silk were all issued from Ili.
translations.idiomatic: After Xinjiang became a province, the Old Torghut divisions remained under the Ili General, and their stipends in silver and silk continued to be paid from Ili.
