sentences.zh: 蒙古惟舊土爾扈特等部之在新疆者，汗、王、公、扎薩克等卒，襲子不及歲，以前皆由已歿汗、王、公等之妻或母署印。

translations.literal: Among the Mongols, only in the Old Torghut and other tribes in Xinjiang, when khans, princes, dukes, zasaks, and the like died and the heir had not yet reached one year of age, the seal had previously been held in commission by the deceased khan's, prince's, or duke's wife or mother.
translations.idiomatic: Among Xinjiang Mongols, only the Old Torghut and related tribes had the custom that when a khan, prince, duke, or zasak died leaving an heir under one year old, the widow or mother held the seal in commission.

sentences.zh: 有鹽，有礦，地兼耕牧。

translations.literal: There is salt and there are mines; the land supports both farming and pastoralism.
translations.idiomatic: The region has salt and mines, and the land supports both farming and herding.

sentences.zh: 佐領共五十四。

translations.literal: There are fifty-four assistant commandants in all.
translations.idiomatic: There are fifty-four assistant commandants in all.

sentences.zh: 北路凡三旗，盟曰烏訥恩素珠克圖，在塔爾巴哈台城東，當金山之西南霍博克薩里，東噶扎爾巴什諾爾，南戈壁，西察漢鄂博，北額爾齊斯河。

translations.literal: The Northern Route has three banners in all; the league is called Unen Suvquit; it lies east of Tacheng city, at Hoboksari southwest of the Altai; east is Gazharbash Nor; south is the Gobi; west is Chahan Obo; north is the Irtysh River.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Route comprises three banners in the league of Unen Suvquit, east of Tacheng at Hoboksari southwest of the Altai: Gazharbash Nor to the east, the Gobi to the south, Chahan Obo to the west, and the Irtysh to the north.

sentences.zh: 渥巴錫族子策伯克多爾濟等，乾隆三十六年，從渥巴錫來歸，獻金削刀及色爾克斯馬。

translations.literal: Ubashi's clansmen Cebeke Duolji and others, in the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong, followed Ubashi in returning to allegiance and presented a gold-hilted knife and a Circassian horse.
translations.idiomatic: Ubashi's kinsman Cebeke Duolji and others followed Ubashi back in Qianlong 36 and presented a gold-hilted knife and a Circassian horse.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，入覲，封策伯克多爾濟扎薩克和碩布延圖親王，授其弟奇哩布扎薩克一等台吉，轄右翼，賜牧霍博克薩里，為舊土爾扈特北路，以策伯克多爾濟領之，授盟長。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he had audience; Cebeke Duolji was enfeoffed as zasak Hoshoi Buyantu qin wang; his younger brother Qirib was granted zasak first-rank taiji and governed the Right Wing; pasture at Hoboksari was granted as the Old Torghut Northern Route, led by Cebeke Duolji, who was made league chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the 37th year he had audience at court. Cebeke Duolji was enfeoffed as zasak Prince Hoshoi Buyantu; his brother Qirib received zasak first-rank taiji rank and governed the Right Wing. They were granted pasture at Hoboksari as the Old Torghut Northern Route under Cebeke Duolji as league chief.

sentences.zh: 四十年，授奇哩布弟阿克薩哈勒扎薩克一等台吉，轄左翼。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year Qirib's younger brother Aksahal was granted zasak first-rank taiji and governed the Left Wing.
translations.idiomatic: In the 40th year Qirib's brother Aksahal was granted zasak first-rank taiji and placed over the Left Wing.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，策伯克多爾濟卒，奇哩布襲，銷右翼印。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year Cebeke Duolji died; Qirib succeeded and the Right Wing seal was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the 43rd year Cebeke Duolji died. Qirib succeeded him and the Right Wing seal was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 五十年，授策伯克多爾濟之子公品級一等台吉恭格車棱扎薩克，詔轄其父屬眾，別鑄右翼扎薩克印賜之。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year Cebeke Duolji's son, gong-rank first-class taiji Gongge Cheleng, was granted zasak; an edict placed him over his father's following, and a separate Right Wing zasak seal was cast and bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the 50th year Cebeke Duolji's son, gong-rank First-class Taiji Gongge Cheleng, received zasak rank. An edict placed him over his father's people, and a new Right Wing zasak seal was cast for him.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，封輔國公。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he was enfeoffed as fuguo gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the 57th year he was made Fuguo Gong.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Daoguang 2.

sentences.zh: 子多爾濟那木扎勒降襲公品級扎薩克一等台吉。

translations.literal: His son Duolji Namuzhale succeeded at a reduced rank as gong-rank zasak first-class taiji.
translations.idiomatic: His son Duolji Namuzhale succeeded at reduced rank as gong-rank zasak First-class Taiji.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，塔城回變，親王策林拉布坦以調兵遲延，為參贊大臣錫霖劾革其爵，以捐輸復之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi, when Muslim rebels rose at Tacheng, Prince Celinlabutan was impeached and stripped of his rank by the frontier counsellor Xi Lin for delay in mobilizing troops; he recovered his title through a contribution payment.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4, during the Muslim uprising at Tacheng, Prince Celinlabutan was impeached and deprived of his title by Counsellor Xi Lin for slow mobilization, then had it restored through a monetary contribution.

sentences.zh: 九年，奎昌等立塔爾巴哈台新界鄂博，奏飭親王策林拉布坦、圖普伸克什克、扎薩克喇扎爾巴達爾隨時留意偵察，舊界亦有割棄。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Kuichang and others erected new border cairns at Tacheng and memorialized ordering Prince Celinlabutan, Tupushenkeshike, and zasak Razharbadar to keep watch and reconnoiter at all times; part of the old border was also ceded.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year Kuichang and others set up new border cairns at Tacheng and ordered Prince Celinlabutan, Tupushenkeshike, and Zasak Razharbadar to maintain constant surveillance. Part of the old boundary was also surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十二年十月，回匪竄擾是部薩巴爾山地方，劫掠牲畜衣物，烏素圖等三台逃散。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twelfth year Muslim rebels raided the Sabar Mountain area of this tribe, plundering livestock and clothing; the three relay stations at Usutu and elsewhere were abandoned and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the 12th year Muslim rebels raided this tribe's Sabar Mountain district, looting livestock and goods, and the three relay stations at Usutu and elsewhere were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 十二月，參贊大臣英廉奏匪已遠竄，飭策林拉布坦等妥為安插被難蒙民，一面將原設七台照舊安設。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Counsellor Ying Lian memorialized that the bandits had fled far away and ordered Celinlabutan and others properly to resettle the afflicted Mongols, while at the same time restoring the seven original relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Counsellor Ying Lian reported that the rebels had fled far off and ordered Celinlabutan and others to resettle the affected Mongols properly while restoring all seven original relay stations.

sentences.zh: 尋論設台站之勞，予黃韁。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, in recognition of the labor of establishing the relay stations, yellow horse trappings were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, for the work of re-establishing the relay stations, yellow horse trappings were awarded.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，以阿爾泰烏梁海復在是部薩里山陰度冬，提每年租馬十成之一給是部三旗作水草之租。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, because the Altai Urianghai again wintered on the northern slopes of this tribe's Sari Mountain, it was proposed that one-tenth of the annual rented horses be given to this tribe's three banners as pasture rent.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1, because the Altai Urianghai again wintered on the north side of this tribe's Sari Mountain, it was proposed that one-tenth of their annual horse rents be paid to the tribe's three banners as grazing fees.

sentences.zh: 是部金礦頗著名，地雜耕牧。

translations.literal: This tribe's gold mines are quite renowned; the land supports both farming and pastoralism.
translations.idiomatic: This division's gold mines are well known, and its land supports both farming and herding.

sentences.zh: 有佐領十四。

translations.literal: There are fourteen assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: It has fourteen assistant commandants.

sentences.zh: 東路凡二旗，跨濟爾哈朗河。

translations.literal: The Eastern Route has two banners in all, spanning the Jierhalang River.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Route has two banners spanning the Jierhalang River.

sentences.zh: 東奎屯河，接甘肅綏來，南南山，西庫爾喀喇烏蘇，北戈壁。

translations.literal: East is the Kuitun River, adjoining Gansu Suilai; south is the Southern Mountains; west is Kur Kara Usu; north is the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuitun River lies to the east adjoining Gansu Suilai; the Southern Mountains to the south; Kur Kara Usu to the west; and the Gobi to the north.

sentences.zh: 渥巴錫族弟巴木巴爾等從渥巴錫來歸。

translations.literal: Ubashi's younger clansmen Bambal and others followed Ubashi in returning to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Ubashi's younger kinsmen Bambal and others followed Ubashi back to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，入覲熱河，封扎薩克多羅畢錫埒勒圖郡王，弟奇布騰固山依特格勒貝子，盟名亦曰烏訥恩素珠克圖。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong he had audience at Rehe; he was enfeoffed as zasak Dorobisirele jin wang; his younger brother Qibiteng was made gushan yitegele beizi; the league name was also Unen Suvquit.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 37 he had audience at Rehe and was enfeoffed as zasak Prince Dorobisirele; his brother Qibiteng was made Gushan Yitegele Beizi. The league was likewise named Unen Suvquit.

sentences.zh: 初隸庫爾喀喇烏蘇大臣，統崙，統受伊犁將軍節制。

translations.literal: At first they were subordinate to the Kur Kara Usu minister and governed together, and all came under the Ili General's command.
translations.idiomatic: At first they were under the Kur Kara Usu resident minister and governed jointly, while all remained under the Ili General.

sentences.zh: 同治末，俄人以北路舊土爾扈特取所屬哈薩克馬駝，執是部貝子普爾普噶丹為質，尋釋之。

translations.literal: At the end of Tongzhi the Russians, because the Northern Route Old Torghut had taken Kazakh horses and camels under their authority, seized this tribe's beizi Purpugadan as a hostage and soon released him.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Tongzhi the Russians seized this division's Beizi Purpugadan as a hostage after Northern Route Old Torghut took Kazakh horses and camels from their jurisdiction, then soon released him.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，給撫卹銀一萬兩。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu ten thousand taels of relief silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Guangxu ten thousand taels in relief silver were granted.

sentences.zh: 十一年，設庫爾喀喇烏蘇同知兼理事銜，釐是部民、蒙交涉事件。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year a subprefect for Kur Kara Usu with concurrent Mongol jurisdiction was established to regulate civil and Mongol intercourse affairs of this tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the 11th year a Kur Kara Usu subprefect with concurrent Mongol jurisdiction was established to handle this division's Han–Mongol affairs.

sentences.zh: 清末，襲郡王者帕勒塔嘗請出洋，又入貴冑學堂，以本旗事為伊犁將軍廣福劾，議處。

translations.literal: At the end of the dynasty Paleta, who had succeeded to the jun wang rank, once asked to go abroad and also entered the school for noble youths; on account of his banner's affairs he was impeached by the Ili General Guang Fu and subject to disciplinary action.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the dynasty Paleta, who had inherited the jun wang title, once sought permission to travel abroad and enrolled in the school for noble youths. Ili General Guang Fu impeached him over banner affairs, and disciplinary measures were ordered.

sentences.zh: 是部共有佐領七。

translations.literal: This tribe has seven assistant commandants in all.
translations.idiomatic: This division has seven assistant commandants in all.

sentences.zh: 西路一旗，當天山之北精河東岸。

translations.literal: The Western Route has one banner, on the east bank of the Jing River north of the Tianshan.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Route has one banner on the east bank of the Jing River north of the Tianshan.

sentences.zh: 東精河屯田，南哈什山陰，西托霍木圖台，北喀喇塔拉額西柯淖爾。

translations.literal: East is Jing River garrison farms; south is the northern slope of Hash Mountain; west is Tuohomutu relay station; north is Karatala Exike Nor.
translations.idiomatic: Jing River garrison farms lie to the east; the north side of Hash Mountain to the south; Tuohomutu relay station to the west; and Karatala Exike Nor to the north.

sentences.zh: 渥巴錫族叔父默們圖從渥巴錫來歸。

translations.literal: Ubashi's paternal uncle Mementu followed Ubashi in returning to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Ubashi's uncle Mementu followed Ubashi back to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，入覲熱河，封扎薩克濟爾噶朗貝勒，賜牧精河，受伊犁將軍節制。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong he had audience at Rehe; he was enfeoffed as zasak jilgalang beile; pasture at the Jing River was granted; he came under the Ili General's command.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 37 he had audience at Rehe and was enfeoffed as zasak Beile Jilgalang, with pasture granted on the Jing River under the Ili General.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，貝勒鄂齊爾以捐餉予雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng Beile Eqi'er was granted double-eyed peacock plumes for a military contribution payment.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10 Beile Eqi'er received double-eyed peacock plumes for a military contribution.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，以被擾，予撫卹銀一萬兩。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu, because they had been harassed, ten thousand taels of relief silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Guangxu, after suffering raids, they received ten thousand taels in relief silver.

sentences.zh: 十三年，設精河同知兼理事銜，釐是部民、蒙交涉事。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year a Jing River subprefect with concurrent Mongol jurisdiction was established to regulate civil and Mongol intercourse affairs of this tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the 13th year a Jing River subprefect with concurrent Mongol jurisdiction was established to handle this division's Han–Mongol affairs.

sentences.zh: 有佐領四。

translations.literal: There are four assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: It has four assistant commandants.

sentences.zh: 新土爾扈特，在科布多西南，當金山南烏隆古河之東。

translations.literal: The New Torghut are southwest of Kobdo, east of the Ulungu River south of the Altai.
translations.idiomatic: The New Torghut lie southwest of Kobdo, east of the Ulungu River on the south side of the Altai.

sentences.zh: 東新和碩特，南胡圖斯山，西與北均阿爾泰烏梁海，東南扎哈沁。

translations.literal: East is the New Khoshut; south is Hutusi Mountain; west and north are both Altai Urianghai; southeast is Zhakhachin.
translations.idiomatic: The New Khoshut lie to the east; Hutusi Mountain to the south; the Altai Urianghai to the west and north; and the Zhakhachin to the southeast.

sentences.zh: 土爾扈特翁罕十四世孫舍棱率諸昆弟附牧伊犁，為準噶爾屬台吉。

translations.literal: Seleng, fourteenth-generation descendant of the Torghut Weng Han, led his brothers in attaching their pastures to Ili and served as a Zungar subject taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Seleng, fourteenth-generation descendant of Torghut Weng Han, led his brothers to graze near Ili as a Zungar subject taiji.

sentences.zh: 大軍徵準噶爾，獲達瓦齊，阿睦爾撒納等以叛相次誅滅，舍棱獨抗不降，竄匿庫庫烏蘇、喀喇塔拉境。

translations.literal: When the great army campaigned against the Zungars, Dawachi was captured and Amursana and others were executed in succession for rebellion; Seleng alone resisted and would not submit, hiding in the Kok Usu and Karatala region.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial armies campaigned against the Zungars, Dawachi was captured and Amursana and other rebels were executed in turn. Seleng alone held out and hid in the Kok Usu and Karatala country.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十三年，詔定邊將軍成袞扎布等剿之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Qianlong an edict ordered the frontier general Cheng Gunzhab and others to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23 an edict ordered Frontier General Cheng Gunzhab and others to hunt him down.

sentences.zh: 舍棱奔俄羅斯，我軍追及之於勒布什河源，舍棱乃詭約降，計戕我副都統唐喀祿，馳逾喀喇瑪嶺，歸額濟勒土爾扈特游牧。

translations.literal: Seleng fled to Russia; our army overtook him at the source of the Lob River; Seleng then falsely agreed to surrender, plotted to kill our vice commander-in-chief Tang Kalu, galloped over the Karama Pass, and returned to the pastures of the Ilek Torghut.
translations.idiomatic: Seleng fled into Russia. Our troops caught him at the headwaters of the Lob, where he feigned surrender, murdered Vice Commander-in-Chief Tang Kalu by stratagem, crossed the Karama Pass, and returned to the Ilek Torghut pastures.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，复誘其汗渥巴錫來踞伊犁，抵他木哈，知內備固，計無所出，不得已，隨渥巴錫歸順。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he again induced his khan Ubashi to come and seize Ili; reaching Tamuha, he knew the interior defenses were solid and could devise no plan; having no alternative, he followed Ubashi in submitting.
translations.idiomatic: In the 36th year he again induced his khan Ubashi to march on Ili. Reaching Tamuha, he found the Qing defenses strong and could see no way forward; left with no choice, he followed Ubashi in submission.

sentences.zh: 詔宥舍棱罪。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned Seleng's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned Seleng's offenses.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，與從子沙喇扣肯入覲熱河，封舍棱多羅弼里克圖郡王，沙喇扣肯烏察喇勒圖貝子，均授扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he and his nephew Sharhoken had audience at Rehe; Seleng was enfeoffed as Dorobiliktu jun wang; Sharhoken was made uchalaltu beizi; both were granted zasak rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the 37th year he and his nephew Sharhoken had audience at Rehe. Seleng was enfeoffed as zasak Prince Dorobiliktu and Sharhoken as Beizi Uchalaltu; both received zasak rank.

sentences.zh: 舍棱所部曰左翼旗，沙喇扣肯曰右翼旗，定盟名曰青色特啟勒圖，舍棱充盟長，沙喇扣肯副之。

translations.literal: Seleng's following was called the Left Wing banner; Sharhoken's the Right Wing banner; the league was named Chingget Kheriltu; Seleng served as league chief and Sharhoken as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Seleng's people formed the Left Wing banner and Sharhoken's the Right Wing. The league was named Chingget Kheriltu, with Seleng as league chief and Sharhoken as deputy.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，詔世襲罔替，隸科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year perpetual hereditary succession without degradation was granted; they were placed under the Kobdo frontier counsellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the 48th year they received perpetual hereditary rank without degradation and were placed under the Kobdo Counsellor.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，回疆軍興，是部輸馬駝助軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang, when the Muslim borderlands campaign began, this tribe supplied horses and camels to assist the army.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6, when war broke out in the Muslim borderlands, this tribe supplied horses and camels for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，是部王、貝子等請捐助軍需，溫旨卻之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng the princes, beiles, and others of this tribe asked to contribute military supplies; a gracious edict declined this.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3 the tribe's princes and beiles offered military contributions; a gracious edict declined them.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，徵是部兵援古城等城，以散潰，撤之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi troops of this tribe were levied to relieve Gucheng and other cities; because they scattered and broke, they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 troops of this tribe were called to relieve Gucheng and other cities, but were withdrawn after they broke and scattered.

sentences.zh: 六年，於是部之布倫託海地方設辦事大臣，以李雲麟為之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year a resident minister was established at Burultokhai in this tribe's territory, with Li Yunlin appointed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year a resident minister was established at Burultokhai in this tribe's territory, with Li Yunlin in the post.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，布倫託海兵民潰變，李雲麟走青格里河。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year the soldiers and civilians at Burultokhai mutinied and broke; Li Yunlin fled to the Qinggeli River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the 7th year the garrison and populace at Burultokhai mutinied. Li Yunlin fled to the Qinggeli River.

sentences.zh: 諭福濟、錫綸前往查辦明瑤、棍噶扎拉參，曉諭解散。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fu Ji and Xi Lun to proceed to investigate Ming Yao and Kungazhala Can and to proclaim instructions for dispersal.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Fu Ji and Xi Lun to investigate Ming Yao and Kungazhala Can and proclaim orders to disband.

sentences.zh: 七月，布倫託海變民竄烏龍古河。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the mutinous populace of Burultokhai fled to the Ulungu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Burultokhai rebels fled to the Ulungu River.

sentences.zh: 九月，以棍噶扎拉參挑噶爾為喇嘛成軍，諭福濟等督率進剿布倫託海變民，撥部庫銀十萬兩解科布多，為布倫託海剿匪及賑濟難民之用。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, because Kungazhala Can had raised an army of lamas at Chagar, Fu Ji and others were ordered to lead troops in suppressing the Burultokhai mutineers; one hundred thousand taels of Board of Revenue silver were allocated to Kobdo for suppressing bandits at Burultokhai and relieving afflicted refugees.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, after Kungazhala Can raised a lama army at Chagar, Fu Ji and others were ordered to lead the campaign against the Burultokhai rebels. One hundred thousand taels of Board of Revenue silver were sent to Kobdo for suppression and refugee relief.

sentences.zh: 調福濟為布倫託海辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Fu Ji was transferred to be resident minister at Burultokhai.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji was transferred to serve as resident minister at Burultokhai.

sentences.zh: 十月，以守科布多城出力，予是部郡王凌扎棟魯布親王銜。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, for exertions in defending Kobdo city, this tribe's jun wang Linzhadonglubu was granted the qin wang title.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, for his role in defending Kobdo, this tribe's Jun Wang Linzhadonglubu was granted the qin wang title.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以是部仍屬科布多管轄。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month this tribe was confirmed as still under Kobdo jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the tribe was confirmed as remaining under Kobdo jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，以哈薩克圍殺布倫託海變民，命是部郡王凌扎棟魯布進剿。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, because the Kazakhs had surrounded and killed Burultokhai mutineers, this tribe's jun wang Linzhadonglubu was ordered to advance in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the 8th year, after Kazakhs surrounded and killed Burultokhai rebels, the tribe's Jun Wang Linzhadonglubu was ordered to advance against them.

sentences.zh: 四月，福濟遷烏里雅蘇台將軍，文碩代之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Fu Ji was transferred to Uliastai General; Wen Shuo replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Fu Ji was made Uliastai General and Wen Shuo replaced him at Burultokhai.

sentences.zh: 七月，布倫託海變民傷俄國卡兵，棍噶扎拉參營於克林河，諭福濟等疾籌進剿，飭知遵行。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Burultokhai mutineers wounded Russian border troops; Kungazhala Can encamped on the Kelin River; Fu Ji and others were ordered urgently to plan an advance in suppression, with instructions to comply.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Burultokhai rebels wounded Russian border troops. Kungazhala Can camped on the Kelin River, and Fu Ji and others were urgently ordered to organize a punitive advance.

sentences.zh: 是月棍噶扎拉參剿變民於和博克托里，勝之。

translations.literal: That month Kungazhala Can suppressed mutineers at Hoboktori and was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: That month Kungazhala Can defeated the rebels at Hoboktori.

sentences.zh: 八月，棍噶扎拉參复布倫託海，變民降，收撫之，賊首張匊等伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Kungazhala Can recovered Burultokhai; the mutineers surrendered and were pacified; the bandit chiefs Zhang Ju and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Kungazhala Can recovered Burultokhai. The rebels surrendered and were pacified, and the ringleaders Zhang Ju and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 諭福濟等籌給布倫託海難民口食。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fu Ji and others to arrange provisions of food for Burultokhai refugees.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Fu Ji and others to provide food for Burultokhai refugees.

sentences.zh: 九月，命塔城額魯特暫安舊居，阿爾泰山俗眾居青格里河。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Tacheng Oirats were ordered temporarily to settle in their former dwellings, and the common people of the Altai Mountains to reside on the Qinggeli River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Tacheng Oirats were ordered to remain temporarily in their former homes, and the Altai populace to settle on the Qinggeli River.

sentences.zh: 十月，徙布倫託海人眾於阿爾泰山，予布倫託海在防之索倫及綠營官兵銀兩。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the people of Burultokhai were moved to the Altai Mountains, and silver was granted to the Solon and Green Standard officers and soldiers stationed in defense at Burultokhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Burultokhai population was moved to the Altai, and silver was granted to the Solon and Green Standard troops who had garrisoned the post.

sentences.zh: 十一月，裁新設布倫託海辦事大臣，撤回旗、綠官兵，命索倫、額魯特領隊大臣及棍噶扎拉參應辦事宜統歸科布多參贊大臣經理，改派奎昌辦布倫託海與俄分界事宜。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the newly established Burultokhai resident minister was abolished; banner and Green Standard troops were withdrawn; affairs that the Solon and Oirat leading detachments and Kungazhala Can were to handle were all placed under the Kobdo frontier counsellor's management; Kuichang was reassigned to handle Burultokhai boundary matters with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the new Burultokhai resident minister was abolished and banner and Green Standard troops withdrawn. Duties of the Solon and Oirat leading detachments and Kungazhala Can were consolidated under the Kobdo Counsellor, and Kuichang was assigned to handle the Burultokhai boundary with Russia.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月，肅州回匪竄是部貝子旗布拉噶河一帶，科布多參贊大臣托倫布等調回駐察罕淖爾之黑龍江馬隊暨蒙古馬隊，分赴布拉噶河防剿。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twelfth year Suzhou Muslim rebels raided the Bulage River area of this tribe's beizi banner; the Kobdo counsellor Tolunbu and others recalled the Heilongjiang cavalry and Mongol cavalry stationed at Chahan Nor and sent them in separate detachments to Bulage River to defend and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the 12th year Suzhou Muslim rebels raided the Bulage River district of this tribe's beizi banner. Kobdo Counsellor Tolunbu and others recalled the Heilongjiang and Mongol cavalry from Chahan Nor and sent them to Bulage River to defend and suppress the raiders.

sentences.zh: 十一月，烏魯木齊領隊大臣錫綸奏：「七月十六日，率所募民勇自阿爾泰山南移營烏龍古河南岸，聞東路布爾根河一帶有警，科布多屬之扎哈沁及和碩特、土爾扈特邊界皆被擾，阿爾泰附近之烏梁海台站逃散，匪由和碩特、土爾扈特等喇嘛營子西竄至青格里河。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Urumqi leading detachment minister Xi Lun memorialized: "On the sixteenth day of the seventh month, leading the militia I had recruited, I moved camp from south of the Altai to the south bank of the Ulungu River; hearing that there was an alarm along the Burgen River on the eastern route, the Zhakhachin under Kobdo and the Khoshut and Torghut borderlands were all harassed; Urianghai relay stations near the Altai scattered and fled; the bandits fled west from Khoshut and Torghut lama encampments to the Qinggeli River."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Urumqi Leading Detachment Minister Xi Lun memorialized: "On the sixteenth day of the seventh month I led the militia I had raised south from the Altai and moved camp to the south bank of the Ulungu. Reports came of trouble along the Burgen River in the east: Kobdo's Zhakhachin and the Khoshut and Torghut frontiers were all raided, Urianghai relay stations near the Altai were abandoned, and the rebels fled west from Khoshut and Torghut lama camps toward the Qinggeli River."

sentences.zh: 十二月，錫綸奏：「回匪擾及烏梁海部落，臣帶民勇民團追匪至噶扎爾巴爾淖爾，匪已由薩勒布爾山南竄沙山子，即由山北取道布凌河，疾馳至霍博克河上游之庫克辛倉，探得匪在河下游之科科墨頓林木中紮營五座，於夜分潛師進薄賊壘，擊潰賊三營，又取後一營，匪眾敗遁，尋由阿雅爾淖爾竄綏來縣之大小拐，回瑪那斯。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Xi Lun memorialized: "Muslim rebels harassed the Urianghai tribe; I led militia and local defense corps in pursuit of the bandits to Gazharbar Nor; the bandits had already fled south of the Salbur Mountains to Shashanzi; I then took the route north of the mountains along the Buling River, galloping swiftly to Kukexincang at the upper reaches of the Hobok River; scouts learned that the bandits had pitched five camps in the Kokomoton woods on the lower river; at night I secretly advanced troops to close on the rebel stockades, routed three rebel camps, and also took the rearmost camp; the rebel masses were defeated and fled; shortly thereafter they fled from Ayar Nor to the Greater and Lesser Guai of Suilai county and returned to Manas."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xi Lun reported: "Muslim rebels raided the Urianghai tribe. I pursued them with militia and local defense corps to Gazharbar Nor. The rebels had fled south of the Salbur Mountains to Shashanzi, so I took the northern route along the Buling River and rode hard to Kukexincang on the upper Hobok. Scouts found five rebel camps in the Kokomoton woods downstream. At night I led a stealth attack on their stockades, routed three camps and captured a fourth; the rebels broke and fled, then passed Ayar Nor to the Greater and Lesser Guai in Suilai county and returned to Manas."

sentences.zh: 科布多幫辦大臣保英奏：「十月十九日，親率馬隊由吉慶淖爾西行，二十七日抵土爾扈特之青格里河。

translations.literal: The Kobdo assistant minister Bao Ying memorialized: "On the nineteenth day of the tenth month I personally led the cavalry column west from Jiqing Nor; on the twenty-seventh day we reached the Torghut Qinggeli River.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo Assistant Minister Bao Ying reported: "On the nineteenth day of the tenth month I led the cavalry west from Jiqing Nor and reached the Torghut Qinggeli River on the twenty-seventh.

sentences.zh: 賊竄布倫託海，經錫綸進剿，斬獲甚多。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Burultokhai; pursuing through Xi Lun, many were beheaded and captured.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Burultokhai. Xi Lun pursued them and killed or captured many.

sentences.zh: 匪已西竄，臣將官兵駐青格里河，檄飭烏梁海、土爾扈特、和碩特、扎哈沁速將軍台移回原處安設。」

translations.literal: The bandits had already fled west; I stationed officers and soldiers at the Qinggeli River and issued orders to the Urianghai, Torghut, Khoshut, and Zhakhachin swiftly to move the military relay stations back and reinstall them at their original sites."
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had fled west. I garrisoned troops on the Qinggeli River and ordered the Urianghai, Torghut, Khoshut, and Zhakhachin to restore their military relay stations to their original locations without delay."

sentences.zh: 其後烏魯木齊、瑪納斯諸城克復，是部始息警。

translations.literal: Thereafter Urumqi, Manas, and other cities were recovered, and this tribe at last had its alarm quieted.
translations.idiomatic: After Urumqi, Manas, and other cities were recovered, this tribe at last ceased to be on alert.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年，劃科城中、俄界幫辦大臣額爾慶額安插歸中國之哈薩克，以奎峒山左右暨哈巴河源諸山為夏季游牧，以阿拉別克河東暨果裡子克河、哈巴河、阿拉克台為冬季游牧。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu the Kobdo Sino-Russian boundary assistant minister Ergeqing'e settled Kazakhs returning to China, using the mountains to the left and right of Kuitung and the headwaters of the Haba River as summer pasture, and east of the Alabieke River together with the Guolizike River, Haba River, and Alaketai as winter pasture.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 9 the Kobdo Sino-Russian boundary assistant minister Ergeqing'e resettled Kazakhs who had returned to China, assigning the Kuitung ranges and Haba River headwaters for summer grazing and the country east of the Alabieke River, together with the Guolizike, Haba, and Alaketai rivers, for winter grazing.

sentences.zh: 實皆是部地。

translations.literal: These were in fact all this tribe's territory.
translations.idiomatic: All of this was in fact this tribe's land.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，瑞洵奏創修布倫託海渠工，開辦屯田，給土爾扈王旗、貝子旗借用駝只幫價銀，飭扎哈沁、土爾扈特、烏梁海左右翼擇水草較好地，從扎哈沁沙扎蓋台起，至布倫託海止，安設十三台。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Rui Xun memorialized to create and repair Burultokhai canal works and open military colonies; camels were lent to the Torghut wang banner and beizi banner with subsidy silver; Zhakhachin, Torghut, and the left and right wings of the Urianghai were ordered to choose better pasture lands; from Zhakhachin Shazagaitai to Burultokhai, thirteen relay stations were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the 29th year Rui Xun proposed repairing the Burultokhai canal, opening military colonies, and lending camels to the Torghut wang and beizi banners with subsidy silver. He ordered the Zhakhachin, Torghut, and Urianghai left and right wings to select better pasture and established thirteen relay stations from Zhakhachin Shazagaitai to Burultokhai.

sentences.zh: 二十九年閏五月，錄科布多所屬各旗保護俄商遺棄貨物有裨大局之勞，予土爾扈特正盟長扎薩克郡王密錫克棟古魯布紫韁，副盟長扎薩克貝子瑪克蘇爾扎布雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-ninth year, recording the merit of the banners under Kobdo in protecting abandoned Russian merchant goods to the benefit of the overall situation, the Torghut principal league chief zasak jun wang Mishikedonggulubu was granted purple reins, and the deputy league chief zasak beizi Maxuerzhabu double-eyed peacock plumes.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of the 29th year, in recognition of Kobdo banners' service in safeguarding abandoned Russian merchant goods, the Torghut principal league chief, zasak Prince Mishikedonggulubu, received purple reins and the deputy league chief, zasak Beizi Maxuerzhabu, received double-eyed peacock plumes.

sentences.zh: 三十二年十二月，劃科布多、阿爾泰分轄之界，以是部二旗及新和碩特一旗、阿爾泰烏梁海七旗均隸阿爾泰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the thirty-second year the boundary between Kobdo and Altai jurisdictions was delineated; this tribe's two banners, one New Khoshut banner, and seven Altai Urianghai banners were all placed under Altai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the 32nd year the Kobdo–Altai jurisdictional boundary was fixed, and this tribe's two banners, one New Khoshut banner, and seven Altai Urianghai banners were all placed under Altai.

sentences.zh: 是部地兼耕牧，有金礦。

translations.literal: This tribe's land combines farming and pastoralism; there are gold mines.
translations.idiomatic: This tribe's territory supports both farming and herding, and gold mines are found there.

sentences.zh: 布爾津河通輪船。

translations.literal: The Burqin River is navigable by steamships.
translations.idiomatic: Steamships can navigate the Burqin River.

sentences.zh: 共有佐領三。

translations.literal: There are three assistant commandants in all.
translations.idiomatic: It has three assistant commandants in all.

sentences.zh: 近是部者，有哈弼察克新和碩特。

translations.literal: Near this tribe is the Habchak New Khoshut.
translations.idiomatic: Near this tribe lies the Habchak New Khoshut.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十六年，和碩特台吉巴雅爾拉瑚族蒙袞率屬來歸，原附新土爾扈特貝子沙喇扣肯之旗。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong, Khoshut taiji Bayarlahu's clansman Menggun led his following in submission; he had originally been attached to New Torghut beizi Sharhoken's banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 36 the Khoshut taiji Bayarlahu's clansman Menggun led his people in submission. He had formerly been attached to New Torghut Beizi Sharhoken's banner.

sentences.zh: 詔予一等台吉，給半佐領，令其附居。

translations.literal: An edict granted him first-class taiji rank, gave half an assistant commandant, and ordered him to reside as an attachment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted him first-class taiji rank and half an assistant commandant and ordered him to settle as an attached community.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，移杜爾伯特近處哈密察克游牧。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year pasture was moved to Hamichak near the Dorbod.
translations.idiomatic: In the 57th year their pastures were moved to Hamichak near the Dorbod.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，科布多參贊大臣奏蒙袞妻察彥率子佈彥克什克詣言生齒日繁，求給扎薩克印，不食俸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing the Kobdo counsellor memorialized that Menggun's wife Chayan led her son Buyankeshike to report that the population grew daily and to request a zasak seal, without taking stipend.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 the Kobdo Counsellor reported that Menggun's widow Chayan brought her son Buyankeshike to say their numbers were growing daily and to request a zasak seal without stipend.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，回疆軍興，後至咸豐初，是部皆偕杜爾伯特諸部捐馬駝、捐餉助軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang the Xinjiang campaign began; down to the beginning of Xianfeng this tribe together with the Dorbod tribes all donated horses and camels and contributed funds to aid the army.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xinjiang campaign began in Daoguang 6, this tribe, like the Dorbod, repeatedly donated horses, camels, and funds to support the army through the early Xianfeng period.

sentences.zh: 同治末，回匪北竄，是部與新土爾扈特同被擾。

translations.literal: At the end of Tongzhi Muslim rebels fled north; this tribe and the New Torghut were both harassed.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Tongzhi, Muslim rebels fled north and both this tribe and the New Torghut were raided.

sentences.zh: 署伊犁將軍榮全以商論伊犁事，自科布多西行，是部設台供支。

translations.literal: Acting Ili General Rongquan, going west from Kobdo to negotiate Ili affairs, was supplied by relay stations this tribe established.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Ili General Rongquan traveled west from Kobdo to negotiate Ili affairs, and this tribe set up relay stations to supply him.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十九年，錄庚子舉辦防團保護俄貨之勞，予扎薩克台吉布彥克什克鎮國公銜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Guangxu, recording merit for organizing defense corps in 1900 to protect Russian goods, zasak taiji Buyankeshike was granted the Defender of the State ducal title.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29, for organizing defense corps in 1900 to protect Russian goods, zasak taiji Buyankeshike was granted the Defender of the State ducal title.

sentences.zh: 三十三年正月，卒，以子達木鼎第得恩襲。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-third year he died; his son Damiding inherited by grace.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first month of the 33rd year, and his son Damiding succeeded by imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 初有出缺請旨之例，實亦世襲。

translations.literal: Initially there was the practice of requesting imperial appointment on a vacancy, but in fact it was hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies were formally referred to the throne, but the office was in practice hereditary.

sentences.zh: 牧地東扎哈沁，南與西皆新土爾扈特，北阿爾泰烏梁海。

translations.literal: Pasturelands: east, Zhakhachin; south and west, all New Torghut; north, Altai Urianghai.
translations.idiomatic: Its pastures adjoin Zhakhachin on the east, New Torghut on the south and west, and Altai Urianghai on the north.

sentences.zh: 有佐領一。

translations.literal: There is one assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: It has one assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 和碩特部，在新疆焉耆府北。

translations.literal: The Khoshut tribe is north of Yanqi prefecture in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshut tribe lies north of Yanqi prefecture in Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 東烏沙克塔爾，南開都河，西小珠勒都斯，北察罕通格山。

translations.literal: East, Wushaktar; south, the Kaidu River; west, the Little Ili River; north, Mount Chahan Tongge.
translations.idiomatic: On the east lies Wushaktar; on the south the Kaidu River; on the west the Little Ili River; and on the north Mount Chahan Tongge.

sentences.zh: 舊為四衛拉特之一，係出元太祖弟哈布圖哈薩爾。

translations.literal: Formerly one of the four Oirat confederations, descended from Genghis Khan's younger brother Khabutu Hasar.
translations.idiomatic: They were formerly one of the four Oirat confederations and traced descent from Genghis Khan's younger brother Khabutu Hasar.

sentences.zh: 有博貝密爾咱者，始稱汗。

translations.literal: One Bobeyimirzha first styled himself khan.
translations.idiomatic: A certain Bobeyimirzha was the first to take the title of khan.

sentences.zh: 子哈尼諾顏洪果爾嗣之，有子六，牧青海、西套、伊犁諸境。

translations.literal: His son Khani noyan Hongguo'er succeeded him; he had six sons who pastured the regions of Qinghai, Xitao, and Ili.
translations.idiomatic: His son Khani Noyan Hongguo'er succeeded him and had six sons who grazed in Qinghai, Xitao, and Ili.

sentences.zh: 詳青海厄魯特部傳。

translations.literal: For details see the biography of the Qinghai Oirat tribes.
translations.idiomatic: See the biography of the Qinghai Oirat tribes for further particulars.

sentences.zh: 其第三子昆都倫烏巴什，第四子圖魯拜琥，裔蕃衍。

translations.literal: His third son Qundlun Ubashi and fourth son Tulubaihu had descendants who multiplied.
translations.idiomatic: His third son Qundlun Ubashi and fourth son Tulubaihu left numerous descendants.

sentences.zh: 圖魯拜琥號顧實汗，其裔或稱青海厄魯特，設扎薩克二十有一；

translations.literal: Tulubaihu styled himself Gushi Khan; his descendants were called Qinghai Oirat and established twenty-one zasaks;
translations.idiomatic: Tulubaihu took the title Gushi Khan. His descendants, known as the Qinghai Oirats, established twenty-one zasaks;

sentences.zh: 或稱阿拉善厄魯特，設扎薩克一；

translations.literal: or were called Alashan Oirat and established one zasak;
translations.idiomatic: others were known as the Alashan Oirats and had one zasak;

sentences.zh: 或隸察哈爾旗，設爵三，皆不著。

translations.literal: or were subordinate to Chahar banners with three titles established—all are not recorded here.
translations.idiomatic: still others were under Chahar banners with three titles—all are omitted here.

sentences.zh: 和碩特部昆都倫烏巴什，號都爾格齊諾顏，子十六：長邁瑪達賴烏巴什，次烏巴什琿台吉，次多爾濟，次額爾克岱青鄂克綽特布，次第巴卓哩克圖，次噶布楚諾顏，次蒙固，次青巴圖爾，次伊納克巴圖爾，次伊勒察克，次賽巴克，次哈喇庫濟，次羅卜藏達什，次塔爾巴，次色棱，次朋素克。

translations.literal: The Khoshut Qundlun Ubashi, styled Dorgochi Noyan, had sixteen sons: the eldest Maidalai Ubashi, next Ubashi hontaiji, next Dorji, next Erkedaiqing Ekechuotebu, next Dibacholitu, next Gabchu Noyan, next Mengu, next Qing Batür, next Inak Batür, next Ilechak, next Saibak, next Halakuji, next Lobzang Dash, next Tarba, next Seleng, next Pungsuk.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshut leader Qundlun Ubashi, styled Dorgochi Noyan, had sixteen sons: Maidalai Ubashi, Ubashi Hontaiji, Dorji, Erkedaiqing Ekechuotebu, Dibacholitu, Gabchu Noyan, Mengu, Qing Batür, Inak Batür, Ilechak, Saibak, Halakuji, Lobzang Dash, Tarba, Seleng, and Pungsuk.

sentences.zh: 今和碩特設扎薩克四，皆多爾濟及額爾克岱青鄂克綽特布裔。

translations.literal: Today the Khoshut have four zasaks established, all descendants of Dorji and Erkedaiqing Ekechuotebu.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshut now have four zasaks, all descended from Dorji and Erkedaiqing Ekechuotebu.

sentences.zh: 崇德七年，昆都倫烏巴什遣索諾木從達賴喇嘛使貢駝馬，賜布幣及朝鮮貢物。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongde, Qundlun Ubashi sent Sonam with the Dalai Lama's envoy to present tribute of camels and horses; cloth and Korean tribute goods were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 7 Qundlun Ubashi sent Sonam with the Dalai Lama's envoy to present camels and horses as tribute and received cloth and Korean tribute goods in return.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，貢所產馬及黑狐皮。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi he presented tribute of locally produced horses and black fox fur.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 8 he presented local horses and black fox pelts as tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年，复貢駝馬。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he again presented tribute of camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he again presented camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 嗣數遣使至。

translations.literal: Subsequently envoys were sent several times.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent on several later occasions.

sentences.zh: 康熙十六年，邁瑪達賴烏巴什子丹津琿台吉遣達爾漢宰桑入貢。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Kangxi, Maidalai Ubashi's son Danjin hontaiji sent the Darhan zasang to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16 Maidalai Ubashi's son Danjin Hontaiji sent the Darhan zasang to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，復遣杭勒岱等至，諸昆弟遣使從，凡百餘人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he again sent Hanglai and others; all the brothers sent envoys following, over one hundred persons in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he again sent Hanglai and others, with envoys from all his brothers—more than one hundred men in all.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，定四衛拉特貢例，使入關以二百人為額，諭所部知之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the tribute regulations for the four Oirat confederations were fixed: envoys entering the pass were limited to two hundred persons; the tribes were instructed to know this.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the tribute regulations for the four Oirat confederations were fixed at two hundred men per embassy entering the pass, and the tribes were so informed.

sentences.zh: 詳杜爾伯特部傳。

translations.literal: For details see the biography of the Dorbod tribe.
translations.idiomatic: See the biography of the Dorbod tribe for further particulars.

sentences.zh: 時準噶爾稍強，和碩特族懼其威，咸奉令。

translations.literal: At that time the Zungar had grown somewhat strong; the Khoshut clans feared their power and all obeyed their orders.
translations.idiomatic: The Zungar had grown stronger, and the Khoshut clans, fearing their power, all obeyed their commands.

sentences.zh: 後噶爾丹亂定，顧實汗諸子姓游牧青海者咸內附。

translations.literal: After Galdan's rebellion was settled, all of Gushi Khan's descendants and clansmen who pastured in Qinghai submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: After Galdan's rebellion was suppressed, all of Gushi Khan's descendants grazing in Qinghai submitted to the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹從子策妄阿喇布坦偪和碩特族與同處，表請青海復舊業如噶爾丹時，將陰謀為己屬。

translations.literal: Galdan's nephew Tsewang Araptan pressed the Khoshut clans living together with him and memorialized requesting that Qinghai restore its old holdings as in Galdan's time, intending secretly to make them his subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan's nephew Tsewang Araptan pressed the Khoshut who lived near him and petitioned to restore Qinghai's old pastures as under Galdan, intending secretly to bring them under his control.

sentences.zh: 上燭其奸，諭責之，令遣和碩特歸舊牧，勿私據，不從。

translations.literal: The emperor saw through the treachery, rebuked him with an edict, and ordered the Khoshut sent back to their old pastures and not seized privately; he did not obey.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor saw through the scheme, rebuked him, and ordered the Khoshut returned to their old pastures without private seizure, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 有羅卜藏車凌者，多爾濟曾孫也，策妄阿喇布坦以女妻之。

translations.literal: There was Lobzang Chiling, a great-great-grandson of Dorji; Tsewang Araptan gave him his daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: One Lobzang Chiling, a great-great-grandson of Dorji, received Tsewang Araptan's daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年，靖邊大將軍傅爾丹屯科布多，將擊準噶爾。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng the Pacify the Borders General-in-Chief Furdan encamped at Kobdo and was about to attack the Zungar.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8 Pacify-the-Borders General-in-Chief Furdan encamped at Kobdo to attack the Zungar.

sentences.zh: 或告曰：「噶爾丹策淩以兵萬授羅卜藏車凌，遣禦哈薩克，設汛阿里馬圖沙拉伯勒境。

translations.literal: Someone reported: "Galdan Tsering gave Lobzang Chiling ten thousand troops and sent him to defend against the Kazakhs, establishing garrison posts on the Alimatu Shalabole border.
translations.idiomatic: Someone reported: "Galdan Tsering gave Lobzang Chiling ten thousand men to hold the Kazakhs and posted garrisons on the Alimatu Shalabole frontier.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏車凌棄之，率戶三千餘由噶斯走青海，將內附。

translations.literal: Lobzang Chiling abandoned it, led more than three thousand households via Gas to Qinghai, and was about to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Chiling abandoned the post, led more than three thousand households through Gas into Qinghai, and prepared to submit.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹策淩遣宰桑烏喇特巴哈曼集等追之，為所敗。

translations.literal: Galdan Tsering sent the zasang Urut Bahamanji and others in pursuit; they were defeated by him.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Tsering sent the zasang Urut Bahamanji and others in pursuit, but Lobzang Chiling defeated them.

sentences.zh: 復遣喀喇沁宰桑都噶爾往襲，不之及也。」

translations.literal: He again sent the Kharchin zasang Dugar to raid, but did not catch up."
translations.idiomatic: He then sent the Kharchin zasang Dugar to attack, but failed to overtake them."

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹以聞，詔副都統達鼐：「偵防噶斯路。

translations.literal: Furdan reported this; an edict to Vice Commander-in-Chief Datnai said: "Scout and guard the Gas route.
translations.idiomatic: Furdan reported this. An edict to Vice Commander-in-Chief Datnai ordered: "Scout and secure the Gas route.

sentences.zh: 俟羅卜藏車凌降，遣入覲，以兵監從眾，置內汛，勿墮詭降計。」

translations.literal: When Lobzang Chiling surrenders, send him for audience; use troops to escort and monitor his followers; establish inner garrison posts; do not fall for a feigned-surrender stratagem."
translations.idiomatic: When Lobzang Chiling surrenders, send him to audience under armed escort, post inner garrisons, and do not fall for a false surrender."

sentences.zh: 久之，羅卜藏車凌不至。

translations.literal: After a long time Lobzang Chiling did not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Chiling never came.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，大軍徵達瓦齊，抵伊犁。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong the great army campaigned against Dawachi and reached Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 the imperial army campaigned against Dawachi and reached Ili.

sentences.zh: 有善披嶺集賽之得木齊蘇克都爾格齊霍什哈及古里特鄂拓克之得木齊和通喀喇博羅莽鼐、伊什克特咱瑪博勒等，告舊為羅卜藏車凌屬，獻籍六百餘戶。

translations.literal: Demchi Sukdorgochi Hoshiha of Shanpi Lingjisai and Demchi Hotongkaraboromangnai of Gurit Otok, Ishikt Zamabole, and others reported that they had formerly been Lobzang Chiling's subjects and presented registers of more than six hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Demchi Sukdorgochi Hoshiha of Shanpi Lingjisai, Demchi Hotongkaraboromangnai of Gurit Otok, Ishikt Zamabole, and others said they had formerly been Lobzang Chiling's subjects and presented registers of more than six hundred households.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏車凌子曰諾爾布敦多克，游牧額琳哈畢爾噶，遣長子鄂齊爾馳降。

translations.literal: Lobzang Chiling's son Norbudundok pastured at Ereen Khabirga and sent his eldest son Eqi'er galloping to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Chiling's son Norbudundok grazed at Ereen Khabirga and sent his eldest son Eqi'er in haste to surrender.

sentences.zh: 定北將軍班第遣招其族，台吉三濟特聞之，獻籍三百戶。

translations.literal: Pacify the North General Bandi sent to recruit his clan; taiji Sanjit heard of this and presented a register of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Pacify-the-North General Bandi sent to recruit his clan, and taiji Sanjit, hearing of this, presented a register of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 丹津琿台吉子曰阿喇布坦，有子二：長噶爾丹敦多布，生沙克都爾曼濟；

translations.literal: Danjin hontaiji's son was Alabutan; he had two sons: the elder Galdandundok, who fathered Shakdur Manji;
translations.idiomatic: Danjin Hontaiji's son Alabutan had two sons: the elder Galdandundok, who fathered Shakdur Manji;

sentences.zh: 次敦多布車凌，生明噶特。

translations.literal: the younger Dundobchiling, who fathered Minggat.
translations.idiomatic: and the younger Dundobchiling, who fathered Minggat.

sentences.zh: 達瓦齊善沙克都爾曼濟，倚任之。

translations.literal: Dawachi favored Shakdur Manji and relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: Dawachi favored Shakdur Manji and relied heavily on him.

sentences.zh: 小策淩敦多卜孫訥默庫濟爾噶爾與達瓦齊構兵，沙克都爾曼濟擊之，殲其孥。

translations.literal: The younger Tsewang Dorji's grandson Nemekujilgar fought Dawachi; Shakdur Manji attacked him and exterminated his family.
translations.idiomatic: The younger Tsewang Dorji's grandson Nemekujilgar fought Dawachi; Shakdur Manji attacked him and wiped out his family.

sentences.zh: 班第等至，達瓦齊竄格登，沙克都爾曼濟乃降。

translations.literal: When Bandi and the others arrived, Dawachi fled to Geden, and Shakdur Manji then surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: When Bandi arrived, Dawachi fled to Geden and Shakdur Manji surrendered.

sentences.zh: 有班珠爾者，顧實汗裔也，與輝特阿睦爾撒納異父同母，陰比之。

translations.literal: There was Bandidor, a descendant of Gushi Khan, who shared the same mother but different fathers with the Khoit Amursana and secretly sided with him.
translations.idiomatic: Bandidor, a descendant of Gushi Khan, was Amursana's half-brother on the mother's side and secretly supported him.

sentences.zh: 前避達瓦齊亂來歸，授多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Earlier, fleeing Dawachi's turmoil, he had come in submission and was granted the rank of doroi jun wang.
translations.idiomatic: He had earlier fled Dawachi's turmoil and submitted, and was made a doroi prince of the second degree.

sentences.zh: 詔俟厄魯特定，將以為和碩特汗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that when the Oirat were settled he would be made Khan of the Khoshut.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that once the Oirat were pacified he would be made Khan of the Khoshut.

sentences.zh: 時從大軍抵伊犁，私奪諾爾布敦多克、沙克都爾曼濟諸台吉屬產。

translations.literal: At that time, following the great army to Ili, he privately seized the property of Norbudundok, Shakdur Manji, and other taijis' followers.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Ili with the main army, he privately seized the herds and property of Norbudundok, Shakdur Manji, and other taijis.

sentences.zh: 班第禁之，乃稍戢。

translations.literal: Bandi forbade this, and he then somewhat restrained himself.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi forbade this, and he restrained himself somewhat.

sentences.zh: 尋定入覲次，以沙克都爾曼濟及班珠爾列初班，三濟特、鄂齊爾次之。

translations.literal: Soon the order of audience was fixed: Shakdur Manji and Bandidor were placed in the first contingent; Sanjit and Eqi'er in the second.
translations.idiomatic: The order of audience was soon fixed: Shakdur Manji and Bandidor in the first contingent, Sanjit and Eqi'er in the second.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納阻其行，詭稱沙克都爾曼濟將叛迎達瓦齊，請以班珠爾屯特穆爾圖諾爾護降眾，班第斥詞妄。

translations.literal: Amursana obstructed their journey, falsely claiming Shakdur Manji would rebel and welcome Dawachi, and requesting that Bandidor be stationed at Temurtu Nor to guard the surrendering masses; Bandi denounced the words as false.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana blocked their journey, falsely claiming Shakdur Manji would rebel and welcome Dawachi, and asked that Bandidor guard the surrendering tribes at Temurtu Nor. Bandi rejected the charge as false.

sentences.zh: 班珠爾詭入覲，赴塔密爾牧，取阿睦爾撒納孥，謀偕遁，參贊大臣阿蘭泰擒之。

translations.literal: Bandidor feigned going to audience, went to pasture at Tamir, seized Amursana's family, and plotted to flee together; Counsellor Alantai captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Bandidor pretended to go to audience, moved to the Tamir pastures, seized Amursana's family, and plotted escape. Counsellor Alantai captured him.

sentences.zh: 沙克都爾曼濟入覲避暑山莊，上御澹泊敬誠殿受朝，詔封和碩特汗，授盟長，諭董所屬勤養教，圖生聚。

translations.literal: Shakdur Manji had audience at the Mountain Villa for Escaping the Heat; the emperor received homage in the Hall of Plainness, Sincerity, and Respect, issued an edict enfeoffing him as Khan of the Khoshut, granted him league chief rank, and instructed him to oversee his followers in diligently nurturing religion and seeking population growth.
translations.idiomatic: Shakdur Manji had audience at the Mountain Villa. The emperor received him in the Hall of Plainness, Sincerity, and Respect, enfeoffed him as Khan of the Khoshut, made him league chief, and urged him to nurture religion among his people and rebuild their numbers.

sentences.zh: 三濟特、鄂齊爾繼至，詔授三濟特扎薩克一等台吉，鄂齊爾閒散一等台吉，遣歸牧。

translations.literal: Sanjit and Eqi'er arrived afterward; an edict granted Sanjit the rank of zasak first-class taiji and Eqi'er unattached first-class taiji, and they were sent back to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjit and Eqi'er followed. Sanjit was granted zasak first-class taiji rank and Eqi'er unattached first-class taiji, and both were sent back to their pastures.

sentences.zh: 定西將軍策楞將以大兵剿阿睦爾撒納，詔沙克都爾曼濟往會，甫就道，諜者以阿睦爾撒納據伊犁告。

translations.literal: Pacify the West General Celeng was about to lead a great army to suppress Amursana; an edict ordered Shakdur Manji to join him; he had just set out when spies reported that Amursana held Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Pacify-the-West General Celeng was preparing a major campaign against Amursana and ordered Shakdur Manji to join him. Shakdur Manji had just set out when scouts reported that Amursana held Ili.

sentences.zh: 諭遣親信宰桑馳諭所部備兵，勿為逆煽，而以身從大軍擊賊。

translations.literal: He was instructed to send trusted zasangs in haste to instruct his tribes to ready troops, not to be incited by the rebel, and himself to follow the great army in attacking the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He was told to send trusted zasangs in haste to ready his tribes for war without heeding rebel incitement, while he himself marched with the main army.

sentences.zh: 班珠爾械至禁獄所，請遺三濟特、鄂齊爾書，令和碩特眾分剿阿逆。

translations.literal: Bandidor, brought in irons to the prison, requested that letters be sent to Sanjit and Eqi'er ordering the Khoshut masses to divide in suppressing the rebel Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: Bandidor, imprisoned in irons, asked that letters be sent to Sanjit and Eqi'er ordering the Khoshut to join in suppressing the rebel Amursana.

sentences.zh: 三濟特既得書，言諾爾布敦多克、沙克都爾曼濟皆鄰牧，且族台吉瑪尼巴圖、巴蘇泰、瑪賚烏巴什、弩庫特圖魯孟克、阿穆爾弩斯海、薩望等皆無異志，當以書遺之。

translations.literal: When Sanjit received the letter he said Norbudundok and Shakdur Manji were both neighboring pastures, and moreover the clan taijis Manibatu, Basutai, Mazai Ubashi, Nuketu Tulumengke, Amur Nusai, Sawang, and others all had no divergent intent; letters should be sent to them as well.
translations.idiomatic: When Sanjit received the letter he said Norbudundok and Shakdur Manji were neighbors and that the clan taijis Manibatu, Basutai, Mazai Ubashi, Nuketu Tulumengke, Amur Nusai, Sawang, and others were loyal; letters should be sent to them too.

sentences.zh: 鄂齊爾稱原歸告父共剿逆。

translations.literal: Eqi'er said he wished to return and tell his father to join in suppressing the rebel together.
translations.idiomatic: Eqi'er said he would return and urge his father to join the campaign against the rebel.

sentences.zh: 而我副將軍薩拉爾集伊犁宰桑等定議，約諾爾布敦多克及沙克都爾曼濟子圖捫以兵至博囉塔拉、布爾哈蘇台、闥勒奇嶺剿阿睦爾撒納。

translations.literal: Meanwhile our deputy commander Saral gathered the Ili zasangs and fixed a plan, arranging for Norbudundok and Shakdur Manji's son Tumen to bring troops to Borotala, Burhasutai, and Talerqi Ridge to suppress Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Deputy Commander Saral and the Ili zasangs agreed that Norbudundok and Shakdur Manji's son Tumen would bring troops to Borotala, Burhasutai, and Talerqi Ridge to attack Amursana.

sentences.zh: 諾爾布敦多克、圖捫各遣使至巴里坤告故，諾爾布敦多克表曰：「臣父羅卜藏車凌，前噶爾丹策淩時謀內附，不獲間。

translations.literal: Norbudundok and Tumen each sent envoys to Barkul to report the reason; Norbudundok memorialized: "My father Lobzang Chiling, in the time of Galdan Tsering, plotted to submit inward but found no opening.
translations.idiomatic: Norbudundok and Tumen each sent envoys to Barkul to explain. Norbudundok memorialized: "My father Lobzang Chiling wished to submit during Galdan Tsering's rule but found no opportunity.

sentences.zh: 大軍徵達瓦齊，臣族班珠爾倚阿睦爾撒納奪臣屬，臣原奮志勦賊。」

translations.literal: When the great army campaigned against Dawachi, my clansman Bandidor, relying on Amursana, seized my followers; I originally resolved to exert my will in suppressing the bandits."
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army campaigned against Dawachi, my clansman Bandidor, backed by Amursana, seized my followers. I am eager to join in suppressing the rebels."

sentences.zh: 上嘉其誠，詔封公爵，以班珠爾所奪給之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his sincerity and issued an edict enfeoffing him as duke, giving him what Bandidor had seized.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his loyalty, enfeoffed him as duke, and restored what Bandidor had taken.

sentences.zh: 班珠爾尋伏誅。

translations.literal: Bandidor was soon executed.
translations.idiomatic: Bandidor was soon executed.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，諾爾布敦多克來歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Norbudundok came in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Norbudundok submitted.

sentences.zh: 薩拉爾等既定謀，阿睦爾撒納偵知之，先備。

translations.literal: After Saral and the others had fixed their plan, Amursana learned of it by espionage and prepared first.
translations.idiomatic: After Saral and the others had settled their plan, Amursana learned of it through spies and prepared first.

sentences.zh: 諾爾布敦多克以兵擊諸伊犁之諾羅斯哈濟拜甡，不勝，偕薩拉爾間道行，由珠勒都斯至巴里坤。

translations.literal: Norbudundok attacked with troops the Noros Khaji Baising group at Ili but was not victorious; he traveled by a secret route together with Saral from the Ili River to Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: Norbudundok attacked the Noros Khaji Baising forces at Ili but was defeated. He and Saral took a secret route from the Ili River to Barkul.

sentences.zh: 時沙克都爾曼濟抵策楞軍，詔令遺書其子圖捫，以兵護牧。

translations.literal: At that time Shakdur Manji reached Celeng's army; an edict ordered that a letter be sent to his son Tumen to guard the pastures with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Shakdur Manji then reached Celeng's army. An edict ordered him to write his son Tumen to guard the pastures with troops.

sentences.zh: 書未達，明噶特附阿睦爾撒納叛，脅所部眾。

translations.literal: Before the letter arrived, Minggat joined Amursana in rebellion and coerced his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Before the letter arrived, Minggat joined Amursana's rebellion and coerced his followers.

sentences.zh: 圖捫不之從，挈戚屬抵珠勒都斯，請內徙，上憫之，詔封多羅貝勒，賜銀千兩，賞雙眼孔雀翎，諭由額琳哈畢爾噶往會沙克都爾曼濟。

translations.literal: Tumen did not follow; he led his kinsmen to the Ili River and requested inward relocation; the emperor pitied him, issued an edict enfeoffing him as doroi beile, granted one thousand taels of silver, awarded double-eyed peacock plumes, and instructed him to go from Ereen Khabirga to join Shakdur Manji.
translations.idiomatic: Tumen refused. He led his kin to the Ili River and asked to move inward. The emperor took pity on him, enfeoffed him as doroi beile, granted one thousand taels of silver and double-eyed peacock plumes, and ordered him to join Shakdur Manji from Ereen Khabirga.

sentences.zh: 有圖什墨勒厄爾哲者，從大軍剿阿睦爾撒納，中道強取諾爾布敦多克屬，詔責之，察所取以歸。

translations.literal: There was Tushmel Erje, who followed the great army in suppressing Amursana; midway he forcibly seized Norbudundok's followers; an edict rebuked him and ordered investigation and return of what had been taken.
translations.idiomatic: Tushmel Erje, marching with the army against Amursana, seized Norbudundok's followers en route. Rebuked by edict, he was ordered to investigate and return what he had taken.

sentences.zh: 諾爾布敦多克及子鄂齊爾尋相繼卒，詔以鄂齊爾弟博爾和津襲公爵，諭曰：「諾爾布敦多克舊牧與哈薩克接壤，恐或掠之。

translations.literal: Norbudundok and his son Eqi'er soon died in succession; an edict ordered Eqi'er's younger brother Borhejin to inherit the ducal rank, saying: "Norbudundok's old pastures border the Kazakhs; there is fear they may raid.
translations.idiomatic: Norbudundok and his son Eqi'er soon died in succession. An edict made Eqi'er's younger brother Borhejin duke, stating: "Norbudundok's old pastures border the Kazakhs and may be raided.

sentences.zh: 若欲徙歸額琳哈畢爾噶，惟其便。」

translations.literal: If you wish to move back to Ereen Khabirga, let it be as you please."
translations.idiomatic: If you wish to move back to Ereen Khabirga, you may do as you see fit."

sentences.zh: 沙克都爾曼濟攜子圖捫及博爾和津等由珠勒都斯至巴里坤，乞屯牧近地。

translations.literal: Shakdur Manji brought his son Tumen, Borhejin, and others from the Ili River to Barkul and begged to settle and pasture nearby.
translations.idiomatic: Shakdur Manji brought his son Tumen, Borhejin, and others from the Ili River to Barkul and asked to settle and graze nearby.

sentences.zh: 副都統雅爾哈善以聞，諭曰：「沙克都爾曼濟以舊牧乏生計，跋涉遠至，殊堪憫惻。

translations.literal: Vice Commander-in-Chief Yarghasan reported this; an edict said: "Shakdur Manji, because his old pastures lacked livelihood, traveled far in hardship—this is deeply pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander-in-Chief Yarghasan reported this. An edict said: "Shakdur Manji's old pastures could no longer support his people, and he has come a great distance in hardship—this deserves compassion.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾頻年不靖，諸部生計維艱。

translations.literal: The Zungar have for years not been at peace; the livelihood of all tribes is difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Years of Zungar unrest have left all the tribes struggling to live.

sentences.zh: 然使台吉等各收其屬，安處游牧，以耕畜為業，善自謀生，不數年間，可復舊業。

translations.literal: Yet if the taijis each gather their followers, settle peacefully in pasture, take farming and livestock as their occupation, and plan well for their livelihood, within a few years they can restore their old holdings.
translations.idiomatic: Yet if each taiji gathers his people, settles them in peace, and supports himself by farming and herding, within a few years they may recover their former prosperity.

sentences.zh: 今沙克都爾曼濟等雖暫處巴里坤，究非故土，難以久處。

translations.literal: Now although Shakdur Manji and others are temporarily at Barkul, after all it is not their native land and they cannot remain long.
translations.idiomatic: Although Shakdur Manji and his people were now lodged temporarily at Barkul, it was not their homeland and they could not stay there indefinitely.

sentences.zh: 又喀爾喀附近之和碩特、杜爾伯特、輝特等，俱將遣歸舊牧，且諭令各安生業，嚴戢盜賊。

translations.literal: Moreover the Khoshut, Dorbod, Khoit, and others near Khalkha will all be sent back to their old pastures, and they are also instructed each to settle in their livelihood and strictly restrain bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshut, Dorbod, Khoit, and others near Khalkha were also to be sent back to their former pastures, with orders to settle peacefully, support themselves, and crack down firmly on banditry.

sentences.zh: 沙克都爾曼濟等自宜仍歸舊牧，但甫從遠道至，遽令之歸，不免困頓，可令暫處巴里坤附近地，賞給糧米如戶口數。」

translations.literal: Shakdur Manji and others should of course return to old pastures, but having just arrived from afar, to order them back at once would only bring exhaustion; they may be allowed to stay temporarily on land near Barkul, with grain and rice granted according to household count."
translations.idiomatic: Shakdur Manji and his followers ought eventually to return to their old pastures, but having only just come a great distance, an immediate order to go back would only exhaust them. They might temporarily settle on land near Barkul, with grain and rice issued according to the number of households."

sentences.zh: 復遣使諭沙克都爾曼濟及綽囉斯汗噶爾藏多爾濟、輝特汗巴雅爾曰：「爾等自入覲歸牧後，遵朕諭旨，約束所屬，守分安居，已逾一載，甚勞遠念。

translations.literal: Again messengers were sent to instruct Shakdur Manji and Choros Khan Galecan Dorji and Khoit Khan Bayar, saying: "Since your audience and return to pasture you have followed Our edicts, restrained your followers, and kept to your duties in peaceful settlement—for more than a year now—We have greatly wearied Ourselves with thoughts of you afar.
translations.idiomatic: Messengers were again sent to Shakdur Manji, Choros Khan Galecan Dorji, and Khoit Khan Bayar with this message: "Since your audience and return to pasture you have obeyed Our orders, kept your people in line, and lived peacefully within your bounds for more than a year. We have long borne you in mind across the distance.

sentences.zh: 今特遣官存問，並令齎賜食物佩飾，以示優眷。

translations.literal: Now We specially send officials to inquire after you and order them to bear gifts of food and personal ornaments, to show Our gracious favor.
translations.idiomatic: We now specially dispatch officials to inquire after your welfare and send food and personal ornaments as gifts, to show Our special favor.

sentences.zh: 逆賊阿睦爾撒納現竄匿哈薩克，苟延殘喘。

translations.literal: The rebel Amursana now hides among the Kazakhs, clinging to his last breath.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Amursana is now hiding among the Kazakhs, barely clinging to life.

sentences.zh: 朕遣官兵征剿經年，時屆寒冬，暫行撤還。

translations.literal: We have dispatched officers and soldiers to campaign and suppress for years; as winter has come, the force is temporarily withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: We have sent troops against him for years, but as winter has set in the army is being temporarily withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 第逆賊狡詐百出，儻遣人赴爾等游牧，詭計煽惑，爾等即行擒獻。

translations.literal: But the rebel is endlessly crafty; if he should send men to your pastures to plot and incite by deception, you are to seize and deliver them at once.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the rebel is endlessly treacherous. If he sends men to your pastures to deceive and incite trouble, you must seize them and hand them over at once.

sentences.zh: 至沙克都爾曼濟奏請游牧巴里坤附近地，已諭酌賜口糧，俟明春复賞給耔種，耕耨廋集額卜齊布拉克地，秋收後遣歸舊牧。

translations.literal: As for Shakdur Manji's memorial requesting pasture near Barkul, he has already been instructed to be granted rations as appropriate; when next spring comes seed will again be bestowed, to plow and cultivate and store grain at Ebiqilebulake, and after the autumn harvest he will be sent back to his old pasture.
translations.idiomatic: As for Shakdur Manji's request to graze near Barkul, he has already been told he will receive rations as needed. Next spring seed will be given again so he may plow, cultivate, and store grain at Ebiqilebulake; after the autumn harvest he will be sent back to his former pastures.

sentences.zh: 爾等其善自謀生，永享昇平之福。」

translations.literal: Do you each plan well for your livelihood and ever enjoy the blessings of rising peace."
translations.idiomatic: See to your livelihood wisely, and may you long enjoy the blessings of peace."

sentences.zh: 沙克都爾曼濟尋獻所部盜馬者請論罪，諭曰：「厄魯特劫奪成風，不可不嚴加懲創。

translations.literal: Shakdur Manji soon presented those of his tribe who had stolen horses and asked that they be judged; an edict said: "Among the Oirats plunder and seizure have become a custom; they cannot but be severely punished.
translations.idiomatic: Shakdur Manji soon handed over men of his tribe who had stolen horses and asked that they be punished. An edict replied: "Plunder has become habitual among the Oirats and must be severely punished.

sentences.zh: 爾等擒獲竊賊，解送內地，甚屬恭順。

translations.literal: That you captured thieves and sent them to the interior is very much a matter of respectful submission.
translations.idiomatic: Your capture of the thieves and delivery of them inland shows great dutifulness.

sentences.zh: 嗣後可自治之。」

translations.literal: Hereafter you may administer such cases yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter you may handle such matters yourselves."

sentences.zh: 復以博爾和津幼不更事，諭沙克都爾曼濟留心護視，並令其族摩羅及宰桑新登等暫理牧務。

translations.literal: Again, because Borhejin was young and inexperienced in affairs, Shakdur Manji was instructed to watch over him carefully, and his clansmen Moro and the zaisang Xindeng were ordered temporarily to manage pastoral affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Because Borhejin was young and inexperienced, Shakdur Manji was told to look after him carefully, and his kinsmen Moro and the zaisang Xindeng were ordered to manage pastoral affairs for the time being.

sentences.zh: 既而諸衛拉特復不靖，巴雅爾詭稱沙克都爾曼濟掠所部牧，將以兵襲巴里坤。

translations.literal: Before long the Oirats again were unsettled; Bayar falsely claimed Shakdur Manji had raided his tribe's pastures and would attack Barkul with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Oirats were again restless. Bayar falsely claimed that Shakdur Manji had raided his pastures and was about to attack Barkul with troops.

sentences.zh: 噶爾藏多爾濟及兄子扎納噶爾布叛擾邊境，有普爾普者，以其主沙克都爾曼濟私通扎納噶爾佈告，詔雅爾哈善察之。

translations.literal: Galecan Dorji and his elder brother's son Zanagarbu rebelled and harassed the frontier; one Purpu reported that his lord Shakdur Manji had privately communicated with Zanagarbu; an edict ordered Yarghasan to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Galecan Dorji and his elder brother's son Zanagarbu rebelled and raided the frontier. A man named Purpu reported that his lord Shakdur Manji was secretly in league with Zanagarbu, and an edict ordered Yarghasan to investigate.

sentences.zh: 時沙克都爾曼濟設汛哨內防禦，遣諜赴巴里坤偵大軍狀，子圖捫死，不以告。

translations.literal: At the time Shakdur Manji set outposts for defense inward, sent spies to Barkul to reconnoiter the great army's situation; his son Tumen died but he did not report it.
translations.idiomatic: Shakdur Manji had meanwhile posted guards for internal defense and sent spies to Barkul to observe the main army. His son Tumen died, but he did not report it.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善召之，稱病不至，疑果叛，宵抵其營殲之，斬眾四千餘，察獲博爾和津。

translations.literal: Yarghasan summoned him; he claimed illness and did not come; suspecting rebellion was real, at night he reached his camp and annihilated it, beheading more than four thousand of the host, and took Borhejin in custody.
translations.idiomatic: Yarghasan summoned him, but he pleaded illness and did not come. Convinced that he had indeed rebelled, Yarghasan reached his camp by night and destroyed it, beheading more than four thousand men and taking Borhejin into custody.

sentences.zh: 奏請安置地，詔徙京師，停襲公爵。

translations.literal: A memorial requested land for resettlement; an edict ordered removal to the capital and suspension of ducal inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: A memorial asked where the survivors should be settled. An edict ordered them moved to the capital and suspended inheritance of the ducal rank.

sentences.zh: 沙克都爾曼濟弟桑濟竄徙額爾齊斯境，掠奉使杜爾伯特之侍衛佛保駝馬，佛保奮擊之，乃逸。

translations.literal: Shakdur Manji's younger brother Sangji fled to the Irtysh region, plundered the camels and horses of the guardsman Fubao who was on a mission to the Dorbod; Fubao fought fiercely and he escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Shakdur Manji's younger brother Sangji fled to the Irtysh region and plundered the camels and horses of the guardsman Fubao, who was on a mission to the Dorbod. Fubao fought back fiercely and Sangji escaped.

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特汗車凌遣親王車凌烏巴什等追剿，桑濟走死，和碩特叛黨始靖。

translations.literal: Dorbod Khan Cheren sent Prince Cheren Ubashi and others in pursuit; Sangji fled and died, and the Khoshut rebel faction was finally pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Dorbod Khan Cheren sent Prince Cheren Ubashi and others in pursuit. Sangji fled and was killed, and the Khoshut rebels were finally pacified.

sentences.zh: 而其族多爾濟之裔恭格等，有偕土爾扈特部游牧俄羅斯之額濟勒河境者，三十六年，從土爾扈特汗渥巴錫自俄羅斯來歸。

translations.literal: But among their clan, descendants of Dorji such as Gongge, some who had grazed with the Torghut tribes in Russia on the Ejin River border—in the thirty-sixth year they returned from Russia with Torghut Khan Ubashi.
translations.idiomatic: Among their clan, however, Dorji's descendants such as Gongge—some of whom had grazed with the Torghuts in Russia on the Ejin River—in the thirty-sixth year returned from Russia with Torghut Khan Ubashi.

sentences.zh: 尋入覲，詔封恭格為土謝圖貝勒，族叔父雅蘭阿穆爾聆貴為貝子，授族弟諾海及巴雅爾拉瑚一等台吉，均為扎薩克，各編一旗，賜盟名曰巴圖色特啟勒圖，餘悉如土爾扈特例。

translations.literal: Soon they had audience; an edict enfeoffed Gongge as Tushetu beile, his clan uncle Yalan Amur Linggui as beizi, granted clan younger brothers Nohai and Bayar Lahu as first-rank taiji, all as zasak, each organized into one banner, bestowing the league name Batu Set Kiretu; the rest all followed Torghut precedent.
translations.idiomatic: They soon had audience at court. Gongge was enfeoffed as Tushetu beile, his clan uncle Yalan Amur Linggui as beizi, and his younger clansmen Nohai and Bayar Lahu as first-rank taiji. All received zasak rank and each was organized into a banner. Their league was named Batu Set Kiretu, and everything else followed Torghut precedent.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，賜牧珠勒都斯。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year pasture at Zhaledus was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 37th year they were granted pasture at Zhaledus.

sentences.zh: 四十年，設正副盟長各一。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year one chief and one deputy league chief were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the 40th year one chief and one deputy league chief were appointed.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，恭格從子博騰特克卒，無嗣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing Gongge's nephew Botengteke died without heir.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 Gongge's nephew Botengteke died without an heir.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以所管佐領分給貝子鄂齊爾二，扎薩克台吉齊業齊三，烏爾圖那遜一，除其爵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month his assistant commandant companies were distributed: two to Beizi Eqi'er, three to zasak taiji Qiyeqi, one to Urtunason, and his rank was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month his assistant commandant companies were divided: two to Beizi Eqi'er, three to zasak taiji Qiyeqi, and one to Urtunason, and his title was abolished.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，回疆軍興，徵是部兵協剿。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang when the Xinjiang campaign arose, troops of this tribe were levied to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6, when the Xinjiang campaign began, troops of this tribe were called up to assist in suppression.

sentences.zh: 敗回匪於阿克甦之渾巴什河，予緞疋、銀兩及翎頂各有差。

translations.literal: They defeated Muslim bandits at the Hunbash River in Aksu, and satin, silver, and peacock plumes were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: They defeated Muslim rebels at the Hunbash River in Aksu and received satin, silver, and peacock plumes in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 自是回疆有事，皆偕土爾扈特兵應徵調，統隸於伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: From then on whenever Xinjiang had affairs, they always answered levies alongside Torghut troops, under the overall command of the Ili General.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, whenever trouble arose in Xinjiang, they were mobilized together with Torghut troops under the Ili General.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，回亂，是部被蹂躪，戶口散失大半，中路左旗扎薩克台吉喇什德勒克率餘眾避居博爾圖山中，竭力保守。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi during the Muslim rebellion this tribe was ravaged and more than half its households scattered; Rashidelerik, zasak taiji of the Central Route Left Banner, led the remnant to shelter in the Boltu mountains and strove to preserve them.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3, during the Muslim rebellion, this tribe was devastated and more than half its people scattered. Rashidelerik, zasak taiji of the Central Route Left Banner, led the survivors into the Boltu mountains and did his utmost to preserve them.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，劉錦棠收復托克遜，喇什德勒克謁劉錦棠。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu Liu Jintang recovered Toksun; Rashidelerik had audience with Liu Jintang.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 3 Liu Jintang recovered Toksun, and Rashidelerik paid him a visit.

sentences.zh: 八月，進兵，以後隨同官軍馳驅，於地勢險夷，賊情虛實，水道深淺，具陳實狀。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the army advanced; thereafter he ranged with the government forces, fully reporting the actual conditions of terrain easy or difficult, rebels true or false, and waterways deep or shallow.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the army advanced, and thereafter he rode with the government forces, reporting in full on the lay of the land, the rebels' true strength, and the depth of the waterways.

sentences.zh: 師逾開都河，遂遷其部於河東。

translations.literal: When the army crossed the Kaidu River, his tribe was then moved to the east of the river.
translations.idiomatic: When the army crossed the Kaidu River, his tribe was moved to the east bank.

sentences.zh: 欽差大臣左宗棠請獎，疏入，予花翎。

translations.literal: Imperial Commissioner Zuo Zongtang requested rewards; the memorial was received and peacock plumes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Commissioner Zuo Zongtang recommended him for reward; the memorial was approved and he received peacock plumes.

sentences.zh: 先是中旗貝子多爾那齊那木札勒、右旗扎薩克洞魯布旺扎勒皆避出，至是始歸所牧。

translations.literal: Earlier the Central Banner beizi Dornachinamujale and the Right Banner zasak Dongrub Wangzhale had both fled out; only now did they return to their pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Central Banner beizi Dornachinamujale and the Right Banner zasak Dongrub Wangzhale had both fled; only now did they return to their pastures.

sentences.zh: 是部佐領尚呈左宗棠，請以其兩旗人眾隸喇什德勒克。

translations.literal: Assistant commandants of this tribe still memorialized Zuo Zongtang, asking that the people of their two banners be placed under Rashidelerik.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant commandants of this tribe still petitioned Zuo Zongtang, asking that the people of their two banners be placed under Rashidelerik.

sentences.zh: 事尋寢。

translations.literal: The matter was soon dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was soon dropped.

sentences.zh: 八年，設喀喇沙爾直隸同知兼理事銜，釐是部蒙、民交涉事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year a Karashahr direct-attached subprefect with concurrent Mongol-affairs rank was established to regulate Mongol and civilian dealings of this tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the 8th year a Karashahr direct subprefect with concurrent Mongol-affairs authority was appointed to handle this tribe's dealings between Mongols and civilians.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，甘肅回匪竄出關，伊犁將軍長庚檄是部貝子棍布扎普派扎薩克台吉貢噶那木扎勒統兵駐都木達塔什哈地方，扼博斯騰淖爾通羅布淖爾之徑，事定，撤歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year when Gansu Muslim bandits broke out of the passes, Ili General Chang Geng ordered this tribe's beizi Gunbuzhapu to dispatch zasak taiji Gongga Namuzhale to command troops stationed at Dumudatashha to block the route from Bosten Lake to Lop Nor; when affairs were settled they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the 22nd year, when Gansu Muslim rebels broke through the passes, Ili General Chang Geng ordered this tribe's beizi Gunbuzhapu to send zasak taiji Gongga Namuzhale with troops to hold Dumudatashha and block the route from Bosten Lake to Lop Nor. When the crisis ended, they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 其地出產同舊土爾扈特南部落。

translations.literal: Its local products are the same as those of the Old Torghut Southern Route tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Its local products are the same as those of the Old Torghut Southern Route tribe.

sentences.zh: 佐領共十一。

translations.literal: There are eleven assistant commandants in all.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe had eleven assistant commandants in all.
